--[[
    DoorHinge.lua
    A servo-powered door with open/close state.

    Setup:
    - A door part with a HingeConstraint named "Hinge".
    - The hinge's Attachment0 should be on the door frame, Attachment1 on the door.
    - The hinge Axis should point up (rotation axis).
    - Keep the door assembly server-owned for authoritative collision; call
      :destroy() when the door is removed to clean up the servo state.

    Usage:
        local DoorHinge = require(path.to.DoorHinge)
        local door = DoorHinge.new(workspace.DoorModel.Hinge)
        door:open()
        door:close()
        door:destroy()
]]

local DoorHinge = {}
DoorHinge.__index = DoorHinge

type DoorHingeState = {
    hinge: HingeConstraint?,
    isOpen: boolean,
}

export type DoorHinge = typeof(setmetatable({} :: DoorHingeState, DoorHinge))

function DoorHinge.new(hinge: HingeConstraint): DoorHinge
    local self = setmetatable(
        {
            hinge = hinge,
            isOpen = false,
        } :: DoorHingeState,
        DoorHinge
    )
    hinge.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Servo
    hinge.ServoMaxTorque = 2000
    hinge.AngularSpeed = 3
    hinge.LimitsEnabled = true
    hinge.LowerAngle = 0
    hinge.UpperAngle = 90
    return self
end

function DoorHinge.open(self: DoorHinge)
    local hinge = self.hinge
    if not hinge then
        return
    end
    hinge.TargetAngle = hinge.UpperAngle
    self.isOpen = true
end

function DoorHinge.close(self: DoorHinge)
    local hinge = self.hinge
    if not hinge then
        return
    end
    hinge.TargetAngle = hinge.LowerAngle
    self.isOpen = false
end

function DoorHinge.toggle(self: DoorHinge)
    if self.isOpen then
        self:close()
    else
        self:open()
    end
end

function DoorHinge.destroy(self: DoorHinge)
    -- Release the servo so the hinge becomes passive after cleanup.
    local hinge = self.hinge
    if hinge then
        hinge.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.None
    end
    self.hinge = nil
end

return DoorHinge

-- HUD: team cash, phase + day + countdown, truck health, upgrade shop button.
-- Plan: UI-02 (HUD), UI-06 (shop button)
-- Binds to PlayerGui.Hud and reads replicated workspace attributes:
-- Cash, GameState, StateEndsAt, Day, TruckHp, TruckMaxHp. No remotes needed.

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local UiBind = require(script.Parent.Parent.Lib.UiBind)
local ShopController = require(script.Parent.ShopController)

local HudController = {}

-- TODO(UI): move player-facing text to a LocalizationTable.
local TEXT = {
	Phase = { Ready = "START", Day = "DZIEŃ", Night = "NOC", Shop = "ULEPSZENIA", Results = "WYNIKI" },
	Day = "Dzień %d/%d",
	NoDay = "Dzień -/%d",
	NoTime = "--:--",
	Hp = "%d/%d",
}
local TICK = 0.1

local function formatTime(seconds: number): string
	local whole = math.max(0, math.ceil(seconds))
	return string.format("%d:%02d", whole // 60, whole % 60)
end

function HudController.Init() end

function HudController.Start()
	local gui = UiBind.screen("Hud")
	if not gui then
		return
	end
	local cashLabel = UiBind.find(gui, "CashPanel/CashLabel")
	local timerPanel = UiBind.find(gui, "TimerPanel")
	local phaseLabel = UiBind.find(gui, "TimerPanel/PhaseLabel")
	local dayLabel = UiBind.find(gui, "TimerPanel/DayLabel")
	local timerLabel = UiBind.find(gui, "TimerPanel/TimerLabel")
	local timerFill = UiBind.find(gui, "TimerPanel/TimerBar/Fill")
	local hpFill = UiBind.find(gui, "TruckHpPanel/HpBar/HpFill")
	local hpLabel = UiBind.find(gui, "TruckHpPanel/HpBar/HpLabel")
	local shopButton = UiBind.find(gui, "ShopButton")

	local dayColor = timerPanel and timerPanel:GetAttribute("DayColor")
	local nightColor = timerPanel and timerPanel:GetAttribute("NightColor")
	local phaseDuration = 0

	local function updateCash()
		if cashLabel then
			cashLabel.Text = UiBind.formatCash(workspace:GetAttribute("Cash") or 0)
		end
	end

	local function updatePhase()
		local state = workspace:GetAttribute("GameState") or "Ready"
		local day = workspace:GetAttribute("Day") or 0
		if phaseLabel then
			phaseLabel.Text = TEXT.Phase[state] or state
		end
		if dayLabel then
			dayLabel.Text = if day > 0
				then string.format(TEXT.Day, day, Config.Run.Days)
				else string.format(TEXT.NoDay, Config.Run.Days)
		end
		local color = if state == "Night" then nightColor else dayColor
		if typeof(color) == "Color3" then
			if phaseLabel then
				phaseLabel.TextColor3 = color
			end
			if timerFill then
				timerFill.BackgroundColor3 = color
			end
		end
		if timerPanel then
			timerPanel:SetAttribute("Phase", state)
		end
		if shopButton then
			shopButton.Visible = state == "Shop"
		end
	end

	local function onEndsAtChanged()
		local endsAt = workspace:GetAttribute("StateEndsAt") or 0
		phaseDuration = if endsAt > 0 then math.max(endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow(), 0.001) else 0
	end

	local function updateTimer()
		local endsAt = workspace:GetAttribute("StateEndsAt") or 0
		if endsAt <= 0 then
			if timerLabel then
				timerLabel.Text = TEXT.NoTime
			end
			UiBind.setFill(timerFill, 1)
			return
		end
		local remaining = endsAt - workspace:GetServerTimeNow()
		if timerLabel then
			timerLabel.Text = formatTime(remaining)
		end
		UiBind.setFill(timerFill, if phaseDuration > 0 then remaining / phaseDuration else 1)
	end

	local function updateHp()
		local hp = workspace:GetAttribute("TruckHp") or 0
		local maxHp = math.max(workspace:GetAttribute("TruckMaxHp") or 1, 1)
		UiBind.setFill(hpFill, hp / maxHp)
		if hpLabel then
			hpLabel.Text = string.format(TEXT.Hp, math.ceil(hp), maxHp)
		end
	end

	if shopButton then
		shopButton.Activated:Connect(ShopController.Toggle)
	end
	workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Cash"):Connect(updateCash)
	workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal("GameState"):Connect(updatePhase)
	workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Day"):Connect(updatePhase)
	workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal("StateEndsAt"):Connect(onEndsAtChanged)
	workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal("TruckHp"):Connect(updateHp)
	workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal("TruckMaxHp"):Connect(updateHp)

	updateCash()
	updatePhase()
	onEndsAtChanged()
	updateHp()
	while true do
		updateTimer()
		task.wait(TICK)
	end
end

return HudController

local Geode = require(ReplicatedStorage.Packages.Geode)

local t = Geode.t

Geode.op("buyItem", function(tx, item: string)
	local prices: { [string]: number } = { sword = 100, shield = 75 }
	local price = prices[item]
	assert(price, `unknown item {item}`)
	tx:decrement("coins", price)
	tx:append("inventory", item)
end)

	name = "ExamplePlayerData",
	template = { coins = 0, inventory = {}, wins = 0 },
	replicate = { coins = "owner", inventory = "owner", wins = "public" },
	ops = { "buyItem" },
	guards = { Geode.guard.range("coins", { min = 0 }) },
	products = {
		[0] = function(tx)
			tx:increment("coins", 500)
		end,
	},
})

Geode.remoteOp("buyItem", {
	store = PlayerData.store,
	args = { t.enum({ "sword", "shield" }) },
	rateLimit = { count = 5, window = 10 },
})

local Daily = Geode.Ranked.windowed("ExampleDailyWins", { window = "daily", mode = "sum" })

PlayerData:onLoaded(function(player, profile)
	profile:increment("coins", 100)
	print(`{player.Name} loaded with {profile:get("coins")} coins`)
end)

-- stand-in for winning a round, once a minute
task.spawn(function()
	while true do
		task.wait(60)
		for _, player in game:GetService("Players"):GetPlayers() do
			local data = PlayerData:get(player)
			if data and data:isLoaded() then
				data:increment("wins")
				Daily:submit(player.UserId, 1)

		end
	end
end)

type PlatformMoverState = {
    platform: BasePart,
    waypoints: { Vector3 },
    waitTime: number,
    index: number,
    direction: number,
    running: boolean,
    delayTask: thread?,
    alignPos: AlignPosition?,
    alignOrn: AlignOrientation?,
}

export type PlatformMover = typeof(setmetatable({} :: PlatformMoverState, PlatformMover))

function PlatformMover.new(
    platform: BasePart,
    waypoints: { Vector3 }?,
    waitTime: number?
): PlatformMover
    -- AlignPosition cannot move an anchored assembly.
    platform.Anchored = false

    local alignPos = platform:FindFirstChildOfClass("AlignPosition")
        or Instance.new("AlignPosition")
    alignPos.Mode = Enum.PositionAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
    alignPos.RigidityEnabled = false
    alignPos.MaxForce = platform.AssemblyMass * 1000
    alignPos.MaxVelocity = 20
    alignPos.Responsiveness = 20
    alignPos.Parent = platform

    local alignOrn = platform:FindFirstChildOfClass("AlignOrientation")
        or Instance.new("AlignOrientation")
    alignOrn.Mode = Enum.OrientationAlignmentMode.OneAttachment
    alignOrn.AlignType = Enum.AlignType.AllAxes
    alignOrn.RigidityEnabled = false
    alignOrn.MaxTorque = platform.AssemblyMass * 500
    alignOrn.MaxAngularVelocity = 5
    alignOrn.Responsiveness = 20
    alignOrn.CFrame = platform.CFrame.Rotation
    alignOrn.Parent = platform

    if not alignPos.Attachment0 then
        local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
        att.Parent = platform
        alignPos.Attachment0 = att
    end
    if not alignOrn.Attachment0 then
        local att = Instance.new("Attachment")
        att.Parent = platform
        alignOrn.Attachment0 = att
    end

    local self = setmetatable(
        {
            platform = platform,
            waypoints = waypoints or {},
            waitTime = waitTime or 2,
            index = 1,
            direction = 1,
            running = false,
            delayTask = nil :: thread?,
            alignPos = alignPos,
            alignOrn = alignOrn,
        } :: PlatformMoverState,
        PlatformMover
    )

    return self
end

function PlatformMover.moveToNext(self: PlatformMover)
    if #self.waypoints == 0 then
        return
    end

    local target = self.waypoints[self.index]
    local alignPos = self.alignPos
    if not alignPos then
        return
    end
    alignPos.Position = target

    self.delayTask = task.delay(self.waitTime, function()
        self.delayTask = nil
        if not self.running then
            return
        end
        self.index += self.direction
        if self.index > #self.waypoints then
            self.index = #self.waypoints - 1
            self.direction = -1
        elseif self.index < 1 then
            self.index = 2
            self.direction = 1
        end
        self:moveToNext()
    end)
end

function PlatformMover.start(self: PlatformMover)
    if self.running then
        return
    end
    self.running = true
    self:moveToNext()
end

function PlatformMover.stop(self: PlatformMover)
    self.running = false
    if self.delayTask then
        task.cancel(self.delayTask)
        self.delayTask = nil
    end
end

function PlatformMover.destroy(self: PlatformMover)
    self:stop()
    if self.alignPos then
        self.alignPos:Destroy()
        self.alignPos = nil
    end
    if self.alignOrn then
        self.alignOrn:Destroy()
        self.alignOrn = nil
    end
end

return PlatformMover

-- Upgrade shop window: shows levels and prices, sends purchase intents, gives feedback.
-- Plan: UI-06 (upgrade shop), SYS-11 (client side)
-- Binds to PlayerGui.UpgradeShop (cards = children of Panel/ItemList with an UpgradeId attribute).
-- Opens by itself when the Shop phase starts and closes when it ends; the HUD button toggles it.
--
-- ShopController.Open() / Close() / Toggle() / IsOpen()

local GuiService = game:GetService("GuiService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")

local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net)
local Upgrades = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Upgrades)
local UiBind = require(script.Parent.Parent.Lib.UiBind)

local ShopController = {}

-- TODO(UI): move player-facing text to a LocalizationTable.
local TEXT = {
	Level = "Poz. %d/%d",
	Max = "MAX",
	TooPoor = "ZA MAŁO!",
	Closed = "ZAMKNIĘTE",
}
local DIMMED = 0.45
local FEEDBACK_SECONDS = 0.9

type Card = {
	id: string,
	frame: GuiObject,
	levelLabel: TextLabel?,
	buyButton: TextButton?,
	busy: boolean,
	feedbackUntil: number,
}

local gui: ScreenGui? = nil
local panel: GuiObject? = nil
local cashLabel: TextLabel? = nil
local cards: { Card } = {}

local function cash(): number
	return workspace:GetAttribute("Cash") or 0
end

local function refreshCard(card: Card)
	local def = Upgrades.Defs[card.id]
	local level = workspace:GetAttribute(Upgrades.attribute(card.id)) or 0
	if card.levelLabel then
		card.levelLabel.Text = string.format(TEXT.Level, level, def.MaxLevel)
	end
	local button = card.buyButton
	if not button or os.clock() < card.feedbackUntil then
		return
	end
	local cost = Upgrades.nextCost(card.id, level)
	local canBuy = cost ~= nil and cash() >= cost and workspace:GetAttribute("GameState") == "Shop"
	button.Text = if cost then UiBind.formatCash(cost) else TEXT.Max
	button.Interactable = canBuy and not card.busy
	button.BackgroundTransparency = if canBuy then 0 else DIMMED
	button.TextTransparency = if canBuy then 0 else DIMMED * 0.6
end

local function refresh()
	if cashLabel then
		cashLabel.Text = UiBind.formatCash(cash())
	end
	for _, card in cards do
		refreshCard(card)
	end
end

local function flash(card: Card, text: string)
	local button = card.buyButton
	if not button then
		return
	end
	card.feedbackUntil = os.clock() + FEEDBACK_SECONDS
	button.Text = text
	task.delay(FEEDBACK_SECONDS, refreshCard, card)
end

local function buy(card: Card)
	if card.busy then
		return
	end
	card.busy = true
	refreshCard(card)
	local result = Net.invoke("BuyUpgrade", card.id)
	card.busy = false
	if result == "Bought" then
		UiBind.pop(card.frame, 0.9)
	elseif result == "TooPoor" then
		flash(card, TEXT.TooPoor)
	elseif result == "Closed" then
		flash(card, TEXT.Closed)
	end
	refresh()
end

function ShopController.IsOpen(): boolean
	return gui ~= nil and gui.Enabled
end

function ShopController.Open()
	if not gui or gui.Enabled then
		return
	end
	refresh()
	gui.Enabled = true
	UiBind.pop(panel)
	if UserInputService.GamepadEnabled and cards[1] and cards[1].buyButton then
		GuiService.SelectedObject = cards[1].buyButton
	end
end

function ShopController.Close()
	if not gui or not gui.Enabled then
		return
	end
	gui.Enabled = false
	local selected = GuiService.SelectedObject
	if selected and selected:IsDescendantOf(gui) then
		GuiService.SelectedObject = nil
	end
end

function ShopController.Toggle()
	if ShopController.IsOpen() then
		ShopController.Close()
	else
		ShopController.Open()
	end
end

function ShopController.Init() end

function ShopController.Start()
	gui = UiBind.screen("UpgradeShop")
	if not gui then
		return
	end
	gui.Enabled = false
	panel = UiBind.find(gui, "Panel")
	cashLabel = UiBind.find(gui, "Panel/Header/CashChip/CashLabel")

	local itemList = UiBind.find(gui, "Panel/ItemList")
	for _, frame in if itemList then itemList:GetChildren() else {} do
		local id = frame:GetAttribute("UpgradeId")
		if id and Upgrades.Defs[id] then
			local card: Card = {
				id = id,
				frame = frame,
				levelLabel = UiBind.find(frame, "LevelLabel"),
				buyButton = UiBind.find(frame, "BuyButton"),
				busy = false,
				feedbackUntil = 0,
			}
			table.insert(cards, card)
			if card.buyButton then
				card.buyButton.Activated:Connect(function()
					buy(card)
				end)
			end
		elseif id then
			warn(`[ShopController] card {frame.Name} has unknown UpgradeId "{id}"`)
		end
	end
	table.sort(cards, function(a, b)
		return (a.frame :: any).LayoutOrder < (b.frame :: any).LayoutOrder
	end)

	local closeButton = UiBind.find(gui, "Panel/Header/CloseButton")
	if closeButton then
		closeButton.Activated:Connect(ShopController.Close)
	end

	workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal("Cash"):Connect(refresh)
	for _, id in Upgrades.Ids do
		workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal(Upgrades.attribute(id)):Connect(refresh)
	end
	local function onState()
		if workspace:GetAttribute("GameState") == "Shop" then
			ShopController.Open()
		else
			ShopController.Close()
		end
		refresh()
	end
	workspace:GetAttributeChangedSignal("GameState"):Connect(onState)
	onState()
end

return ShopController

--!strict

-- Fills the tables in docs/benchmarks.md from latest.json. A table sits between two comments,
--
--   <!-- bench:table hops start -->
--   <!-- bench:table hops end -->
--
-- and everything between them is written again. The prose around them stays as written. A table
-- with a notes column keeps each row's notes, matched by the row's label, since those are
-- written by hand. Tables come out the way Prettier formats them

local BenchDocs = {}

type Table = {
	headers: { string },
	-- the last column is kept by hand when set
	notes: boolean?,
	suites: { string },
	cells: (result: (scenario: string, metric: string) -> any) -> { string },
}

--// cells

local function seconds(value: number): string
	return string.format("%.2f", value)
end

local function timing(result: any): string
	if result == nil or result.value.n == 0 then
		return "-"
	end
	local value = result.value
	local failed = if value.failed > 0 then `, {value.failed} failed` else ""
	if value.kind == "range" then
		return `{seconds(value.min)} to {seconds(value.max)}{failed}`
	end
	return `{seconds(value.median)} ({seconds(value.min)} to {seconds(value.max)}, {value.n}{failed})`
end

local function amount(result: any): string
	if result == nil then
		return "-"
	end
	local value = result.value
	local function one(number: number): string
		return string.format("%.1f", number)
	end
	return `{one(value.median)} ({one(value.min)} to {one(value.max)}, {value.n})`
end

local function count(result: any): string
	if result == nil then
		return "-"
	end
	return `{result.value.passed} of {result.value.total}`
end

local function valuesSeen(result: any): string
	if result == nil then
		return "-"
	end
	local value = result.value
	local seen = {}
	for text, times in value.counts do
		table.insert(seen, { text = text, times = times })
	end
	table.sort(seen, function(a, b)
		return a.times > b.times or (a.times == b.times and a.text < b.text)
	end)
	local parts = {}
	for _, entry in seen do
		table.insert(parts, `{entry.text} in {entry.times}`)
	end
	return `{table.concat(parts, ", ")} of {value.total}`
end

local function joinWords(parts: { string }): string
	if #parts <= 1 then
		return parts[1] or "none"
	end
	return table.concat(parts, ", ", 1, #parts - 1) .. " and " .. parts[#parts]
end

local function requestWords(catalog: any, result: any): string
	if result == nil then
		return "-"
	end
	local parts = {}
	for _, method in catalog.requestMethods do
		local range = result.value.byMethod[method.id]
		if range == nil or range.max == 0 then
			continue
		end
		local times = if range.min == range.max
			then tostring(range.min)
			elseif range.max == range.min + 1 then `{range.min} or {range.max}`
			else `{range.min} to {range.max}`
		table.insert(parts, `{times} {method.label}`)
	end
	return joinWords(parts)
end

local function sameRequests(a: any, b: any): boolean
	if a == nil or b == nil then
		return a == b
	end
	for id, range in a.value.byMethod do
		local other = b.value.byMethod[id]
		if other == nil or other.min ~= range.min or other.max ~= range.max then
			return false
		end
	end
	for id in b.value.byMethod do
		if a.value.byMethod[id] == nil then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

--// tables

local function tables(catalog: any): { [string]: Table }
	return {
		["perf-times"] = {
			headers = {
				"Library",
				"Load, new profile (s)",
				"Load, stored profile (s)",
				"Save (s)",
				"Release (s)",
			},
			suites = { "load-save-release" },
			cells = function(result)
				return {
					timing(result("load-new", "time")),
					timing(result("load-stored", "time")),
					timing(result("save", "time")),
					timing(result("release", "time")),
				}
			end,
		},
		["perf-requests"] = {
			headers = { "Library", "Load", "Save", "Release", "Notes" },
			notes = true,
			suites = { "load-save-release" },
			cells = function(result)
				local new = result("load-new", "requests")
				local stored = result("load-stored", "requests")
				local load = requestWords(catalog, new)
				if not sameRequests(new, stored) then
					load ..= `, stored profile {requestWords(catalog, stored)}`
				end
				return {
					load,
					requestWords(catalog, result("save", "requests")),
					requestWords(catalog, result("release", "requests")),
				}
			end,
		},
		hops = {
			headers = {
				"Library",
				"Old server releases (s)",
				"Saw the final save",
				"Old server keeps it (s)",
				"Value seen when kept",
				"Requests by the new server",
				"Notes",
			},
			notes = true,
			suites = { "server-hop" },
			cells = function(result)
				local releases = result("old-releases", "requests")
				local keeps = result("old-keeps", "requests")
				local requests = requestWords(catalog, releases)
				if not sameRequests(releases, keeps) then
					requests ..= `, when kept {requestWords(catalog, keeps)}`
				end
				return {
					timing(result("old-releases", "time")),
					count(result("old-releases", "final-save-seen")),
					timing(result("old-keeps", "time")),
					valuesSeen(result("old-keeps", "value-seen")),
					requests,
				}
			end,
		},
		throttling = {
			headers = {
				"Library",
				"Load (s)",
				"Save (s)",
				"Release (s)",
				"What the proxy saw during the load",
			},
			notes = true,
			suites = { "throttling" },
			cells = function(result)
				return {
					timing(result("load", "time")),
					timing(result("save", "time")),
					timing(result("release", "time")),
				}
			end,
		},
		memory = {
			headers = { "Library", "Heap per profile (KB)" },
			suites = { "memory" },
			cells = function(result)
				return { amount(result("loaded-profiles", "heap-per-profile")) }
			end,
		},
		["geode-edits"] = {
			headers = { "Library", "Time per edit (µs)" },
			suites = { "geode-edits" },
			cells = function(result)
				return { amount(result("increment", "time-per-edit")) }
			end,
		},
	}
end

--// markdown

local function width(text: string): number
	return utf8.len(text) or #text
end

-- A markdown table the way Prettier writes one: every column as wide as its widest cell
local function format(rows: { { string } }): string
	local widths = {}
	for _, row in rows do
		for column, cell in row do
			widths[column] = math.max(widths[column] or 3, width(cell))
		end
	end
	local function line(cells: { string }): string
		local padded = {}
		for column, cell in cells do
			padded[column] = cell .. string.rep(" ", widths[column] - width(cell))
		end
		return `| {table.concat(padded, " | ")} |`
	end
	local lines = { line(rows[1]) }
	local dashes = {}
	for column in rows[1] do
		dashes[column] = string.rep("-", widths[column])
	end
	table.insert(lines, line(dashes))
	for index = 2, #rows do
		table.insert(lines, line(rows[index]))
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n")
end

local function splitRow(line: string): { string }?
	if string.sub(line, 1, 1) ~= "|" then
		return nil
	end
	local cells = {}
	for cell in string.gmatch(string.sub(line, 2), "([^|]*)|") do
		table.insert(cells, (string.gsub(cell, "^%s*(.-)%s*$", "%1")))
	end
	return cells
end

-- Each row's last cell by its label, from the table that's there now
local function existingNotes(region: string): { [string]: string }
	local notes = {}
	local seen = 0
	for line in string.gmatch(region, "[^\n]+") do
		local cells = splitRow(line)
		if cells then
			seen += 1
			-- the first two lines are the header and the dashes
			if seen > 2 and #cells > 1 then
				notes[cells[1]] = cells[#cells]
			end
		end
	end
	return notes
end

local function labelOf(subject: any): string
	return subject.docsLabel or subject.config.label
end

local function render(catalog: any, latest: any, spec: Table, notes: { [string]: string }): string
	local rows = { spec.headers }
	for _, subject in catalog.subjects do
		local found: { [string]: any } = {}
		local any = false
		for _, result in latest.results do
			if result.subject == subject.id and table.find(spec.suites, result.suite) then
				found[`{result.scenario}|{result.metric}`] = result
				any = true
			end
		end
		if not any then
			continue
		end
		local label = labelOf(subject)
		local row = { label }
		for _, cell in
			spec.cells(function(scenario: string, metric: string): any
				return found[`{scenario}|{metric}`]
			end)
		do
			table.insert(row, cell)
		end
		if spec.notes then
			table.insert(row, notes[label] or "")
		end
		table.insert(rows, row)
	end
	return format(rows)
end

--[=[
	The page with every marked table written again from latest.json. Errors on a marker for a
	table it doesn't know, or one that isn't closed
]=]
function BenchDocs.fill(catalog: any, latest: any, markdown: string): string
	local specs = tables(catalog)
	local out = {}
	local at = 1
	while true do
		local start, startEnd, name =
			string.find(markdown, "<!%-%- bench:table ([%w-]+) start %-%->\n", at)
		if start == nil then
			table.insert(out, string.sub(markdown, at))
			break
		end
		local spec = specs[name :: string]
		if spec == nil then
			error(
				`docs/benchmarks.md marks a table named {name}, which the bench data doesn't have`
			)
		end
		local closing = `<!-- bench:table {name} end -->`
		local stop = string.find(markdown, closing, (startEnd :: number) + 1, true)
		if stop == nil then
			error(`the {name} table in docs/benchmarks.md isn't closed with {closing}`)
		end
		local region = string.sub(markdown, (startEnd :: number) + 1, (stop :: number) - 1)
		table.insert(out, string.sub(markdown, at, startEnd :: number))
		-- Prettier keeps a blank line between a comment and a table
		table.insert(out, "\n")
		table.insert(out, render(catalog, latest, spec, existingNotes(region)))
		table.insert(out, "\n\n")
		at = stop :: number
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

return BenchDocs

--[[
    Suspension.lua
    Simple spring-damper suspension using SpringConstraint.

    Setup:
    - A wheel part connected to a chassis part via SpringConstraint.
    - Attachment0 on chassis, Attachment1 on wheel.
    - Wheel must be unanchored. A single SpringConstraint lets the wheel move
      freely in 3D space, so constrain it to vertical motion with a
      PrismaticConstraint aligned to the suspension axis. A second
      SpringConstraint does not remove degrees of freedom.

    Usage:
        local Suspension = require(path.to.Suspension)
        Suspension.new(springConstraint, {
            stiffness = 8000,
            damping = 800,
            freeLength = 2,
        })
]]

local Suspension = {}
Suspension.__index = Suspension

function Suspension.new(spring, config)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Suspension)
    self.spring = spring

    self.spring.Stiffness = config.stiffness or 5000
    self.spring.Damping = config.damping or 500
    self.spring.FreeLength = config.freeLength or 3
    self.spring.MinLength = config.minLength or 0.5
    self.spring.MaxLength = config.maxLength or config.freeLength * 2

    return self
end

return Suspension

-- Helpers for controllers that bind to UI built in Studio (ui/ui-spec.json -> ui/BuildUi.luau).
-- Missing elements only warn, so a renamed label breaks one feature, not the whole client.
--
-- UiBind.screen("Hud")                    -> ScreenGui in PlayerGui, or nil after a timeout
-- UiBind.find(root, "TimerPanel/Fill")     -> descendant by slash path, or nil (warns)
-- UiBind.pop(guiObject)                   -> short scale-in feedback (adds a "PopScale" UIScale)
-- UiBind.setFill(bar, fraction)           -> sets a fill frame's X scale, keeps its Y size
-- UiBind.formatCash(12450)                 -> "$12,450"

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

local UiBind = {}

local POP_INFO = TweenInfo.new(0.18, Enum.EasingStyle.Back, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

function UiBind.screen(name: string, timeout: number?): ScreenGui?
	local playerGui = Players.LocalPlayer:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
	local gui = playerGui:WaitForChild(name, timeout or 10)
	if not gui then
		warn(`[UiBind] PlayerGui.{name} not found: run ui/BuildUi.luau in Studio and save the place`)
	end
	return gui :: ScreenGui?
end

function UiBind.find(root: Instance?, path: string): any
	local current = root
	for part in string.gmatch(path, "[^/]+") do
		current = current and current:FindFirstChild(part)
	end
	if not current then
		warn(`[UiBind] {root and root:GetFullName() or "?"}/{path} not found`)
	end
	return current
end

function UiBind.pop(object: GuiObject?, from: number?)
	if not object then
		return
	end
	local scale = object:FindFirstChild("PopScale") :: UIScale?
	if not scale then
		local created = Instance.new("UIScale")
		created.Name = "PopScale"
		created.Parent = object
		scale = created
	end
	local popScale = scale :: UIScale
	popScale.Scale = from or 0.85
	TweenService:Create(popScale, POP_INFO, { Scale = 1 }):Play()
end

function UiBind.setFill(bar: GuiObject?, fraction: number)
	if not bar then
		return
	end
	local size = bar.Size
	bar.Size = UDim2.new(math.clamp(fraction, 0, 1), 0, size.Y.Scale, size.Y.Offset)
end

function UiBind.formatCash(amount: number): string
	local digits = tostring(math.floor(amount))
	local grouped = string.reverse((string.gsub(string.reverse(digits), "(%d%d%d)", "%1,")))
	if string.sub(grouped, 1, 1) == "," then
		grouped = string.sub(grouped, 2)
	end
	return "$" .. grouped
end

return UiBind

--!strict

-- Builds the bench data the docs site publishes from the runs in benchmarks/runs and the
-- definitions in benchmarks/catalog.json: one file per run with its results, latest.json with
-- the current results and index.json listing every run. Plain Luau like BenchResults, the
-- caller reads and writes the files

local BenchResults = require("./BenchResults")

local array = BenchResults.array

local BenchPublish = {}

BenchPublish.SCHEMA_URL = "https://qvyra.github.io/geode/data/benchmarks/schema/v1.json"
BenchPublish.SCHEMA_VERSION = 1

export type Value = { [string]: any }

export type Result = {
	suite: string,
	scenario: string,
	metric: string,
	subject: string,
	runs: { string },
	value: Value,
}

-- One thing measured once: a time, a request count, a yes or no, or a value seen
type Sample = {
	suite: string,
	scenario: string,
	metric: string,
	subject: string,
	run: string,
	-- nil for a step that failed, which is counted but has no time
	value: any,
}

local PERF_SCENARIOS = table.freeze({
	loadNew = "load-new",
	load = "load-stored",
	save = "save",
	release = "release",
})

local SUITE_OF_MODE = table.freeze({
	perf = "load-save-release",
	hold = "server-hop",
	join = "server-hop",
	throttle = "throttling",
	memory = "memory",
})

--// lookups

local function find(list: { any }, id: string): any
	for _, entry in list do
		if entry.id == id then
			return entry
		end
	end
	return nil
end

--[=[
	The subject a bench library's task belongs to, given the Geode build the run measured
]=]
function BenchPublish.subjectOf(catalog: any, benchLibrary: string, buildId: string): string
	local build = find(catalog.builds, buildId)
	if build == nil then
		error(`build {buildId} isn't in benchmarks/catalog.json`)
	end
	for _, subject in catalog.subjects do
		if
			subject.bench == benchLibrary
			and (subject.lines == nil or table.find(subject.lines, build.line))
		then
			return subject.id
		end
	end
	error(`no subject in benchmarks/catalog.json for {benchLibrary} on the {build.line} line`)
end

--[=[
	The build whose source tree matches, if the catalog has one
]=]
function BenchPublish.buildOf(catalog: any, sourceTree: string): string?
	for _, build in catalog.builds do
		if table.find(build.sourceTrees, sourceTree) then
			return build.id
		end
	end
	return nil
end

--[=[
	Adds a build to the catalog's text, at the end of its builds list, and leaves the rest of the
	file as it was. Prettier tidies the new entry
]=]
function BenchPublish.addBuild(catalogText: string, build: { [string]: any }): string
	local start = string.find(catalogText, '"builds"%s*:%s*%[')
	if start == nil then
		error("benchmarks/catalog.json has no builds list")
	end
	local at = (string.find(catalogText, "[", start, true) :: number) + 1
	local depth, inString = 1, false
	while depth > 0 do
		local char = string.sub(catalogText, at, at)
		if char == "" then
			error("benchmarks/catalog.json ends inside its builds list")
		elseif inString then
			if char == "\\" then
				at += 1
			elseif char == '"' then
				inString = false
			end
		elseif char == '"' then
			inString = true
		elseif char == "[" or char == "{" then
			depth += 1
		elseif char == "]" or char == "}" then
			depth -= 1
		end
		at += 1
	end
	-- `at` is just past the list's closing bracket. The entry goes after its last item
	local close = at - 1
	local body = string.sub(catalogText, 1, close - 1)
	local last = string.find(body, "%S%s*$") :: number
	local entry = string.gsub(BenchResults.encode(build), "\n$", "")
	local comma = if string.sub(body, last, last) == "[" then "\n" else ",\n"
	return string.sub(body, 1, last)
		.. comma
		.. entry
		.. string.sub(body, last + 1)
		.. string.sub(catalogText, close)
end

local function methodIds(catalog: any): { [string]: string }
	local ids = {}
	for _, method in catalog.requestMethods do
		ids[method.bench] = method.id
	end
	return ids
end

--// samples

local function requestsOf(step: any, ids: { [string]: string }): { [string]: number }
	local counts = {}
	for label, count in step.byMethod or {} do
		local id = ids[label]
		if id == nil then
			error(`request method {label} isn't in benchmarks/catalog.json`)
		end
		counts[id] = count
	end
	return counts
end

local function samplesOf(catalog: any, run: any): ({ Sample }, { any }, { any })
	local ids = methodIds(catalog)
	local samples: { Sample } = {}
	local notRunnable = array({})
	local problems = array({})

	for _, entry in run.tasks do
		local subject = BenchPublish.subjectOf(catalog, entry.library, run.build)
		local suite = SUITE_OF_MODE[entry.mode]
		local function add(scenario: string, metric: string, value: any)
			table.insert(samples, {
				suite = suite,
				scenario = scenario,
				metric = metric,
				subject = subject,
				run = run.run,
				value = value,
			})
		end
		local function step(scenario: string, data: any)
			if data.ok then
				add(scenario, "time", data.seconds)
				add(scenario, "requests", requestsOf(data, ids))
			else
				add(scenario, "time", nil)
			end
		end

		if entry.problem then
			table.insert(
				problems,
				{ subject = subject, mode = entry.mode, problem = entry.problem }
			)
		end
		local report = entry.report
		if report and report.notRunnable then
			table.insert(
				notRunnable,
				{ subject = subject, suite = suite, reason = report.notRunnable }
			)
		end
		local result = report and report.result
		if result == nil then
			continue
		end

		if entry.mode == "perf" then
			for _, data in result.steps do
				local scenario = PERF_SCENARIOS[data.op]
				if scenario then
					step(scenario, data)
				end
			end
		elseif entry.mode == "throttle" then
			for _, data in result.steps do
				step(data.op, data)
			end
		elseif entry.mode == "memory" then
			if result.notReadable then
				table.insert(notRunnable, {
					subject = subject,
					suite = suite,
					reason = `collectgarbage("count") failed: {result.notReadable}`,
				})
			elseif result.perProfileKb then
				add("loaded-profiles", "heap-per-profile", result.perProfileKb)
			end
		elseif entry.mode == "join" then
			for _, attempt in result.attempts do
				if attempt.step then
					step("old-releases", attempt.step)
					add("old-releases", "final-save-seen", attempt.coins == 888)
				end
			end
			local keep = result.keep
			if keep and keep.step then
				step("old-keeps", keep.step)
				add(
					"old-keeps",
					"value-seen",
					if keep.coins == nil then "none" else tostring(keep.coins)
				)
			end
		end
	end

	-- Geode's edits in Lune, timed by the runner rather than a task
	local cpu = run.lune and run.lune.cpu
	if cpu then
		local subject = BenchPublish.subjectOf(catalog, "Geode", run.build)
		if cpu.problem then
			table.insert(problems, { subject = subject, mode = "cpu", problem = cpu.problem })
		end
		for _, seconds in cpu.batches or {} do
			table.insert(samples, {
				suite = "geode-edits",
				scenario = "increment",
				metric = "time-per-edit",
				subject = subject,
				run = run.run,
				-- microseconds
				value = seconds / cpu.editsPerBatch * 1e6,
			})
		end
	end
	return samples, notRunnable, problems
end

--// values

local function round(value: number): number
	return math.round(value * 1000) / 1000
end

local function median(sorted: { number }): number
	local middle = (#sorted + 1) / 2
	if middle % 1 == 0 then
		return sorted[middle]
	end
	return (sorted[math.floor(middle)] + sorted[math.ceil(middle)]) / 2
end

local function timeValue(kind: string, values: { any }): Value
	local times = array({})
	local failed = 0
	for _, value in values do
		if value == nil or value == false then
			failed += 1
		else
			table.insert(times, value)
		end
	end
	local rounded = array({})
	for index, time in times do
		rounded[index] = round(time)
	end
	local value: Value = { kind = kind, unit = "s", n = #times, failed = failed, samples = rounded }
	if #times > 0 then
		local sorted = table.clone(times)
		table.sort(sorted)
		value.min = round(sorted[1])
		value.max = round(sorted[#sorted])
		if kind == "timing" then
			value.median = round(median(sorted))
		end
	end
	return value
end

local function requestsValue(values: { any }): Value
	local methods: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, counts in values do
		for id in counts do
			methods[id] = true
		end
	end
	local byMethod = {}
	local exact = true
	for id in methods do
		local low, high = math.huge, -math.huge
		for _, counts in values do
			local count = counts[id] or 0
			low = math.min(low, count)
			high = math.max(high, count)
		end
		byMethod[id] = { min = low, max = high }
		if low ~= high then
			exact = false
		end
	end
	return { kind = "requests", exact = exact, n = #values, byMethod = byMethod }
end

local function countValue(values: { any }): Value
	local passed = 0
	for _, value in values do
		if value then
			passed += 1
		end
	end
	return { kind = "count", passed = passed, total = #values }
end

local function valuesValue(values: { any }): Value
	local counts = {}
	for _, value in values do
		counts[value] = (counts[value] or 0) + 1
	end
	return { kind = "values", counts = counts, total = #values }
end

-- A measured quantity that isn't a time in seconds, like KB or microseconds
local function amountValue(unit: string, values: { any }): Value
	local rounded = array({})
	for index, value in values do
		rounded[index] = round(value)
	end
	local sorted = table.clone(values)
	table.sort(sorted)
	return {
		kind = "amount",
		unit = unit,
		n = #values,
		median = round(median(sorted)),
		min = round(sorted[1]),
		max = round(sorted[#sorted]),
		samples = rounded,
	}
end

local function valueOf(catalog: any, suiteId: string, metricId: string, values: { any }): Value
	local metric = find(catalog.metrics, metricId)
	if metric.kind == "amount" then
		return amountValue(metric.unit, values)
	elseif metric.kind == "timing" then
		local suite = find(catalog.suites, suiteId)
		return timeValue(suite.timeKind or "timing", values)
	elseif metric.kind == "requests" then
		return requestsValue(values)
	elseif metric.kind == "count" then
		return countValue(values)
	end
	return valuesValue(values)
end

-- Results in catalog order: suite, scenario, metric, then subject. `runsOf` says which runs each
-- subject takes, nil to leave a subject out
local function resultsOf(
	catalog: any,
	samples: { Sample },
	runsOf: (subject: string) -> { string }?
): { Result }
	local grouped: { [string]: { any } } = {}
	-- the runs that gave each result samples, which can be fewer than the subject takes when an
	-- older run didn't measure something yet
	local contributed: { [string]: { [string]: boolean } } = {}
	for _, sample in samples do
		local runs = runsOf(sample.subject)
		if runs == nil or not table.find(runs, sample.run) then
			continue
		end
		local key = `{sample.suite}|{sample.scenario}|{sample.metric}|{sample.subject}`
		local list = grouped[key]
		if list == nil then
			list = {}
			grouped[key] = list
		end
		-- a failed step's time is nil, which a list can't hold
		table.insert(list, if sample.value == nil then false else sample.value)
		contributed[key] = contributed[key] or {}
		contributed[key][sample.run] = true
	end

	local results = array({})
	for _, suite in catalog.suites do
		for _, scenario in suite.scenarios do
			for _, metric in scenario.metrics do
				for _, subject in catalog.subjects do
					local key = `{suite.id}|{scenario.id}|{metric}|{subject.id}`
					local from = contributed[key]
					if from == nil then
						continue
					end
					local runs = array({})
					for _, id in runsOf(subject.id) :: { string } do
						if from[id] then
							table.insert(runs, id)
						end
					end
					table.insert(results, {
						suite = suite.id,
						scenario = scenario.id,
						metric = metric,
						subject = subject.id,
						runs = runs,
						value = valueOf(catalog, suite.id, metric, grouped[key]),
					})
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return results
end

--// files

local function sortedRuns(runs: { any }): { any }
	local sorted = table.clone(runs)
	table.sort(sorted, function(a, b)
		return a.date < b.date
	end)
	return sorted
end

local function runRef(run: any): { [string]: any }
	return { id = run.run, date = run.date, build = run.build, data = `runs/{run.run}.json` }
end

local function without(entry: { [string]: any }, fields: { string }): { [string]: any }
	local copy = table.clone(entry)
	for _, field in fields do
		copy[field] = nil
	end
	return copy
end

--[=[
	One run's published file: its normalized results, in the same shape as latest.json's, and the
	cleaned raw tasks they came from
]=]
function BenchPublish.runFile(catalog: any, run: any): { [string]: any }
	local samples, notRunnable, problems = samplesOf(catalog, run)
	local only = array({ run.run })
	local tasks = array({})
	for _, entry in run.tasks do
		local copy = table.clone(entry)
		copy.subject = BenchPublish.subjectOf(catalog, entry.library, run.build)
		table.insert(tasks, copy)
	end
	return {
		["$schema"] = BenchPublish.SCHEMA_URL,
		schemaVersion = BenchPublish.SCHEMA_VERSION,
		kind = "run",
		id = run.run,
		date = run.date,
		build = run.build,
		geode = { sourceTree = run.geodeSourceTree },
		bench = { tree = run.benchTree, workflowRun = run.workflowRun },
		libraries = run.libraries,
		refused = run.refused,
		results = resultsOf(catalog, samples, function()
			return only
		end),
		notRunnable = notRunnable,
		problems = problems,
		tasks = tasks,
		lune = run.lune,
	}
end

-- The runs each subject takes for latest.json. Current subjects share the last runs of the
-- current subject's lines, a historical one keeps the last runs of its own
local function chosenRuns(catalog: any, runs: { any }): { [string]: { string } }
	local limit = catalog.currentRuns
	local lineOf: { [string]: string } = {}
	for _, build in catalog.builds do
		lineOf[build.id] = build.line
	end
	local function last(lines: { string }?): { string }
		local picked = {}
		for _, run in runs do
			if lines == nil or table.find(lines, lineOf[run.build]) then
				table.insert(picked, run.run)
			end
		end
		return table.move(picked, math.max(1, #picked - limit + 1), #picked, 1, {})
	end

	local current = find(catalog.subjects, catalog.current)
	local shared = last(current.lines)
	local chosen = {}
	for _, subject in catalog.subjects do
		chosen[subject.id] = if subject.historical then last(subject.lines) else shared
	end
	return chosen
end

--[=[
	latest.json: the catalog's definitions, the current results and the runs they came from
]=]
function BenchPublish.latest(catalog: any, runs: { any }): { [string]: any }
	local sorted = sortedRuns(runs)
	local chosen = chosenRuns(catalog, sorted)
	local samples = {}
	for _, run in sorted do
		local found = samplesOf(catalog, run)
		table.move(found, 1, #found, #samples + 1, samples)
	end
	-- a suite marked recordedOnly stays in the run files, but its numbers aren't steady enough to
	-- stand as the current ones
	local recordedOnly: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, suite in catalog.suites do
		recordedOnly[suite.id] = suite.recordedOnly == true
	end
	local results = array({})
	for _, result in
		resultsOf(catalog, samples, function(subject: string)
			return chosen[subject]
		end)
	do
		if not recordedOnly[result.suite] then
			table.insert(results, result)
		end
	end

	local used: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, result in results do
		for _, id in result.runs do
			used[id] = true
		end
	end
	local refs = array({})
	for _, run in sorted do
		if used[run.run] then
			table.insert(refs, runRef(run))
		end
	end

	local suites = array({})
	for _, suite in catalog.suites do
		table.insert(suites, without(suite, { "timeKind" }))
	end
	local methods = array({})
	for _, method in catalog.requestMethods do
		table.insert(methods, without(method, { "bench" }))
	end
	local subjects = array({})
	for _, subject in catalog.subjects do
		table.insert(subjects, without(subject, { "bench", "docsLabel" }))
	end

	return {
		["$schema"] = BenchPublish.SCHEMA_URL,
		schemaVersion = BenchPublish.SCHEMA_VERSION,
		kind = "latest",
		updatedAt = if #sorted > 0 then sorted[#sorted].date else nil,
		aggregation = {
			currentRuns = catalog.currentRuns,
			rule = catalog.rule,
			caveat = catalog.caveat,
		},
		suites = suites,
		metrics = catalog.metrics,
		requestMethods = methods,
		lines = catalog.lines,
		builds = catalog.builds,
		subjects = subjects,
		runs = refs,
		results = results,
		notMeasured = catalog.notMeasured,
	}
end

--[=[
	index.json: every run, oldest first
]=]
function BenchPublish.index(runs: { any }): { [string]: any }
	local refs = array({})
	for _, run in sortedRuns(runs) do
		table.insert(refs, runRef(run))
	end
	return {
		["$schema"] = BenchPublish.SCHEMA_URL,
		schemaVersion = BenchPublish.SCHEMA_VERSION,
		kind = "index",
		updatedAt = if #refs > 0 then refs[#refs].date else nil,
		latest = "latest.json",
		runs = refs,
	}
end

--[=[
	Every published file by its path under data/benchmarks, encoded
]=]
function BenchPublish.files(catalog: any, runs: { any }, schema: string): { [string]: string }
	local files = {
		["latest.json"] = BenchResults.encode(BenchPublish.latest(catalog, runs)),
		["index.json"] = BenchResults.encode(BenchPublish.index(runs)),
		["schema/v1.json"] = schema,
	}
	for _, run in runs do
		files[`runs/{run.run}.json`] = BenchResults.encode(BenchPublish.runFile(catalog, run))
	end
	return files
end

return BenchPublish

--[[
    VehicleController.lua
    A client-authoritative vehicle chassis with server-side validation.

    Setup:
    - Four wheels as cylinders or spheres, each connected to the chassis via
      HingeConstraints or bearings (do not rigidly weld drive wheels).
    - Two HingeConstraints for front wheels (steering).
    - Two HingeConstraints for drive wheels with Motor actuator.
    - A VehicleSeat parented to the chassis.

    Usage:
        local VehicleController = require(path.to.VehicleController)
        local controller = VehicleController.new(vehicleModel)
        controller:destroy() -- call when the vehicle is removed
]]

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local VehicleController = {}
VehicleController.__index = VehicleController

export type VehicleControllerConfig = {
    maxSpeed: number?,
    turnAngle: number?,
    wheelRadius: number?,
    motorMaxTorque: number?,
    motorMaxAcceleration: number?,
    servoMaxTorque: number?,
    angularSpeed: number?,
}

type VehicleControllerState = {
    model: Model,
    seat: VehicleSeat,
    maxSpeed: number,
    turnAngle: number,
    wheelRadius: number,
    driveMotors: { HingeConstraint },
    steerHinges: { HingeConstraint },
    heartbeatConnection: RBXScriptConnection?,
    validationConnection: RBXScriptConnection?,
    occupantConnection: RBXScriptConnection?,
}

export type VehicleController =
    typeof(setmetatable({} :: VehicleControllerState, VehicleController))

function VehicleController.new(model: Model, config: VehicleControllerConfig?): VehicleController
    local resolvedConfig: VehicleControllerConfig = config or {}
    local self = setmetatable(
        {
            model = model,
            seat = model:WaitForChild("VehicleSeat") :: VehicleSeat,
            maxSpeed = resolvedConfig.maxSpeed or 50,
            turnAngle = resolvedConfig.turnAngle or 30,
            wheelRadius = resolvedConfig.wheelRadius or 2,
            driveMotors = {} :: { HingeConstraint },
            steerHinges = {} :: { HingeConstraint },
            heartbeatConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
            validationConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
            occupantConnection = nil :: RBXScriptConnection?,
        } :: VehicleControllerState,
        VehicleController
    )

    for _, obj in ipairs(model:GetDescendants()) do
        if obj:IsA("HingeConstraint") then
            if obj.Name == "DriveMotor" then
                obj.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Motor
                obj.MotorMaxTorque = resolvedConfig.motorMaxTorque or 5000
                obj.MotorMaxAcceleration = resolvedConfig.motorMaxAcceleration or 1500
                table.insert(self.driveMotors, obj)
            elseif obj.Name == "SteerHinge" then
                obj.ActuatorType = Enum.ActuatorType.Servo
                obj.ServoMaxTorque = resolvedConfig.servoMaxTorque or 5000
                obj.AngularSpeed = resolvedConfig.angularSpeed or 3
                table.insert(self.steerHinges, obj)
            end
        end
    end

    self:setupOwnership()
    self:startLoop()

    return self
end

function VehicleController.setupOwnership(self: VehicleController)
    self.occupantConnection = self.seat:GetPropertyChangedSignal("Occupant"):Connect(function()
        local humanoid = self.seat.Occupant
        if humanoid then
            local player = Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(humanoid.Parent)
            if player then
                self.seat:SetNetworkOwner(player)
            end
        else
            self.seat:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto()
        end
    end)
end

function VehicleController.validateState(self: VehicleController)
    if not self.seat:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
        return
    end

    local assemblyMass = self.seat.AssemblyMass
    if assemblyMass == math.huge then
        return
    end

    -- Simple server-side sanity check: if the client-owned assembly moves
    -- much faster than the configured limit, revoke ownership to stop exploits.
    local speed = self.seat.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Magnitude
    if speed > self.maxSpeed * 1.5 then
        self.seat:SetNetworkOwnershipAuto()
        for _, motor in ipairs(self.driveMotors) do
            motor.AngularVelocity = 0
        end
    end
end

function VehicleController.startLoop(self: VehicleController)
    self.heartbeatConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not self.seat:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
            self:destroy()
            return
        end

        local steer = math.clamp(self.seat.Steer, -1, 1)
        local throttle = math.clamp(self.seat.Throttle, -1, 1)

        local targetAngle = -steer * self.turnAngle
        for _, hinge in ipairs(self.steerHinges) do
            hinge.TargetAngle = targetAngle
        end

        -- Convert linear speed (studs/s) to angular velocity (rad/s).
        local targetLinearVelocity = throttle * self.maxSpeed
        local targetAngularVelocity = targetLinearVelocity / self.wheelRadius
        for _, motor in ipairs(self.driveMotors) do
            motor.AngularVelocity = targetAngularVelocity
        end
    end)

    self.validationConnection = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        self:validateState()
    end)
end

function VehicleController.destroy(self: VehicleController)
    if self.heartbeatConnection then
        self.heartbeatConnection:Disconnect()
        self.heartbeatConnection = nil
    end
    if self.validationConnection then
        self.validationConnection:Disconnect()
        self.validationConnection = nil
    end
    if self.occupantConnection then
        self.occupantConnection:Disconnect()
        self.occupantConnection = nil
    end

    for _, motor in ipairs(self.driveMotors) do
        motor.AngularVelocity = 0
    end
    for _, hinge in ipairs(self.steerHinges) do
        hinge.TargetAngle = 0
    end
end

return VehicleController

--!strict

--[[
TeleportHelper.lua

Reserved-server allocation publishes a candidate through UpdateAsync and every
allocator uses the winning record. Teleport initiation and destination arrival
are tracked separately. A successful TeleportAsync call only means initiation;
the destination must call markReservedServerArrival().
]]

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local TeleportService = game:GetService("TeleportService")

local ALLOCATION_LIFETIME_SECONDS = 60 * 60
local MAX_MATCH_ID_LENGTH = 20
local reservedServers = DataStoreService:GetDataStore("ReservedServerAllocations_v3")

export type TeleportData = { [string]: any }
export type AllocationState = "allocated" | "teleporting" | "arrived"
export type AllocationRecord = {
    allocationId: string,
    reservedServerId: string,
    placeId: number,
    matchId: string,
    state: AllocationState,
    createdAt: number,
    expiresAt: number,
    destinationJobId: string?,
}
export type ReservedTeleportState = "failed" | "allocated" | "teleport_started"
export type ReservedTeleportResult = {
    state: ReservedTeleportState,
    allocation: AllocationRecord?,
    error: any?,
}

local TeleportHelper = {}

local function allocationKey(placeId: number, matchId: string): string
    return `reserved_{placeId}_{matchId}`
end

local function validateReservedRequest(
    players: { Player },
    placeId: number,
    matchId: string
): string?
    if placeId ~= placeId or placeId == math.huge or placeId % 1 ~= 0 or placeId <= 0 then
        return "placeId must be a positive finite integer"
    end
    if matchId == "" or #matchId > MAX_MATCH_ID_LENGTH then
        return `matchId must contain 1-{MAX_MATCH_ID_LENGTH} bytes`
    end
    if #players == 0 or #players > 50 then
        return "reserved teleports require 1-50 players"
    end
    local seenUserIds: { [number]: boolean } = {}
    for _, player in players do
        if typeof(player) ~= "Instance" or not player:IsA("Player") or player.Parent ~= Players then
            return "every player must be a current Players member"
        end
        if seenUserIds[player.UserId] then
            return "players must not contain duplicates"
        end
        seenUserIds[player.UserId] = true
    end
    return nil
end

local function makeOptions(teleportData: TeleportData?): TeleportOptions
    local options = Instance.new("TeleportOptions")
    if teleportData ~= nil then
        options:SetTeleportData(teleportData)
    end
    return options
end

local function teleport(
    players: { Player },
    placeId: number,
    options: TeleportOptions?
): (boolean, any?)
    local ok, response = pcall(function()
        return TeleportService:TeleportAsync(placeId, players, options)
    end)
    if not ok then
        warn("TeleportHelper: TeleportAsync failed:", tostring(response))
        return false, response
    end
    return true, response
end

local function isAllocation(value: any): boolean
    return type(value) == "table"
        and type(value.allocationId) == "string"
        and type(value.reservedServerId) == "string"
        and type(value.expiresAt) == "number"
end

local function freshAllocation(key: string): AllocationRecord?
    local getOptions = Instance.new("DataStoreGetOptions")
    getOptions.UseCache = false
    local ok, value = pcall(function()
        return reservedServers:GetAsync(key, getOptions)
    end)
    if ok and isAllocation(value) then
        return value :: AllocationRecord
    end
    return nil
end

function TeleportHelper._selectAllocation(
    current: any,
    candidate: AllocationRecord,
    now: number
): AllocationRecord
    if isAllocation(current) and (current :: AllocationRecord).expiresAt > now then
        return current :: AllocationRecord
    end
    return candidate
end

local function allocate(placeId: number, matchId: string): (AllocationRecord?, any?)
    local now = os.time()
    local candidate: AllocationRecord = {
        allocationId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
        reservedServerId = HttpService:GenerateGUID(false),
        placeId = placeId,
        matchId = matchId,
        state = "allocated",
        createdAt = now,
        expiresAt = now + ALLOCATION_LIFETIME_SECONDS,
        destinationJobId = nil,
    }
    local key = allocationKey(placeId, matchId)
    local publishOk, winner = pcall(function()
        return reservedServers:UpdateAsync(key, function(current: any): AllocationRecord?
            return TeleportHelper._selectAllocation(current, candidate, now)
        end)
    end)
    if publishOk and isAllocation(winner) then
        return winner :: AllocationRecord, nil
    end

    -- UpdateAsync failures can be ambiguous. Read without cache and use the
    -- backend winner rather than reserving/publishing another ID.
    local reconciled = freshAllocation(key)
    if reconciled and reconciled.expiresAt > now then
        return reconciled, nil
    end
    return nil, winner
end

local function updateState(
    allocation: AllocationRecord,
    state: AllocationState,
    destinationJobId: string?
): (AllocationRecord?, any?)
    local key = allocationKey(allocation.placeId, allocation.matchId)
    local ok, updated = pcall(function()
        return reservedServers:UpdateAsync(key, function(current: any): AllocationRecord?
            if not isAllocation(current) then
                return nil
            end
            local record = current :: AllocationRecord
            if record.allocationId ~= allocation.allocationId then
                return nil
            end
            record.state = state
            record.destinationJobId = destinationJobId
            return record
        end)
    end)
    if ok and isAllocation(updated) then
        return updated :: AllocationRecord, nil
    end

    local reconciled = freshAllocation(key)
    if
        reconciled
        and reconciled.allocationId == allocation.allocationId
        and reconciled.state == state
    then
        return reconciled, nil
    end
    return nil, updated
end

function TeleportHelper.teleportToPlace(
    player: Player,
    placeId: number,
    teleportData: TeleportData?
): boolean
    local optionsOk, options = pcall(makeOptions, teleportData)
    if not optionsOk then
        warn("TeleportHelper: invalid teleport data:", tostring(options))
        return false
    end
    local ok = teleport({ player }, placeId, options)
    return ok
end

function TeleportHelper.teleportToServer(
    player: Player,
    placeId: number,
    jobId: string,
    teleportData: TeleportData?
): boolean
    local optionsOk, options = pcall(makeOptions, teleportData)
    if not optionsOk then
        warn("TeleportHelper: invalid teleport data:", tostring(options))
        return false
    end
    options.ServerInstanceId = jobId
    local ok = teleport({ player }, placeId, options)
    return ok
end

function TeleportHelper.teleportToReservedServer(
    players: { Player },
    placeId: number,
    matchId: string,
    teleportData: TeleportData?
): (boolean, ReservedTeleportResult)
    local validationError = validateReservedRequest(players, placeId, matchId)
    if validationError then
        return false, { state = "failed", allocation = nil, error = validationError }
    end

    local allocation, allocationError = allocate(placeId, matchId)
    if not allocation then
        return false, { state = "failed", allocation = nil, error = allocationError }
    end

    local trackingRecord, trackingError = updateState(allocation, "teleporting", nil)
    if not trackingRecord then
        return false, { state = "allocated", allocation = allocation, error = trackingError }
    end

    local data: TeleportData = {}
    if teleportData then
        for key, value in teleportData do
            data[key] = value
        end
    end
    data.reservedAllocationId = trackingRecord.allocationId
    data.reservedMatchId = matchId

    local optionsOk, options = pcall(makeOptions, data)
    if not optionsOk then
        return false, { state = "allocated", allocation = trackingRecord, error = options }
    end
    options.ReservedServerId = trackingRecord.reservedServerId
    local started, teleportError = teleport(players, placeId, options)
    if not started then
        return false, { state = "allocated", allocation = trackingRecord, error = teleportError }
    end
    return true, { state = "teleport_started", allocation = trackingRecord, error = nil }
end

function TeleportHelper.markReservedServerArrival(
    placeId: number,
    matchId: string,
    allocationId: string
): (boolean, AllocationRecord?)
    local current = freshAllocation(allocationKey(placeId, matchId))
    if not current or current.allocationId ~= allocationId then
        return false, nil
    end
    local updated = updateState(current, "arrived", game.JobId)
    return updated ~= nil, updated
end

return TeleportHelper

--!strict

-- Turns what `lune run bench` saves into the bench data kept in benchmarks/. Plain Luau with no
-- Lune requires, so the tests can run it: the caller decodes and writes the files

local BenchResults = {}

export type RunInfo = {
	build: string,
	sourceTree: string,
	benchTree: string,
	workflowRun: string?,
}

--// JSON

-- Marks a table that has to come out as a JSON array even when it's empty
local ARRAY = table.freeze({ __array = true })

--[=[
	Marks a list so `encode` writes it as an array even when it's empty
]=]
function BenchResults.array<T>(list: { T }): { T }
	return setmetatable(list :: any, ARRAY) :: any
end

-- Keys that read best first. Everything else follows in alphabetical order
local KEY_ORDER = {
	"$schema",
	"schemaVersion",
	"kind",
	"id",
	"run",
	"date",
	"build",
	"suite",
	"scenario",
	"metric",
	"subject",
	"runs",
	"value",
}
local KEY_RANK: { [string]: number } = {}
for rank, key in KEY_ORDER do
	KEY_RANK[key] = rank
end

local function before(a: string, b: string): boolean
	local rankA, rankB = KEY_RANK[a], KEY_RANK[b]
	if rankA and rankB then
		return rankA < rankB
	elseif rankA or rankB then
		return rankA ~= nil
	end
	return a < b
end

local ESCAPES: { [string]: string } = {
	['"'] = '\\"',
	["\\"] = "\\\\",
	["\b"] = "\\b",
	["\f"] = "\\f",
	["\n"] = "\\n",
	["\r"] = "\\r",
	["\t"] = "\\t",
}

local function quote(text: string): string
	local escaped = string.gsub(text, '[%c"\\]', function(char: string): string
		return ESCAPES[char] or string.format("\\u%04x", string.byte(char))
	end)
	return `"{escaped}"`
end

-- The shortest text that reads back as the same number, so files don't change between runs of
-- the same data
local function number(value: number): string
	if value ~= value or value == math.huge or value == -math.huge then
		error("JSON has no NaN or infinity")
	end
	if value == math.floor(value) and math.abs(value) < 2 ^ 53 then
		return string.format("%d", value)
	end
	for precision = 15, 16 do
		local text = string.format("%." .. precision .. "g", value)
		if tonumber(text) == value then
			return text
		end
	end
	return string.format("%.17g", value)
end

local function isArray(value: { [any]: any }): boolean
	if getmetatable(value :: any) == ARRAY then
		return true
	end
	local count = 0
	for key in value do
		if type(key) ~= "number" then
			return false
		end
		count += 1
	end
	return count > 0 and count == #value
end

local function write(value: unknown, indent: string, out: { string })
	local kind = type(value)
	if kind == "string" then
		table.insert(out, quote(value :: string))
	elseif kind == "number" then
		table.insert(out, number(value :: number))
	elseif kind == "boolean" then
		table.insert(out, if value then "true" else "false")
	elseif kind == "nil" then
		table.insert(out, "null")
	elseif kind == "table" then
		local tbl = value :: { [any]: any }
		local inner = indent .. "\t"
		if isArray(tbl) then
			if #tbl == 0 then
				table.insert(out, "[]")
				return
			end
			local flat = true
			for _, item in ipairs(tbl) do
				if type(item) == "table" then
					flat = false
					break
				end
			end
			-- lists of plain values stay on one line, which keeps samples and timelines short
			if flat then
				table.insert(out, "[")
				for index, item in ipairs(tbl) do
					if index > 1 then
						table.insert(out, ", ")
					end
					write(item, inner, out)
				end
				table.insert(out, "]")
				return
			end
			table.insert(out, "[\n")
			for index, item in ipairs(tbl) do
				table.insert(out, inner)
				write(item, inner, out)
				table.insert(out, if index < #tbl then ",\n" else "\n")
			end
			table.insert(out, indent .. "]")
			return
		end
		local keys: { string } = {}
		for key in tbl do
			if type(key) ~= "string" then
				error(`a JSON object can only have string keys, found a {type(key)}`)
			end
			table.insert(keys, key)
		end
		if #keys == 0 then
			table.insert(out, "{}")
			return
		end
		table.sort(keys, before)
		table.insert(out, "{\n")
		for index, key in keys do
			table.insert(out, `{inner}{quote(key)}: `)
			write(tbl[key], inner, out)
			table.insert(out, if index < #keys then ",\n" else "\n")
		end
		table.insert(out, indent .. "}")
	else
		error(`JSON can't hold a {kind}`)
	end
end

--[=[
	Encodes a value as JSON with tabs, keys in a fixed order and numbers in their shortest exact
	form, so the same data always gives the same file
]=]
function BenchResults.encode(value: unknown): string
	local out = {}
	write(value, "", out)
	table.insert(out, "\n")
	return table.concat(out)
end

-- Lune's JSON decoder can be one bit off on the last digit of a float, so runs are read here with
-- tonumber, which rounds correctly, and a re-encoded run matches what the bench wrote
local function decodeAt(text: string, at: number): (unknown, number)
	at = string.find(text, "[^ \t\r\n]", at) or error("JSON ended early")
	local char = string.sub(text, at, at)
	if char == "{" then
		local object: { [string]: unknown } = {}
		at = string.find(text, "[^ \t\r\n]", at + 1) or error("JSON ended early")
		if string.sub(text, at, at) == "}" then
			return object, at + 1
		end
		while true do
			local key, value
			key, at = decodeAt(text, at)
			if type(key) ~= "string" then
				error(`expected a key at {at}`)
			end
			at = string.find(text, ":", at, true) or error(`expected : at {at}`)
			value, at = decodeAt(text, at + 1)
			object[key :: string] = value
			at = string.find(text, "[^ \t\r\n]", at) or error("JSON ended early")
			local after = string.sub(text, at, at)
			if after == "}" then
				return object, at + 1
			elseif after ~= "," then
				error(`expected , or }} at {at}`)
			end
			at += 1
		end
	elseif char == "[" then
		local list = BenchResults.array({})
		at = string.find(text, "[^ \t\r\n]", at + 1) or error("JSON ended early")
		if string.sub(text, at, at) == "]" then
			return list, at + 1
		end
		while true do
			local value
			value, at = decodeAt(text, at)
			if value == nil then
				error(`null inside a list at {at}`)
			end
			table.insert(list, value)
			at = string.find(text, "[^ \t\r\n]", at) or error("JSON ended early")
			local after = string.sub(text, at, at)
			if after == "]" then
				return list, at + 1
			elseif after ~= "," then
				error(`expected , or ] at {at}`)
			end
			at += 1
		end
	elseif char == '"' then
		local parts = {}
		local from = at + 1
		while true do
			local stop = string.find(text, '["\\]', from) or error("unfinished string")
			table.insert(parts, string.sub(text, from, stop - 1))
			if string.sub(text, stop, stop) == '"' then
				return table.concat(parts), stop + 1
			end
			local escape = string.sub(text, stop + 1, stop + 1)
			if escape == "u" then
				local code = tonumber(string.sub(text, stop + 2, stop + 5), 16) or error("bad \\u")
				from = stop + 6
				if
					code >= 0xD800
					and code <= 0xDBFF
					and string.sub(text, from, from + 1) == "\\u"
				then
					local low = tonumber(string.sub(text, from + 2, from + 5), 16)
						or error("bad \\u")
					code = 0x10000 + (code - 0xD800) * 0x400 + (low - 0xDC00)
					from += 6
				end
				table.insert(parts, utf8.char(code))
			else
				local plain = ({ b = "\b", f = "\f", n = "\n", r = "\r", t = "\t" })[escape]
				table.insert(parts, plain or escape)
				from = stop + 2
			end
		end
	elseif string.sub(text, at, at + 3) == "true" then
		return true, at + 4
	elseif string.sub(text, at, at + 4) == "false" then
		return false, at + 5
	elseif string.sub(text, at, at + 3) == "null" then
		return nil, at + 4
	end
	local literal = string.match(text, "^-?%d+%.?%d*[eE]?[-+]?%d*", at)
	local value = literal and tonumber(literal)
	if value == nil then
		error(`unexpected {char} at {at}`)
	end
	return value, at + #(literal :: string)
end

--[=[
	Decodes JSON with every number exactly as written. Lists come back marked as lists, so an empty
	one is written back as `[]`
]=]
function BenchResults.decode(text: string): any
	local value, at = decodeAt(text, 1)
	if string.find(text, "[^ \t\r\n]", at) then
		error(`more after the JSON value at {at}`)
	end
	return value
end

--// cleaning a run

-- Fields that only identify the place, the server or a key. None of them is a measurement
local DROPPED = table.freeze({
	jobId = true,
	placeId = true,
	placeVersion = true,
	universeId = true,
	key = true,
	topic = true,
})

local UUID = "%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%-%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x%x"

-- Ids that turn up inside messages: JobIds, and place or universe ids, which are long numbers
local function scrub(text: string): string
	local withoutJobs = string.gsub(text, UUID, "<job>")
	local withoutIds = string.gsub(withoutJobs, "%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d%d+", "<id>")
	return withoutIds
end

local function clean(value: unknown): unknown
	if type(value) == "string" then
		return scrub(value)
	elseif type(value) ~= "table" then
		return value
	end
	local copy = {}
	for key, child in value :: { [any]: any } do
		if type(key) == "string" and DROPPED[key] then
			continue
		end
		copy[key] = clean(child)
	end
	if getmetatable(value :: any) == ARRAY then
		setmetatable(copy, ARRAY :: any)
	end
	return copy
end

--[=[
	Cleans one bench run for keeping in the repo. Drops the place version, JobIds, place ids, keys
	and messaging topics, and blanks ids inside messages. Whether each task had a server to itself
	is kept as `environment.ownServer`. Every measurement stays as the bench saved it
]=]
function BenchResults.sanitize(results: any, info: RunInfo): { [string]: any }
	local seen: { [string]: number } = {}
	for _, entry in results.tasks do
		local jobId = entry.report and entry.report.environment and entry.report.environment.jobId
		if jobId then
			seen[jobId] = (seen[jobId] or 0) + 1
		end
	end

	local tasks = BenchResults.array({})
	for _, entry in results.tasks do
		local copy = clean(entry) :: { [string]: any }
		local environment = entry.report and entry.report.environment
		if environment and environment.jobId then
			copy.report.environment.ownServer = seen[environment.jobId] == 1
		end
		if copy.logTail and next(copy.logTail) == nil then
			copy.logTail = nil
		end
		table.insert(tasks, copy)
	end

	return {
		run = results.run,
		date = results.date,
		build = info.build,
		geodeSourceTree = info.sourceTree,
		benchTree = info.benchTree,
		workflowRun = info.workflowRun,
		libraries = clean(results.pins),
		lune = clean(results.lune),
		refused = clean(results.refused),
		tasks = tasks,
	}
end

return BenchResults

-- Small server helpers for checking a player's character.
--
-- PlayerUtil.getRoot(player)           -> HumanoidRootPart of a living character, or nil
-- PlayerUtil.isNear(player, target, d) -> true if the living character is within d studs of target

local PlayerUtil = {}

function PlayerUtil.getRoot(player: Player): BasePart?
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = character and character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if humanoid and humanoid.Health > 0 and root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
		return root
	end
	return nil
end

function PlayerUtil.isNear(player: Player, target: Instance, distance: number): boolean
	local root = PlayerUtil.getRoot(player)
	if not root then
		return false
	end
	local position = if target:IsA("BasePart")
		then target.Position
		elseif target:IsA("Model") then target:GetPivot().Position
		else nil
	if not position then
		return false
	end
	return (root.Position - position).Magnitude <= distance
end

return PlayerUtil
