--!strict

-- The Open Cloud calls the live runners share: building a place with Rojo, uploading it to the
-- test place as a saved version and running Luau Execution tasks against that version. The API
-- key comes from ROBLOX_API_KEY and never shows up in output or errors

local fs = require("@lune/fs")
local net = require("@lune/net")
local process = require("@lune/process")
local serde = require("@lune/serde")
local stdio = require("@lune/stdio")
local task = require("@lune/task")

export type Config = {
	universeId: number,
	placeId: number,
}

-- What a Luau Execution task looks like in the API's answers. Only the fields the runners read
export type Task = {
	path: string,
	state: string,
	output: { results: { unknown }? }?,
	error: { message: string? }?,
}

export type Finished = {
	task: Task,
	logs: { string },
	-- the first value the task's script returned, when it returned a string
	result: string?,
	-- set when the task didn't complete
	problem: string?,
}

export type Client = {
	fail: (message: string) -> never,
	config: Config,
	call: (
		method: "GET" | "POST",
		path: string,
		body: (string | buffer)?,
		contentType: string?
	) -> any,
	build: (projectPath: string, placePath: string) -> (),
	upload: (placePath: string) -> number,
	startTask: (version: number, script: string, timeout: number) -> Task,
	tryStartTask: (version: number, script: string, timeout: number) -> (Task?, string?),
	finishTask: (started: Task, waitLimit: number) -> Finished,
}

local CONFIG_PATH = "tests/studio/live.json"
local API = "https://apis.roblox.com"
local POLL_INTERVAL = 5

local OpenCloud = {}

-- A task can't run longer than this, Roblox stops it
OpenCloud.TASK_LIMIT = 300

--[=[
	Makes a client for the test place in tests/studio/live.json. `label` starts every error
	message, so the output says which runner failed
]=]
function OpenCloud.client(label: string): Client
	local function fail(message: string): never
		stdio.ewrite(`{label}: {message}\n`)
		process.exit(1)
		error("unreachable")
	end

	local key = process.env.ROBLOX_API_KEY
	if key == nil or key == "" then
		fail("ROBLOX_API_KEY isn't set")
	end

	if not fs.isFile(CONFIG_PATH) then
		fail(`{CONFIG_PATH} is missing`)
	end
	local config = serde.decode("json", fs.readFile(CONFIG_PATH))
	if type(config.universeId) ~= "number" or type(config.placeId) ~= "number" then
		fail(`{CONFIG_PATH} needs a numeric universeId and placeId`)
	end

	-- Sends a request with the key. Answers true and the decoded JSON body, or false and a message
	-- naming the call and status, never the key
	local function send(
		method: "GET" | "POST",
		path: string,
		body: (string | buffer)?,
		contentType: string?
	): (boolean, any)
		local headers: { [string]: string } = {
			["x-api-key"] = key :: string,
			["content-type"] = contentType or "application/json",
		}
		local response = net.request({
			url = API .. path,
			-- Lune's typings want their own method union, this narrower one fits at runtime
			method = method :: any,
			headers = headers,
			body = body,
		})
		if not response.ok then
			return false,
				`{method} {path} answered {response.statusCode} {response.statusMessage}: {response.body}`
		end
		if response.body == "" then
			return true, nil
		end
		return true, serde.decode("json", response.body)
	end

	local function call(
		method: "GET" | "POST",
		path: string,
		body: (string | buffer)?,
		contentType: string?
	): any
		local ok, answer = send(method, path, body, contentType)
		if not ok then
			fail(answer)
		end
		return answer
	end

	local function build(projectPath: string, placePath: string)
		local folder = string.match(placePath, "^(.*)/[^/]+$")
		if folder and not fs.isDir(folder) then
			fs.writeDir(folder)
		end
		local result = process.exec("rojo", { "build", projectPath, "--output", placePath })
		if not result.ok then
			fail(`rojo build failed: {result.stderr}`)
		end
	end

	local function upload(placePath: string): number
		local answer = call(
			"POST",
			`/universes/v1/{config.universeId}/places/{config.placeId}/versions?versionType=Saved`,
			fs.readFile(placePath),
			"application/octet-stream"
		)
		local version = answer and answer.versionNumber
		if type(version) ~= "number" then
			fail("the upload didn't return a version number")
		end
		return version
	end

	local function taskPath(version: number): string
		return `/cloud/v2/universes/{config.universeId}/places/{config.placeId}/versions/{version}/luau-execution-session-tasks`
	end

	local function startTask(version: number, script: string, timeout: number): Task
		return call(
			"POST",
			taskPath(version),
			serde.encode("json", { script = script, timeout = `{timeout}s` })
		)
	end

	-- Like startTask, but a refusal comes back as a message instead of ending the run
	local function tryStartTask(version: number, script: string, timeout: number): (Task?, string?)
		local ok, answer = send(
			"POST",
			taskPath(version),
			serde.encode("json", { script = script, timeout = `{timeout}s` })
		)
		if not ok then
			return nil, answer
		end
		return answer, nil
	end

	-- Polls until the task is done or `waitLimit` seconds pass, then fetches its logs
	local function finishTask(started: Task, waitLimit: number): Finished
		local path = started.path
		local begun = os.clock()
		local current = started
		while
			current.state ~= "COMPLETE"
			and current.state ~= "FAILED"
			and current.state ~= "CANCELLED"
		do
			if os.clock() - begun > waitLimit then
				return {
					task = current,
					logs = {},
					result = nil,
					problem = `didn't finish within {waitLimit} seconds`,
				}
			end
			task.wait(POLL_INTERVAL)
			current = call("GET", `/cloud/v2/{path}`)
		end

		local lines = {}
		local logs = call("GET", `/cloud/v2/{path}/logs`)
		for _, chunk in logs and logs.luauExecutionSessionTaskLogs or {} do
			for _, line in chunk.messages or {} do
				table.insert(lines, line)
			end
		end

		if current.state ~= "COMPLETE" then
			local reason = current.error and current.error.message or current.state
			return {
				task = current,
				logs = lines,
				result = nil,
				problem = `ended {current.state}: {reason}`,
			}
		end
		local results = current.output and current.output.results
		local first = if type(results) == "table" then results[1] else nil
		return {
			task = current,
			logs = lines,
			result = if type(first) == "string" then first else nil,
			problem = nil,
		}
	end

	return {
		fail = fail,
		config = config :: Config,
		call = call,
		build = build,
		upload = upload,
		startTask = startTask,
		tryStartTask = tryStartTask,
		finishTask = finishTask,
	}
end

return OpenCloud

-- Status: experimental
-- Last verified: 2026-06-17
-- Test coverage: no automated coverage
-- Intended use: example; adapt and test before production.

--[[
    DebugDraw.lua
    Utility for drawing temporary debug visuals in the 3D world.

    Usage:
        local DebugDraw = require(path.to.DebugDraw)
        DebugDraw.point(workspace, Vector3.new(0, 10, 0), Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0), 2)
        DebugDraw.ray(workspace, origin, direction, Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0), 2)
        DebugDraw.box(workspace, cframe, size, Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255), 2)

        DebugDraw.clear() -- removes all tracked debug parts
]]

local DebugDraw = {}

local registry = {}

local function validateParent(parent)
    assert(typeof(parent) == "Instance", "parent must be an Instance")
end

local function createBase()
    local part = Instance.new("Part")
    part.Anchored = true
    part.CanCollide = false
    part.CanQuery = false
    part.CanTouch = false
    part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
    return part
end

local function track(part, lifetime)
    table.insert(registry, part)

    if lifetime then
        task.delay(lifetime, function()
            if part.Parent ~= nil then
                part:Destroy()
            end
            for i = #registry, 1, -1 do
                if registry[i] == part then
                    table.remove(registry, i)
                    break
                end
            end
        end)
    end
end

function DebugDraw.point(parent, position, color, lifetime)
    validateParent(parent)
    local part = createBase()
    part.Shape = Enum.PartType.Ball
    part.Size = Vector3.new(0.5, 0.5, 0.5)
    part.CFrame = CFrame.new(position)
    part.Color = color or Color3.fromRGB(255, 0, 0)
    part.Parent = parent
    track(part, lifetime)
    return part
end

function DebugDraw.ray(parent, origin, direction, color, lifetime)
    validateParent(parent)
    local distance = direction.Magnitude
    assert(distance > 0, "direction must be non-zero")

    local part = createBase()
    part.Size = Vector3.new(0.1, 0.1, distance)
    part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(origin, origin + direction) * CFrame.new(0, 0, -distance / 2)
    part.Color = color or Color3.fromRGB(0, 255, 0)
    part.Parent = parent
    track(part, lifetime)
    return part
end

function DebugDraw.box(parent, cframe, size, color, lifetime)
    validateParent(parent)
    local part = createBase()
    part.Size = size
    part.CFrame = cframe
    part.Transparency = 0.7
    part.Color = color or Color3.fromRGB(0, 0, 255)
    part.Parent = parent
    track(part, lifetime)
    return part
end

function DebugDraw.clear()
    for i = #registry, 1, -1 do
        local part = registry[i]
        if part and part.Parent ~= nil then
            part:Destroy()
        end
        registry[i] = nil
    end
end

return DebugDraw

-- One carried item per player, welded to the right hand. The server owns the slot; the
-- client can only ask to drop (DropItem). Ingredient crates give items.
-- Plan: SYS-03
--
-- CarryService.Give(player, itemId) -> boolean (false if hands full, dead or unknown item)
-- CarryService.Peek(player)         -> itemId or nil
-- CarryService.Take(player)         -> itemId or nil, empties the slot
-- CarryService.Clear(player)        -> empties the slot
-- Player attribute "Carrying" (item id or nil) replicates for UI-04 and the hold-tray animation (ANI-02).
--
-- World contract: parts/models tagged "IngredientCrate" with attribute Ingredient = <Recipes ingredient id>.
-- A ProximityPrompt is created if the crate has none. Optional ServerStorage.ItemModels.<itemId> (Model with
-- PrimaryPart, or a BasePart) replaces the placeholder cube.

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net)
local Recipes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Recipes)
local GameService = require(script.Parent.GameService)
local PlayerUtil = require(script.Parent.Parent.Lib.PlayerUtil)

local CarryService = {}

local ATTRIBUTE = "Carrying"

type Slot = { id: string, visual: Instance, died: RBXScriptConnection? }
local slots: { [Player]: Slot } = {}

local function buildVisual(itemId: string): (Instance, BasePart)
	local models = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("ItemModels")
	local template = models and models:FindFirstChild(itemId)
	if template then
		local clone = template:Clone()
		local root = if clone:IsA("Model") then clone.PrimaryPart else clone
		if root and root:IsA("BasePart") then
			return clone, root
		end
		clone:Destroy()
	end
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = "Carried_" .. itemId
	part.Size = Config.Carry.ItemSize
	part.Color = Recipes.Items[itemId].Color
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	return part, part
end

local function releaseVisual(slot: Slot)
	if slot.died then
		slot.died:Disconnect()
	end
	slot.visual:Destroy()
end

function CarryService.Peek(player: Player): string?
	local slot = slots[player]
	return if slot then slot.id else nil
end

function CarryService.Clear(player: Player)
	local slot = slots[player]
	if not slot then
		return
	end
	slots[player] = nil
	releaseVisual(slot)
	player:SetAttribute(ATTRIBUTE, nil)
end

function CarryService.Take(player: Player): string?
	local id = CarryService.Peek(player)
	if id then
		CarryService.Clear(player)
	end
	return id
end

function CarryService.Give(player: Player, itemId: string): boolean
	if slots[player] or not Recipes.Items[itemId] or not PlayerUtil.getRoot(player) then
		return false
	end
	local character = player.Character
	local humanoid = character and character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local hand = character and (character:FindFirstChild("RightHand") or character:FindFirstChild("Right Arm"))
	if not (character and humanoid and hand and hand:IsA("BasePart")) then
		return false
	end

	local visual, root = buildVisual(itemId)
	for _, descendant in visual:GetDescendants() do
		if descendant:IsA("BasePart") then
			descendant.CanCollide = false
			descendant.CanQuery = false
			descendant.CanTouch = false
			descendant.Massless = true
		end
	end
	if visual:IsA("BasePart") then
		visual.CanCollide = false
		visual.CanQuery = false
		visual.CanTouch = false
		visual.Massless = true
	end
	root.CFrame = hand.CFrame * Config.Carry.GripOffset

	local weld = Instance.new("Weld")
	weld.Name = "CarryWeld"
	weld.Part0 = hand
	weld.Part1 = root
	weld.C0 = Config.Carry.GripOffset
	weld.Parent = root
	visual.Parent = character

	local slot: Slot = { id = itemId, visual = visual, died = nil }
	slot.died = humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		CarryService.Clear(player)
	end)
	slots[player] = slot
	player:SetAttribute(ATTRIBUTE, itemId)
	return true
end

local function setupCrate(crate: Instance)
	local ingredient = crate:GetAttribute("Ingredient")
	if
		type(ingredient) ~= "string"
		or not Recipes.Items[ingredient]
		or Recipes.Items[ingredient].Kind ~= "Ingredient"
	then
		warn(`[CarryService] Crate {crate:GetFullName()} has no valid Ingredient attribute`)
		return
	end
	local prompt = crate:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
	if not prompt then
		prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.ActionText = "Take " .. Recipes.Items[ingredient].Name
		prompt.ObjectText = "Crate"
		prompt.HoldDuration = 0
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = Config.Interaction.PromptDistance
		prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
		prompt.Parent = if crate:IsA("Model")
			then (crate.PrimaryPart or crate:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
			else crate
	end
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		local state = GameService.GetState()
		if state ~= "Day" and state ~= "Night" then
			return
		end
		if
			not PlayerUtil.isNear(
				player,
				crate,
				Config.Interaction.PromptDistance + Config.Interaction.ServerSlack + 10
			)
		then
			return
		end
		if CarryService.Peek(player) then
			Net.fireClient(player, "Notify", "Your hands are full (G to drop)")
			return
		end
		CarryService.Give(player, ingredient)
	end)
end

function CarryService.Init()
	GameService.OnStateChanged(function(state)
		if state == "Ready" then
			for player in slots do
				CarryService.Clear(player)
			end
		end
	end)
end

function CarryService.Start()
	Net.handle("DropItem", {}, function(player)
		CarryService.Clear(player)
	end, { rate = 3 })

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(CarryService.Clear)
	local function watchCharacter(player: Player)
		player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
			CarryService.Clear(player)
		end)
	end
	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(watchCharacter)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		watchCharacter(player)
	end

	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("IngredientCrate"):Connect(setupCrate)
	for _, crate in CollectionService:GetTagged("IngredientCrate") do
		setupCrate(crate)
	end
end

return CarryService

description: Módulo Luau para Roblox Studio. Revisa sus dependencias, permisos y compatibilidad antes de integrarlo en tu propia experiencia.

--!strict

-- Benchmarks Geode next to ProfileStore, ProfileService, Lapis and DataStore2 on live Roblox
-- services. Downloads each library at the commit pinned in tests/bench/libraries.json, refuses
-- any whose license no longer matches the recorded hash, builds a place holding the usual Studio
-- checks plus the bench, uploads it to the test place as a saved version, and runs the bench
-- modes as Luau Execution tasks. Geode's edit timings from `lune run benchcpu` go in too. Results
-- land in .cache/bench as JSON and a markdown summary. The API key comes from ROBLOX_API_KEY and
-- is never printed
--
--   lune run bench [library,library,...]

local fs = require("@lune/fs")
local net = require("@lune/net")
local process = require("@lune/process")
local serde = require("@lune/serde")
local stdio = require("@lune/stdio")

local OpenCloud = require("./OpenCloud")

type Pin = {
	name: string,
	repo: string,
	ref: string,
	version: string,
	dependencyOf: string?,
	license: { path: string, name: string, sha256: string },
	files: { [string]: string },
	mount: string,
	swap: { file: string, find: string, replace: string }?,
}

type TaskRecord = {
	mode: string,
	library: string,
	problem: string?,
	report: any,
	logTail: { string },
}

local PINS_PATH = "tests/bench/libraries.json"
local STUDIO_PROJECT = "tests/studio/studio.project.json"
local STUDIO_BASE = "tests/studio"
local OUT = ".cache/bench"
local LIBS = `{OUT}/libs`
local PROJECT_PATH = `{OUT}/bench.project.json`
local PLACE_PATH = `{OUT}/GeodeBench.rbxl`
local RESULTS_PATH = `{OUT}/results.json`
local SUMMARY_PATH = `{OUT}/summary.md`
local LIBRARIES = { "Geode", "GeodeMail", "ProfileStore", "ProfileService", "Lapis", "DataStore2" }
local TASK_TIMEOUT = OpenCloud.TASK_LIMIT
local WAIT_LIMIT = TASK_TIMEOUT + 90
local LOG_TAIL = 40

--// downloads

local function writeFile(path: string, contents: string)
	local folder = string.match(path, "^(.*)/[^/]+$")
	if folder and not fs.isDir(folder) then
		fs.writeDir(folder)
	end
	fs.writeFile(path, contents)
end

local function fetch(pin: Pin, path: string): (string?, string?)
	local url = `https://raw.githubusercontent.com/{pin.repo}/{pin.ref}/{path}`
	local response = net.request(url)
	if not response.ok then
		return nil, `{url} answered {response.statusCode}`
	end
	return response.body, nil
end

local function countPlain(text: string, find: string): number
	local count, start = 0, 1
	while true do
		local first, last = string.find(text, find, start, true)
		if first == nil then
			return count
		end
		count += 1
		start = (last :: number) + 1
	end
end

-- Downloads one library. Returns a reason when it can't be run
local function download(pin: Pin): string?
	local license, problem = fetch(pin, pin.license.path)
	if license == nil then
		return problem
	end
	local hash = serde.hash("sha256", license)
	if hash ~= pin.license.sha256 then
		return `its license changed (sha256 {hash}, recorded {pin.license.sha256} for {pin.license.name})`
	end
	local folder = `{LIBS}/{pin.name}`
	if fs.isDir(folder) then
		fs.removeDir(folder)
	end
	for source, target in pin.files do
		local body, failure = fetch(pin, source)
		if body == nil then
			return failure
		end
		local text = body :: string
		local swap = pin.swap
		if swap and swap.file == source then
			-- the one place the library picks up DataStoreService, pointed at the bench proxy
			local found = countPlain(text, swap.find)
			if found ~= 1 then
				return `the line the bench swaps shows up {found} times in {source}, expected once`
			end
			local first, last = string.find(text, swap.find, 1, true)
			text = string.sub(text, 1, (first :: number) - 1)
				.. swap.replace
				.. string.sub(text, (last :: number) + 1)
		end
		writeFile(`{folder}/{target}`, text)
	end
	return nil
end

--// the bench place

-- Joins a path onto a base and folds `.` and `..` parts
local function normalize(path: string): string
	local parts = {}
	for part in string.gmatch(path, "[^/]+") do
		if part == ".." and #parts > 0 and parts[#parts] ~= ".." then
			table.remove(parts)
		elseif part ~= "." then
			table.insert(parts, part)
		end
	end
	return table.concat(parts, "/")
end

-- `.cache/bench` sits two folders down, so repo paths are reached through ../..
local function fromOut(repoPath: string): string
	return `../../{repoPath}`
end

local function rebase(node: any)
	for key, child in node do
		if key == "$path" and type(child) == "string" then
			node[key] = fromOut(normalize(`{STUDIO_BASE}/{child}`))
		elseif type(child) == "table" then
			rebase(child)
		end
	end
end

-- The usual check place with the bench and the downloaded libraries next to the checks, so the
-- test place still runs the Studio checks after a bench upload
local function writeProject(pins: { Pin })
	local project = serde.decode("json", fs.readFile(STUDIO_PROJECT))
	rebase(project.tree)
	project.name = "GeodeBench"
	local vendor: { [string]: unknown } = { ["$className"] = "Folder" }
	for _, pin in pins do
		vendor[pin.name] = { ["$path"] = `libs/{pin.name}/{pin.mount}` }
	end
	local tests = project.tree.ServerScriptService.GeodeCheck.tests
	tests.bench = {
		["$className"] = "Folder",
		Bench = { ["$path"] = fromOut("tests/bench/Bench.luau") },
		Libraries = { ["$path"] = fromOut("tests/bench/Libraries.luau") },
		Proxy = { ["$path"] = fromOut("tests/bench/Proxy.luau") },
		Vendor = vendor,
	}
	writeFile(PROJECT_PATH, serde.encode("json", project, true))
end

--// tasks

local function taskScript(mode: string, library: string, run: string): string
	return table.concat({
		'local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")',
		'local Bench = require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService").GeodeCheck.tests.bench.Bench)',
		`return HttpService:JSONEncode(Bench.run(\{ mode = "{mode}", library = "{library}", run = "{run}" \}))`,
	}, "\n")
end

local function tail(lines: { string }): { string }
	local from = math.max(1, #lines - LOG_TAIL + 1)
	return table.move(lines, from, #lines, 1, {})
end

local function record(mode: string, library: string, finished: OpenCloud.Finished): TaskRecord
	local report = nil
	local problem = finished.problem
	if problem == nil then
		if finished.result then
			local ok, decoded = pcall(serde.decode, "json" :: "json", finished.result :: string)
			if ok then
				report = decoded
			else
				problem = "returned a report that isn't JSON"
			end
		else
			problem = "returned no report"
		end
	end
	if report and report.error then
		print(`  {mode} {library}: the bench reported {report.error}`)
	end
	if report and report.notRunnable then
		print(`  {mode} {library}: not runnable here, {report.notRunnable}`)
	end
	if problem then
		print(`  {mode} {library}: the task {problem}`)
	end
	return {
		mode = mode,
		library = library,
		problem = problem,
		report = report,
		logTail = tail(finished.logs),
	}
end

local function runOne(
	client: OpenCloud.Client,
	version: number,
	mode: string,
	library: string,
	run: string
): TaskRecord
	print(`{mode} {library}`)
	local started = client.startTask(version, taskScript(mode, library, run), TASK_TIMEOUT)
	return record(mode, library, client.finishTask(started, WAIT_LIMIT))
end

-- Starts the old and the new server of a hop together. Whether Roblox runs both at once is part
-- of what this finds out, so a refused second task is recorded rather than fatal
local function runHop(
	client: OpenCloud.Client,
	version: number,
	library: string,
	run: string
): { TaskRecord }
	print(`hop {library}`)
	local holder = client.startTask(version, taskScript("hold", library, run), TASK_TIMEOUT)
	local joiner, refused =
		client.tryStartTask(version, taskScript("join", library, run), TASK_TIMEOUT)
	local records = { record("hold", library, client.finishTask(holder, WAIT_LIMIT)) }
	if joiner then
		table.insert(records, record("join", library, client.finishTask(joiner, WAIT_LIMIT * 2)))
	else
		print(`  the second task was refused: {refused}`)
		table.insert(records, {
			mode = "join",
			library = library,
			problem = `refused while the first ran: {refused}`,
			report = nil,
			logTail = {},
		})
	end
	return records
end

--// summary

local function median(values: { number }): number?
	if #values == 0 then
		return nil
	end
	local sorted = table.clone(values)
	table.sort(sorted)
	local middle = (#sorted + 1) / 2
	if middle % 1 == 0 then
		return sorted[middle]
	end
	return (sorted[math.floor(middle)] + sorted[math.ceil(middle)]) / 2
end

local function seconds(value: number?): string
	return if value then string.format("%.2f", value) else "-"
end

local function spread(values: { number }): string
	if #values == 0 then
		return "-"
	end
	local sorted = table.clone(values)
	table.sort(sorted)
	return `{seconds(median(sorted))} ({seconds(sorted[1])} to {seconds(sorted[#sorted])}, n={#sorted})`
end

local function counts(values: { number }): string
	if #values == 0 then
		return "-"
	end
	local sorted = table.clone(values)
	table.sort(sorted)
	if sorted[1] == sorted[#sorted] then
		return tostring(sorted[1])
	end
	return `{sorted[1]} to {sorted[#sorted]}`
end

-- Why a library couldn't run in a mode, if it couldn't
local function notRunnable(records: { TaskRecord }, modes: { string }, library: string): string?
	for _, entry in records do
		local reason = entry.report and entry.report.notRunnable
		if reason and entry.library == library and table.find(modes, entry.mode) then
			return reason
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function summarize(records: { TaskRecord }): string
	local lines = {
		"| Library | Load new (s) | Load stored (s) | Save (s) | Release (s) | Requests: load / save / release |",
		"| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |",
	}
	for _, library in LIBRARIES do
		local blocked = notRunnable(records, { "perf" }, library)
		if blocked then
			table.insert(lines, `| {library} | not measured: {blocked} |`)
			continue
		end
		local times: { [string]: { number } } = { loadNew = {}, load = {}, save = {}, release = {} }
		local requests: { [string]: { number } } = { load = {}, save = {}, release = {} }
		local failures = 0
		for _, entry in records do
			local result = entry.report and entry.report.result
			if entry.mode == "perf" and entry.library == library and result then
				for _, step in result.steps do
					if not step.ok then
						failures += 1
						continue
					end
					if times[step.op] then
						table.insert(times[step.op], step.seconds)
					end
					local kind = if step.op == "loadNew" then "load" else step.op
					if requests[kind] then
						table.insert(requests[kind], step.requests)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		table.insert(
			lines,
			`| {library}{if failures > 0 then ` ({failures} failed steps)` else ""} | {spread(
				times.loadNew
			)} | {spread(times.load)} | {spread(times.save)} | {spread(times.release)} | {counts(
				requests.load
			)} / {counts(requests.save)} / {counts(requests.release)} |`
		)
	end

	table.insert(lines, "")
	table.insert(
		lines,
		"| Library | Hop after release (s) | Got the final save | Holder keeps it (s) | Coins seen | Same JobId |"
	)
	table.insert(lines, "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |")
	for _, library in LIBRARIES do
		local blocked = notRunnable(records, { "hold", "join" }, library)
		if blocked then
			table.insert(lines, `| {library} | not measured: {blocked} |`)
			continue
		end
		local hops, latest, total = {}, 0, 0
		local keepTime, keepCoins, sameJob = "-", "-", "-"
		for _, entry in records do
			local result = entry.report and entry.report.result
			if entry.mode == "join" and entry.library == library and result then
				for _, attempt in result.attempts do
					if attempt.step then
						total += 1
						if attempt.step.ok then
							table.insert(hops, attempt.step.seconds)
						end
						if attempt.coins == 888 then
							latest += 1
						end
						sameJob = tostring(attempt.sameJobId)
					end
				end
				local keep = result.keep
				if keep and keep.step then
					keepTime = if keep.step.ok
						then seconds(keep.step.seconds)
						else `failed after {seconds(keep.step.seconds)}: {keep.step.err}`
					keepCoins = tostring(keep.coins)
				end
			end
		end
		table.insert(
			lines,
			`| {library} | {spread(hops)} | {latest} of {total} | {keepTime} | {keepCoins} | {sameJob} |`
		)
	end

	table.insert(lines, "")
	table.insert(lines, "| Library | Burst | Load | Save | Release | Failed requests |")
	table.insert(lines, "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |")
	for _, library in LIBRARIES do
		local blocked = notRunnable(records, { "throttle" }, library)
		if blocked then
			table.insert(lines, `| {library} | not measured: {blocked} |`)
			continue
		end
		for _, entry in records do
			local result = entry.report and entry.report.result
			if entry.mode == "throttle" and entry.library == library and result then
				local cells = { load = "-", save = "-", release = "-" }
				local failedRequests = 0
				for _, step in result.steps do
					cells[step.op] = if step.ok
						then `{seconds(step.seconds)} s`
						else `failed after {seconds(step.seconds)} s`
					failedRequests += step.failedRequests
				end
				local burst = result.burst
				table.insert(
					lines,
					`| {library} | {burst.sent} sent, {burst.failed} failed, {burst.pending} pending | {cells.load} | {cells.save} | {cells.release} | {failedRequests} |`
				)
			end
		end
	end

	table.insert(lines, "")
	table.insert(
		lines,
		"| Library | Profiles | Heap per profile (KB, noisy) | Heap before (KB) | Heap after (KB) |"
	)
	table.insert(lines, "| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |")
	for _, library in LIBRARIES do
		local blocked = notRunnable(records, { "memory" }, library)
		if blocked then
			table.insert(lines, `| {library} | not measured: {blocked} |`)
			continue
		end
		for _, entry in records do
			local result = entry.report and entry.report.result
			if entry.mode == "memory" and entry.library == library and result then
				if result.notReadable then
					table.insert(lines, `| {library} | heap not readable: {result.notReadable} |`)
					continue
				end
				local per = if result.perProfileKb
					then string.format("%.1f", result.perProfileKb)
					else "-"
				table.insert(
					lines,
					`| {library} | {result.profiles} | {per} | {string.format(
						"%.0f",
						result.before.min
					)} | {string.format("%.0f", result.after.min)} |`
				)
			end
		end
	end
	return table.concat(lines, "\n") .. "\n"
end

--// Geode's edits in Lune

local function cpu(): { [string]: any }
	local result = process.exec("lune", { "run", "benchcpu" })
	if not result.ok then
		return { problem = `lune run benchcpu failed: {result.stderr}` }
	end
	local ok, decoded = pcall(serde.decode, "json" :: "json", result.stdout)
	if not ok then
		return { problem = "lune run benchcpu printed something that isn't JSON" }
	end
	return decoded
end

--// what ran

-- git's id for a folder at the checked out commit. Runs with the same id ran the same code. A
-- folder with uncommitted changes gets none, since the id wouldn't match what ran
local function treeId(path: string): string?
	local status = process.exec("git", { "status", "--porcelain", "--", path })
	if not status.ok or status.stdout ~= "" then
		return nil
	end
	local result = process.exec("git", { "rev-parse", `HEAD:{path}` })
	if not result.ok then
		return nil
	end
	return (string.gsub(result.stdout, "%s+$", ""))
end

-- The Actions run this is part of, when it runs in one
local function workflowRun(): string?
	local env = process.env
	local server, repository, id = env.GITHUB_SERVER_URL, env.GITHUB_REPOSITORY, env.GITHUB_RUN_ID
	if server and repository and id then
		return `{server}/{repository}/actions/runs/{id}`
	end
	return nil
end

--// main

local function main()
	local wanted = LIBRARIES
	if process.args[1] then
		wanted = {}
		for name in string.gmatch(process.args[1], "[^,]+") do
			table.insert(wanted, name)
		end
	end

	local manifest = serde.decode("json", fs.readFile(PINS_PATH))
	local pins: { Pin } = manifest.libraries
	local mounted: { Pin } = {}
	local refused: { [string]: string } = {}
	for _, pin in pins do
		print(`downloading {pin.name} {pin.version}`)
		local problem = download(pin)
		if problem then
			print(`  refusing {pin.name}: {problem}`)
			refused[pin.name] = problem
		else
			table.insert(mounted, pin)
		end
	end
	-- a library is only run when it and everything it depends on came through
	local runnable: { string } = {}
	for _, library in wanted do
		local blocked = refused[library] ~= nil
		for _, pin in pins do
			if pin.dependencyOf == library and refused[pin.name] then
				blocked = true
			end
		end
		if blocked then
			refused[library] = refused[library] or "a dependency was refused"
		else
			table.insert(runnable, library)
		end
	end

	print("timing Geode's edits in Lune")
	local cpuReport = cpu()

	print("building the bench place")
	writeProject(mounted)
	-- everything up to here works without the key, which helps when changing the bench
	local client = OpenCloud.client("bench")
	client.build(PROJECT_PATH, PLACE_PATH)
	print("uploading it as a saved version")
	local version = client.upload(PLACE_PATH)
	print(`running against version {version}`)

	local run = string.format("%08x", math.random(0, 0x7fffffff))
	local records: { TaskRecord } = {}
	for _, library in runnable do
		table.insert(records, runOne(client, version, "perf", library, run))
	end
	for _, library in runnable do
		for _, entry in runHop(client, version, library, run) do
			table.insert(records, entry)
		end
	end
	for _, library in runnable do
		table.insert(records, runOne(client, version, "throttle", library, run))
	end
	for _, library in runnable do
		table.insert(records, runOne(client, version, "memory", library, run))
	end

	local pinned = {}
	for _, pin in pins do
		table.insert(pinned, {
			name = pin.name,
			repo = pin.repo,
			ref = pin.ref,
			version = pin.version,
			license = pin.license.name,
			licenseSha256 = pin.license.sha256,
		})
	end
	local results = {
		run = run,
		date = os.date("!%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ"),
		placeVersion = version,
		geodeSourceTree = treeId("src"),
		benchTree = treeId("tests/bench"),
		workflowRun = workflowRun(),
		lune = { cpu = cpuReport },
		pins = pinned,
		refused = refused,
		tasks = records,
	}
	writeFile(RESULTS_PATH, serde.encode("json", results, true))
	local cpuLine = if cpuReport.batches
		then `Geode in Lune, {cpuReport.editsPerBatch} edits per batch: {table.concat(
			cpuReport.batches,
			", "
		)} s\n`
		else `Geode in Lune: {cpuReport.problem}\n`
	local summary = `## Bench run {run}, place version {version}\n\n{summarize(records)}\n{cpuLine}`
	writeFile(SUMMARY_PATH, summary)
	print(`\n{summary}`)

	local problems = 0
	for _, entry in records do
		if entry.problem then
			problems += 1
			stdio.ewrite(`TASK {entry.mode} {entry.library} {entry.problem}\n`)
		end
	end
	for name, reason in refused do
		stdio.ewrite(`REFUSED {name}: {reason}\n`)
	end
	if problems > 0 or next(refused) ~= nil then
		process.exit(1)
	end
end

main()

-- .lune/bench.luau requires this, and a module has to return one value
return nil

--[[
    Logger.lua
    A simple structured logger with level filtering.

    Usage:
        local Logger = require(path.to.Logger)
        local log = Logger.new("InventorySystem", Logger.Levels.Warn)
        log:info("Loaded")
        log:warn("Missing item %d", 123)
        log:error("Failed to save: %s", err)

    Notes:
        - log:error halts execution by calling Lua's error() function.
        - Contextual fields are not supported by this minimal logger.
          Include any context directly in the message or use a structured
          logging library for field-based output.
]]

local Logger = {}
Logger.Levels = {
    Debug = 1,
    Info = 2,
    Warn = 3,
    Error = 4,
}

Logger.__index = Logger

function Logger.new(name: string?, minLevel: number?)
    local self = setmetatable({}, Logger)
    self.name = name or "Logger"
    self.minLevel = minLevel or Logger.Levels.Info
    return self
end

function Logger:_log(levelName: string, levelValue: number, fmt: string, ...: any)
    if levelValue < self.minLevel then
        return
    end
    local ok, msg = pcall(string.format, fmt, ...)
    if not ok then
        msg = "[bad format string: " .. tostring(fmt) .. "]"
    end
    local output = string.format("[%s][%s] %s", self.name, levelName, msg)
    if levelValue >= Logger.Levels.Error then
        error(output, 3)
    elseif levelValue >= Logger.Levels.Warn then
        warn(output)
    else
        print(output)
    end
end

function Logger:debug(fmt: string, ...: any)
    self:_log("DEBUG", Logger.Levels.Debug, fmt, ...)
end

function Logger:info(fmt: string, ...: any)
    self:_log("INFO", Logger.Levels.Info, fmt, ...)
end

function Logger:warn(fmt: string, ...: any)
    self:_log("WARN", Logger.Levels.Warn, fmt, ...)
end

function Logger:error(fmt: string, ...: any)
    self:_log("ERROR", Logger.Levels.Error, fmt, ...)
end

return Logger

-- Compiled with roblox-ts v3.0.0
local TS = _G[script]
local React = TS.import(script, TS.getModule(script, "@rbxts", "react"))
local function isPointerPress(input)
	if input == nil then
		return false
	end
	return input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end
local function usePressRelease(onRelease)
	local onReleaseRef = React.useRef(onRelease)
	onReleaseRef.current = onRelease
	local connectionsRef = React.useRef()
	React.useEffect(function()
		return function()
			local _result = connectionsRef.current
			if _result ~= nil then
				-- ▼ ReadonlyMap.forEach ▼
				local _callback = function(connection)
					return connection:Disconnect()
				end
				for _k, _v in _result do
					_callback(_v, _k, _result)
				end
				-- ▲ ReadonlyMap.forEach ▲
			end
			local _result_1 = connectionsRef.current
			if _result_1 ~= nil then
				table.clear(_result_1)
			end
		end
	end, {})
	return React.useCallback(function(button, input)
		if connectionsRef.current == nil then
			connectionsRef.current = {}
		end
		local connections = connectionsRef.current
		local _input = input
		if connections[_input] ~= nil then
			return nil
		end
		local connection
		connection = input:GetPropertyChangedSignal("UserInputState"):Connect(function()
			if input.UserInputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.End and input.UserInputState ~= Enum.UserInputState.Cancel then
				return nil
			end
			connection:Disconnect()
			local _input_1 = input
			connections[_input_1] = nil
			local _result = onReleaseRef.current
			if _result ~= nil then
				_result(button, input)
			end
		end)
		local _input_1 = input
		connections[_input_1] = connection
	end, {})
end
return {
	isPointerPress = isPointerPress,
	usePressRelease = usePressRelease,
}

--!strict

-- Keeps bench runs in benchmarks/runs and builds the bench data the docs site publishes
--
--   lune run benchdata import <results.json> [--build <name>] [--line <line>] [--notes <file>]
--       [--source-tree <id>] [--bench-tree <id>] [--workflow-run <url>]
--   lune run benchdata build
--   lune run benchdata check
--
-- import cleans a run of anything that identifies the place or a server and keeps it. The build
-- says which Geode it measured. Left out, it's the catalog's build for the run's source tree, or
-- the release whose src matches, or `unreleased-<tree>`. A build the catalog doesn't know yet is
-- added to it on the line given with --line, or the line of the last build. --notes appends what
-- a reviewer should look at to a file. The bench records the tree ids and the workflow run in
-- results.json; runs from before it did need them given, from `git rev-parse <commit>:src` and
-- `git rev-parse <commit>:tests/bench`
--
-- build writes the published files under .moonwave/static/data/benchmarks and fills the marked
-- tables in docs/benchmarks.md. check fails when either doesn't match the runs and the catalog,
-- or when a run doesn't fit the catalog

local fs = require("@lune/fs")
local process = require("@lune/process")
local stdio = require("@lune/stdio")

local BenchDocs = require("./BenchDocs")
local BenchPublish = require("./BenchPublish")
local BenchResults = require("./BenchResults")

local RUNS_DIR = "benchmarks/runs"
local CATALOG_PATH = "benchmarks/catalog.json"
local SCHEMA_PATH = "benchmarks/schema.json"
local OUT_DIR = ".moonwave/static/data/benchmarks"
local DOCS_PATH = "docs/benchmarks.md"
-- check writes a copy here for scripts/validate-bench-data.mjs to hold against the schema
local CHECK_DIR = ".cache/bench-data"

local function fail(message: string): never
	stdio.ewrite(`{message}\n`)
	return process.exit(1)
end

local function options(args: { string }, from: number): { [string]: string }
	local found = {}
	local index = from
	while index <= #args do
		local name = string.match(args[index], "^%-%-(.+)$")
		local value = args[index + 1]
		if name == nil or value == nil then
			fail(`expected --name value pairs, got {args[index]}`)
		end
		found[name :: string] = value
		index += 2
	end
	return found
end

local function git(args: { string }): string?
	local result = process.exec("git", args)
	if not result.ok then
		return nil
	end
	return (string.gsub(result.stdout, "%s+$", ""))
end

-- The release whose src is this tree, if there is one
local function releaseOf(sourceTree: string): string?
	local tags = git({ "for-each-ref", "--format=%(refname:short)", "refs/tags/v*" }) or ""
	for tag in string.gmatch(tags, "[^\r\n]+") do
		if git({ "rev-parse", `{tag}:src` }) == sourceTree then
			return tag
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function note(path: string?, line: string)
	print(line)
	if path then
		local before = if fs.isFile(path) then fs.readFile(path) else ""
		fs.writeFile(path, `{before}{line}\n`)
	end
end

--// import

local function import(args: { string })
	local path = args[2] or fail("import needs the path of a results.json")
	local given = options(args, 3)
	local results = BenchResults.decode(fs.readFile(path))
	local sourceTree = given["source-tree"]
		or results.geodeSourceTree
		or fail("import needs --source-tree for a run that didn't record it")
	local benchTree = given["bench-tree"]
		or results.benchTree
		or fail("import needs --bench-tree for a run that didn't record it")
	for _, tree in { sourceTree, benchTree } do
		if not string.match(tree, "^%x+$") or #tree ~= 40 then
			fail(`{tree} isn't a full git id`)
		end
	end

	local catalogText = fs.readFile(CATALOG_PATH)
	local catalog = BenchResults.decode(catalogText)
	local known = BenchPublish.buildOf(catalog, sourceTree)
	local release = nil
	local build = given.build
	if build == nil then
		if known == nil then
			release = releaseOf(sourceTree)
		end
		build = known
			or (release and string.gsub(release, "^v", ""))
			or `unreleased-{string.sub(sourceTree, 1, 7)}`
	end

	local entry = nil
	for _, candidate in catalog.builds do
		if candidate.id == build then
			entry = candidate
		end
	end
	if entry and not table.find(entry.sourceTrees, sourceTree) then
		fail(`build {build} in {CATALOG_PATH} doesn't list source tree {sourceTree}`)
	elseif entry == nil and known then
		fail(`source tree {sourceTree} belongs to build {known}, not {build}`)
	elseif entry == nil then
		local line = given.line or catalog.builds[#catalog.builds].line
		fs.writeFile(
			CATALOG_PATH,
			BenchPublish.addBuild(catalogText, {
				id = build,
				line = line,
				release = release,
				sourceTrees = BenchResults.array({ sourceTree }),
				note = "Added by the import on the line of the build before it.",
			})
		)
		note(
			given.notes,
			`- New build \`{build}\` in \`{CATALOG_PATH}\`, put on the \`{line}\` line. If it changed how loads, saves, releases or hops work, it needs its own line and subjects.`
		)
	end

	local run = BenchResults.sanitize(results, {
		build = build :: string,
		sourceTree = sourceTree,
		benchTree = benchTree,
		workflowRun = given["workflow-run"] or results.workflowRun,
	})
	if not fs.isDir(RUNS_DIR) then
		fs.writeDir(RUNS_DIR)
	end
	local target = `{RUNS_DIR}/{run.run}.json`
	fs.writeFile(target, BenchResults.encode(run))
	note(given.notes, `- Run \`{run.run}\` from {run.date}, build \`{build}\`, {#run.tasks} tasks`)
end

--// build and check

local function readRuns(): { any }
	local runs = {}
	local names: { string } = if fs.isDir(RUNS_DIR) then fs.readDir(RUNS_DIR) else {}
	table.sort(names)
	for _, name in names do
		if string.sub(name, -5) == ".json" then
			table.insert(runs, BenchResults.decode(fs.readFile(`{RUNS_DIR}/{name}`)))
		end
	end
	return runs
end

-- A file's text with Windows line endings made plain, as git may check it out either way
local function readText(path: string): string
	return (string.gsub(fs.readFile(path), "\r\n", "\n"))
end

local function published(): ({ [string]: string }, string)
	local catalog = BenchResults.decode(fs.readFile(CATALOG_PATH))
	local runs = readRuns()
	local docs = BenchDocs.fill(catalog, BenchPublish.latest(catalog, runs), readText(DOCS_PATH))
	return BenchPublish.files(catalog, runs, fs.readFile(SCHEMA_PATH)), docs
end

local function listOut(dir: string, prefix: string, into: { string })
	for _, name in fs.readDir(dir) do
		local path = `{dir}/{name}`
		if fs.isDir(path) then
			listOut(path, `{prefix}{name}/`, into)
		else
			table.insert(into, `{prefix}{name}`)
		end
	end
end

local function writeAll(dir: string, files: { [string]: string }): number
	if fs.isDir(dir) then
		fs.removeDir(dir)
	end
	local count = 0
	for path, contents in files do
		local full = `{dir}/{path}`
		local folder = string.match(full, "^(.*)/[^/]+$") :: string
		if not fs.isDir(folder) then
			fs.writeDir(folder)
		end
		fs.writeFile(full, contents)
		count += 1
	end
	return count
end

local function build()
	local files, docs = published()
	local count = writeAll(OUT_DIR, files)
	fs.writeFile(DOCS_PATH, docs)
	print(`wrote {count} files to {OUT_DIR} and the tables in {DOCS_PATH}`)
end

local function check()
	local files, docs = published()
	writeAll(CHECK_DIR, files)
	if readText(DOCS_PATH) ~= docs then
		fail(
			`the tables in {DOCS_PATH} don't match the bench data\nlune run benchdata build writes them again`
		)
	end
	if not fs.isDir(OUT_DIR) then
		print(`every run fits the catalog; nothing published in {OUT_DIR} yet`)
		return
	end
	local problems = {}
	local existing = {}
	listOut(OUT_DIR, "", existing)
	for _, path in existing do
		if files[path] == nil then
			table.insert(problems, `{path} is published but no run makes it`)
		end
	end
	for path, contents in files do
		local full = `{OUT_DIR}/{path}`
		if not fs.isFile(full) then
			table.insert(problems, `{path} is missing`)
		elseif readText(full) ~= contents then
			table.insert(problems, `{path} is out of date`)
		end
	end
	if #problems > 0 then
		table.sort(problems)
		fail(`{table.concat(problems, "\n")}\nlune run benchdata build writes them again`)
	end
	print(`{OUT_DIR} matches the runs and the catalog`)
end

local command = process.args[1]
if command == "import" then
	import(process.args)
elseif command == "build" then
	build()
elseif command == "check" then
	check()
else
	fail("usage: lune run benchdata import <results.json> | build | check")
end

-- .lune/benchdata.luau requires this, and a module has to return one value
return nil

--!strict
-- Status: experimental
-- Last verified: 2026-06-17
-- Test coverage: no automated coverage
-- Intended use: example; adapt and test before production.

--[[
    TestRunner.lua
    A minimal in-Studio test runner shim.

    This is NOT a replacement for TestEZ, which is the standard Roblox testing
    framework. Use TestEZ for real projects. This module is a small fallback
    for environments where TestEZ is not available.

    Usage:
        local TestRunner = require(path.to.TestRunner)
        local runner = TestRunner.new()

        runner:describe("Math", function()
            runner:it("adds numbers", function()
                runner:expect(1 + 1).toBe(2)
            end)
        end)

        runner:run()
]]

local TestService = game:GetService("TestService")

local TestRunner = {}
TestRunner.__index = TestRunner

export type TestRunnerOptions = {
    useTestService: boolean?,
    timeout: number?,
}

type Hook = () -> ()
type TestCase = {
    name: string,
    fn: () -> any,
}
type Suite = {
    name: string,
    tests: { TestCase },
    suites: { Suite },
    parent: Suite?,
    beforeEach: { Hook },
    afterEach: { Hook },
}
type TestResults = {
    total: number,
    passed: number,
    failed: number,
    errors: { string },
}
type PromiseLike = {
    andThen: (
        self: PromiseLike,
        onResolve: (...any) -> (),
        onReject: (any) -> ()
    ) -> any,
}

export type TestRunner = typeof(setmetatable(
    {} :: {
        suites: { Suite },
        stack: { Suite },
        hooks: { beforeEach: { Hook }, afterEach: { Hook } },
        useTestService: boolean,
        timeout: number,
    },
    TestRunner
))

function TestRunner.new(options: TestRunnerOptions?): TestRunner
    local resolvedOptions: TestRunnerOptions = options or {}
    local self = setmetatable({}, TestRunner) :: TestRunner
    self.suites = {}
    self.stack = {}
    self.hooks = { beforeEach = {}, afterEach = {} }
    self.useTestService = resolvedOptions.useTestService ~= false
    self.timeout = resolvedOptions.timeout or 5
    return self
end

function TestRunner._currentSuite(self: TestRunner): Suite?
    return self.stack[#self.stack]
end

function TestRunner.describe(self: TestRunner, name: string, fn: () -> ())
    local parent = self:_currentSuite()
    local suite: Suite = {
        name = name,
        tests = {},
        suites = {},
        parent = parent,
        beforeEach = {},
        afterEach = {},
    }

    if parent then
        table.insert(parent.suites, suite)
    else
        table.insert(self.suites, suite)
    end

    table.insert(self.stack, suite)
    fn()
    table.remove(self.stack)
end

function TestRunner.beforeEach(self: TestRunner, fn: Hook)
    local suite = self:_currentSuite()
    assert(suite, "beforeEach() must be called inside describe()")
    table.insert(suite.beforeEach, fn)
end

function TestRunner.afterEach(self: TestRunner, fn: Hook)
    local suite = self:_currentSuite()
    assert(suite, "afterEach() must be called inside describe()")
    table.insert(suite.afterEach, fn)
end

function TestRunner.it(self: TestRunner, name: string, fn: () -> any)
    local suite = self:_currentSuite()
    assert(suite, "it() must be called inside describe()")
    table.insert(suite.tests, { name = name, fn = fn })
end

local function deepEqual(a: any, b: any): (boolean, any?)
    if a == b then
        return true, nil
    end
    if typeof(a) ~= "table" or typeof(b) ~= "table" then
        return false, nil
    end
    for k, v in pairs(a) do
        if not deepEqual(v, b[k]) then
            return false, k
        end
    end
    for k, _ in pairs(b) do
        if a[k] == nil then
            return false, k
        end
    end
    return true, nil
end

local function isPromiseLike(obj: any): boolean
    return typeof(obj) == "table" and typeof(obj.andThen) == "function"
end

function TestRunner.expect(_self: TestRunner, value: any)
    local matchers = {}

    function matchers.toBe(expected: any)
        assert(
            value == expected,
            string.format("expected %s, got %s", tostring(expected), tostring(value))
        )
    end

    function matchers.toEqual(expected: any)
        local ok, key = deepEqual(value, expected)
        if not ok then
            if key ~= nil then
                assert(false, string.format("deep equality mismatch at key %s", tostring(key)))
            else
                assert(
                    false,
                    string.format("expected %s, got %s", tostring(expected), tostring(value))
                )
            end
        end
    end

    function matchers.toBeTruthy()
        assert(value, "expected truthy value")
    end

    function matchers.toBeNil()
        assert(value == nil, "expected nil")
    end

    function matchers.toBeType(typeName: string)
        assert(
            typeof(value) == typeName,
            string.format("expected type %s, got %s", typeName, typeof(value))
        )
    end

    function matchers.toBeGreaterThan(threshold: number)
        assert(typeof(value) == "number", "value must be a number")
        assert(
            value > threshold,
            string.format("expected value > %s, got %s", tostring(threshold), tostring(value))
        )
    end

    function matchers.toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(threshold: number)
        assert(typeof(value) == "number", "value must be a number")
        assert(
            value >= threshold,
            string.format("expected value >= %s, got %s", tostring(threshold), tostring(value))
        )
    end

    function matchers.toBeLessThan(threshold: number)
        assert(typeof(value) == "number", "value must be a number")
        assert(
            value < threshold,
            string.format("expected value < %s, got %s", tostring(threshold), tostring(value))
        )
    end

    function matchers.toBeLessThanOrEqual(threshold: number)
        assert(typeof(value) == "number", "value must be a number")
        assert(
            value <= threshold,
            string.format("expected value <= %s, got %s", tostring(threshold), tostring(value))
        )
    end

    function matchers.toBeCloseTo(expected: number, tolerance: number?)
        local resolvedTolerance = tolerance or 0.00001
        assert(typeof(value) == "number" and typeof(expected) == "number", "values must be numbers")
        assert(
            math.abs(value - expected) <= resolvedTolerance,
            string.format(
                "expected %s to be close to %s (tolerance %s)",
                tostring(value),
                tostring(expected),
                tostring(resolvedTolerance)
            )
        )
    end

    function matchers.toThrow(expectedPattern: string?)
        assert(typeof(value) == "function", "value must be a function")
        local ok, err = pcall(value :: () -> any)
        assert(not ok, "expected function to throw")
        if expectedPattern then
            local errStr = tostring(err)
            assert(
                string.find(errStr, expectedPattern, 1, true),
                string.format("expected error to contain %q, got %q", expectedPattern, errStr)
            )
        end
    end

    return matchers
end

function TestRunner._runHooks(_self: TestRunner, hooksList: { Hook })
    for _, fn in ipairs(hooksList) do
        fn()
    end
end

function TestRunner._collectHooks(
    _self: TestRunner,
    suite: Suite,
    kind: "beforeEach" | "afterEach"
): { Hook }
    local collected: { Hook } = {}
    local current: Suite? = suite
    while current do
        local hooks = if kind == "beforeEach" then current.beforeEach else current.afterEach
        for _, fn in ipairs(hooks) do
            table.insert(collected, fn)
        end
        current = current.parent
    end
    if kind == "beforeEach" then
        local reversed: { Hook } = {}
        for i = #collected, 1, -1 do
            table.insert(reversed, collected[i])
        end
        return reversed
    end
    return collected
end

function TestRunner._runTest(self: TestRunner, test: TestCase, suite: Suite): (boolean, any?)
    local beforeHooks = self:_collectHooks(suite, "beforeEach")
    local afterHooks = self:_collectHooks(suite, "afterEach")

    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        self:_runHooks(beforeHooks)
    end)
    if not ok then
        return false, "beforeEach failed: " .. tostring(err)
    end

    local testOk, testResult: any = pcall(test.fn)
    ok = testOk
    err = testResult
    if ok then
        if isPromiseLike(testResult) then
            local resolved = false
            local promiseErr: any = nil
            local promise = testResult :: PromiseLike
            promise:andThen(function()
                resolved = true
            end, function(e)
                resolved = true
                promiseErr = e
            end)
            local start = os.clock()
            while not resolved and os.clock() - start < self.timeout do
                task.wait(0.05)
            end
            if not resolved then
                ok = false
                testResult = "async test timed out"
            elseif promiseErr ~= nil then
                ok = false
                testResult = promiseErr
            end
        end
    end

    err = testResult

    local afterOk, afterErr = pcall(function()
        self:_runHooks(afterHooks)
    end)
    if not afterOk then
        local prefix = err and (tostring(err) .. "; ") or ""
        ok = false
        err = prefix .. "afterEach failed: " .. tostring(afterErr)
    end

    return ok, err
end

function TestRunner._runSuite(self: TestRunner, suite: Suite, indent: string?, results: TestResults)
    local resolvedIndent = indent or ""
    print(resolvedIndent .. "Suite: " .. suite.name)

    for _, test in ipairs(suite.tests) do
        results.total += 1
        local ok, err = self:_runTest(test, suite)
        if ok then
            results.passed += 1
            print(resolvedIndent .. "  [PASS] " .. test.name)
        else
            results.failed += 1
            local msg = resolvedIndent
                .. "[FAIL] "
                .. suite.name
                .. " > "
                .. test.name
                .. ": "
                .. tostring(err)
            warn(msg)
            table.insert(results.errors, msg)
            if self.useTestService then
                pcall(function()
                    TestService:Error(msg)
                end)
            end
        end
    end

    for _, child in ipairs(suite.suites) do
        self:_runSuite(child, resolvedIndent .. "  ", results)
    end
end

function TestRunner.run(self: TestRunner): (boolean, TestResults)
    local results: TestResults = { total = 0, passed = 0, failed = 0, errors = {} }

    for _, suite in ipairs(self.suites) do
        self:_runSuite(suite, "", results)
    end

    print(
        string.format(
            "\nResults: %d total, %d passed, %d failed",
            results.total,
            results.passed,
            results.failed
        )
    )
    if results.failed > 0 then
        warn("Failed tests:")
        for _, err in ipairs(results.errors) do
            warn("  - " .. err)
        end
    end
    return results.failed == 0, results
end

return TestRunner

-- OUT OF OR IN CONNECTION WITH THE SOFTWARE OR THE USE OR OTHER DEALINGS IN THE
-- SOFTWARE.

-- Customers: spawn during the day, queue at free slots, order 1-3 dishes, lose patience,
-- get served at the window, pay per dish and tip for speed.
-- Plan: SYS-05
--
-- World contract (tags):
--   "CustomerSpawn"  one part where customers appear and where they leave to
--   "QueueSlot"      parts with number attribute Index (1 = nearest the window); one customer per slot
--   "ServiceWindow"  part/model; players holding a dish trigger its ProximityPrompt (created if missing)
-- Optional ServerStorage.Customers: models (R15 rigs with Humanoid + HumanoidRootPart) used before the default rig (MOD-06).
--
-- Customers live in workspace.Customers. Replicated attributes on each customer model (UI-03 tickets):
--   Order ("Burger,Fries" = dishes still missing), Total (same list at arrival), Patience (1 -> 0), Waiting (arrived)
--
-- CustomerService.GetWaiting() -> number of customers at the window

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local ServerStorage = game:GetService("ServerStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net)
local Nights = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Nights)
local Recipes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Recipes)
local CarryService = require(script.Parent.CarryService)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)
local EconomyService = require(script.Parent.EconomyService)
local GameService = require(script.Parent.GameService)
local PlayerUtil = require(script.Parent.Parent.Lib.PlayerUtil)

local CustomerService = {}

local TICK = 0.25

type Customer = {
	model: Model,
	humanoid: Humanoid,
	root: BasePart,
	slot: BasePart?,
	phase: string, -- "Walking" | "Waiting" | "Leaving"
	order: { string },
	total: { string },
	patience: number, -- seconds left
	patienceTotal: number,
	phaseStart: number,
	lastMove: number,
	paid: number, -- cash earned from dishes already served
}

local customers: { [Model]: Customer } = {}
local slotOwner: { [BasePart]: Customer? } = {}
local reserved = 0 -- spawns in progress (the rig is built asynchronously)
local folder: Folder
local spawnPart: BasePart? = nil
local spawnToken = 0
local rng = Random.new()
local warnedRig = false

local function getSlots(): { BasePart }
	local list = {}
	for _, instance in CollectionService:GetTagged("QueueSlot") do
		if instance:IsA("BasePart") and instance:IsDescendantOf(workspace) then
			table.insert(list, instance)
		end
	end
	table.sort(list, function(a, b)
		return (a:GetAttribute("Index") or 0) < (b:GetAttribute("Index") or 0)
	end)
	return list
end

local function freeSlot(): BasePart?
	for _, slot in getSlots() do
		if slotOwner[slot] == nil then
			return slot
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function countActive(): number
	local n = reserved
	for _ in customers do
		n += 1
	end
	return n
end

local function publish(customer: Customer)
	local model = customer.model
	model:SetAttribute("Order", table.concat(customer.order, ","))
	model:SetAttribute("Total", table.concat(customer.total, ","))
	model:SetAttribute("Patience", math.floor(math.clamp(customer.patience / customer.patienceTotal, 0, 1) * 100) / 100)
	model:SetAttribute("Waiting", customer.phase == "Waiting")
end

local function buildRig(): Model?
	local templates = ServerStorage:FindFirstChild("Customers")
	if templates then
		local options = templates:GetChildren()
		if #options > 0 then
			local clone = options[rng:NextInteger(1, #options)]:Clone()
			if
				clone:IsA("Model")
				and clone:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
				and clone:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
			then
				return clone
			end
			clone:Destroy()
		end
	end
	local description = Instance.new("HumanoidDescription")
	for _, property in { "HeadColor", "TorsoColor", "LeftArmColor", "RightArmColor", "LeftLegColor", "RightLegColor" } do
		description[property] = Color3.fromHSV(rng:NextNumber(), 0.35, 0.9)
	end
	local ok, rig = pcall(Players.CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription, Players, description, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
	if ok and rig then
		return rig
	end
	if not warnedRig then
		warnedRig = true
		warn(`[CustomerService] Could not build a customer rig: {rig}`)
	end
	return nil
end

local function makeOrder(night): { string }
	local settings = night.Customers
	local order = {}
	for _ = 1, rng:NextInteger(1, settings.MaxItems) do
		table.insert(order, settings.Dishes[rng:NextInteger(1, #settings.Dishes)])
	end
	return order
end

local function release(customer: Customer, nextPhase: string)
	if customer.slot and slotOwner[customer.slot] == customer then
		slotOwner[customer.slot] = nil
	end
	customer.slot = nil
	customer.phase = nextPhase
	customer.phaseStart = os.clock()
	customer.lastMove = 0
	customer.model:SetAttribute("Waiting", false)
end

local function remove(customer: Customer)
	release(customer, "Leaving")
	customers[customer.model] = nil
	customer.model:Destroy()
end

local function spawnCustomer(token: number)
	local slot = freeSlot()
	local origin = spawnPart
	if not slot or not origin or not origin.Parent then
		return
	end
	local day = math.max(GameService.Run.Day, 1)
	local night = Nights.Days[day]
	reserved += 1
	slotOwner[slot] = {} :: any -- placeholder reserves the slot while the rig loads
	local rig = buildRig()
	reserved -= 1
	if not rig or token ~= spawnToken or GameService.GetState() ~= "Day" then
		slotOwner[slot] = nil
		if rig then
			rig:Destroy()
		end
		return
	end

	local humanoid = rig:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	local root = rig:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart
	humanoid.WalkSpeed = Config.Customers.WalkSpeed
	humanoid.DisplayDistanceType = Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
	rig.Name = "Customer"
	rig:PivotTo(origin.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
	rig.Parent = folder
	pcall(root.SetNetworkOwner, root, nil)

	local order = makeOrder(night)
	local patienceTotal = night.Customers.Patience.Base + night.Customers.Patience.PerItem * #order
	local customer: Customer = {
		model = rig,
		humanoid = humanoid,
		root = root,
		slot = slot,
		phase = "Walking",
		order = order,
		total = table.clone(order),
		patience = patienceTotal,
		patienceTotal = patienceTotal,
		phaseStart = os.clock(),
		lastMove = 0,
		paid = 0,
	}
	slotOwner[slot] = customer
	customers[rig] = customer
	publish(customer)
	humanoid.Died:Connect(function()
		if customers[rig] then
			remove(customer)
		end
	end)
end

local function flatDistance(a: Vector3, b: Vector3): number
	return (Vector3.new(a.X, 0, a.Z) - Vector3.new(b.X, 0, b.Z)).Magnitude
end

local function walkTo(customer: Customer, target: Vector3)
	local now = os.clock()
	if now - customer.lastMove >= 1 then
		customer.lastMove = now
		customer.humanoid:MoveTo(target)
	end
end

local function updateCustomer(customer: Customer, now: number)
	if customer.phase == "Walking" then
		local slot = customer.slot
		if not slot then
			return
		end
		if
			flatDistance(customer.root.Position, slot.Position) <= Config.Customers.ArriveDistance
			or now - customer.phaseStart > Config.Customers.WalkTimeout
		then
			if now - customer.phaseStart > Config.Customers.WalkTimeout then
				customer.model:PivotTo(slot.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0)) -- stuck: snap to the slot
			end
			customer.phase = "Waiting"
			publish(customer)
		else
			walkTo(customer, slot.Position)
		end
	elseif customer.phase == "Waiting" then
		customer.patience -= TICK
		if customer.patience <= 0 then
			GameService.Run.Lost += 1
			release(customer, "Leaving")
			publish(customer)
		else
			publish(customer)
		end
	elseif customer.phase == "Leaving" then
		local origin = spawnPart
		local arrived = not origin
			or flatDistance(customer.root.Position, origin.Position) <= Config.Customers.ArriveDistance + 2
		if arrived or now - customer.phaseStart > Config.Customers.LeaveTimeout then
			remove(customer)
		elseif origin then
			walkTo(customer, origin.Position)
		end
	end
end

local function clearAll()
	spawnToken += 1
	for _, customer in customers do
		remove(customer)
	end
	table.clear(slotOwner)
end

-- Serves the most urgent waiting customer who still needs `dish`.
local function serve(player: Player, dish: string): boolean
	local best: Customer? = nil
	local bestIndex = 0
	for _, customer in customers do
		if customer.phase == "Waiting" then
			local index = table.find(customer.order, dish)
			if index and (best == nil or customer.patience < best.patience) then
				best, bestIndex = customer, index
			end
		end
	end
	if not best then
		return false
	end

	table.remove(best.order, bestIndex)
	local price = Recipes.Dishes[dish].Price
	EconomyService.Add(price, player, Enum.AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.Gameplay.Name, "Dish_" .. dish)
	best.paid += price
	local finished = #best.order == 0
	if finished then
		local fraction = math.clamp(best.patience / best.patienceTotal, 0, 1)
		local multiplier = player:GetAttribute("TipMultiplier")
		multiplier = if type(multiplier) == "number" and multiplier >= 1 and multiplier <= 10 then multiplier else 1
		local tip = math.floor(best.paid * Config.Customers.TipRate * fraction * multiplier)
		if tip > 0 then
			EconomyService.Add(tip, player, Enum.AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.Gameplay.Name, "Tip")
		end
		GameService.Run.Served += 1
		release(best, "Leaving")
	end
	publish(best)

	DataService.Update(player, function(data)
		data.Stats.DishesServed += 1
		if finished then
			data.Stats.CustomersServed += 1
		end
	end)
	return true
end

local function setupWindow(window: Instance)
	local prompt = window:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
	if not prompt then
		prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.ActionText = "Serve dish"
		prompt.ObjectText = "Window"
		prompt.HoldDuration = 0
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = Config.Interaction.PromptDistance
		prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
		prompt.Parent = if window:IsA("Model")
			then (window.PrimaryPart or window:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
			else window
	end
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		if GameService.GetState() ~= "Day" and GameService.GetState() ~= "Night" then
			return
		end
		if
			not PlayerUtil.isNear(
				player,
				window,
				Config.Interaction.PromptDistance + Config.Interaction.ServerSlack + 10
			)
		then
			return
		end
		local carried = CarryService.Peek(player)
		if not carried or Recipes.Items[carried].Kind ~= "Dish" then
			Net.fireClient(player, "Notify", "Bring a finished dish")
			return
		end
		if serve(player, carried) then
			CarryService.Clear(player)
		else
			Net.fireClient(player, "Notify", "Nobody ordered that")
		end
	end)
end

local function spawnLoop(token: number)
	local day = GameService.Run.Day
	local night = Nights.Days[day]
	if not night then
		return
	end
	local settings = night.Customers
	-- First customer shows up quickly so the loop starts at once.
	task.wait(2)
	while token == spawnToken do
		if countActive() < math.min(settings.MaxActive, #getSlots()) then
			task.spawn(spawnCustomer, token)
		end
		task.wait(settings.SpawnInterval * rng:NextNumber(0.8, 1.2))
	end
end

function CustomerService.GetWaiting(): number
	local n = 0
	for _, customer in customers do
		if customer.phase == "Waiting" then
			n += 1
		end
	end
	return n
end

function CustomerService.Init()
	local existing = workspace:FindFirstChild("Customers")
	if existing and existing:IsA("Folder") then
		folder = existing
	else
		folder = Instance.new("Folder")
		folder.Name = "Customers"
		folder.Parent = workspace
	end

	GameService.OnStateChanged(function(state)
		if state == "Day" then
			spawnToken += 1
			task.spawn(spawnLoop, spawnToken)
		else
			-- Night, Results and Ready: nobody new arrives; waiting customers go home.
			spawnToken += 1
			for _, customer in customers do
				if customer.phase ~= "Leaving" then
					release(customer, "Leaving")
					publish(customer)
				end
			end
			if state == "Ready" then
				clearAll()
			end
		end
	end)
end

function CustomerService.Start()
	local function findSpawn()
		for _, instance in CollectionService:GetTagged("CustomerSpawn") do
			if instance:IsA("BasePart") then
				spawnPart = instance
				return
			end
		end
	end
	findSpawn()
	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("CustomerSpawn"):Connect(findSpawn)

	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("ServiceWindow"):Connect(setupWindow)
	for _, window in CollectionService:GetTagged("ServiceWindow") do
		setupWindow(window)
	end

	while true do
		task.wait(TICK)
		local now = os.clock()
		for _, customer in customers do
			updateCustomer(customer, now)
		end
	end
end

return CustomerService

--!strict

-- Runs the Studio checks headlessly against live services via Open Cloud: builds the check place
-- with Rojo, uploads it to the test place as a saved version, runs each group as a Luau Execution
-- task against that version and exits non-zero on any failed check, failed task or timeout.
-- The API key comes from ROBLOX_API_KEY and is never printed

local process = require("@lune/process")
local serde = require("@lune/serde")
local stdio = require("@lune/stdio")

local OpenCloud = require("./OpenCloud")

type Result = {
	kind: "pass" | "fail" | "observed",
	name: string,
	detail: string?,
}

type Report = {
	results: { Result },
	pass: number,
	fail: number,
	observed: number,
}

local PROJECT_PATH = "tests/studio/studio.project.json"
local PLACE_PATH = ".cache/live/GeodeStudioCheck.rbxl"
-- one task per group so none of them hits the five minute task limit
local GROUPS = { "services", "contracts", "profile" }
local TASK_TIMEOUT = OpenCloud.TASK_LIMIT
-- How long to wait on one task before calling it failed. A bit over the task's own limit, so a
-- task that ran out of time gets reported by Roblox first
local WAIT_LIMIT = TASK_TIMEOUT + 60

local function taskScript(group: string): string
	return table.concat({
		'local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")',
		'local Checks = require(game:GetService("ServerScriptService").GeodeCheck.tests.studio.Checks)',
		`return HttpService:JSONEncode(Checks.run(\{ "{group}" \}))`,
	}, "\n")
end

local function runGroup(
	client: OpenCloud.Client,
	version: number,
	group: string
): (Report?, string?)
	local started = client.startTask(version, taskScript(group), TASK_TIMEOUT)
	local finished = client.finishTask(started, WAIT_LIMIT)
	for _, line in finished.logs do
		print(`  {line}`)
	end
	if finished.problem then
		return nil, `the {group} task {finished.problem}`
	end
	if finished.result == nil then
		return nil, `the {group} task returned no report`
	end
	return serde.decode("json", finished.result :: string) :: Report, nil
end

local function main()
	local client = OpenCloud.client("live checks")

	print("building the check place")
	client.build(PROJECT_PATH, PLACE_PATH)
	print("uploading it as a saved version")
	local version = client.upload(PLACE_PATH)
	print(`running against version {version}`)

	local passed, failed, observed = {}, {}, {}
	local taskFailures = {}
	for _, group in GROUPS do
		print(`\n{group}:`)
		local report, problem = runGroup(client, version, group)
		if problem then
			table.insert(taskFailures, problem)
			continue
		end
		for _, result in (report :: Report).results do
			local line = if result.detail then `{result.name}: {result.detail}` else result.name
			if result.kind == "pass" then
				table.insert(passed, line)
			elseif result.kind == "fail" then
				table.insert(failed, line)
			else
				table.insert(observed, line)
			end
		end
	end

	print(`\n{#passed} passed, {#failed} failed, {#observed} observed`)
	if #observed > 0 then
		print("\nobserved, not judged:")
		for _, line in observed do
			print(`  {line}`)
		end
	end
	for _, line in failed do
		stdio.ewrite(`FAIL {line}\n`)
	end
	for _, problem in taskFailures do
		stdio.ewrite(`TASK {problem}\n`)
	end
	if #failed > 0 or #taskFailures > 0 then
		process.exit(1)
	end
end

main()

-- .lune/live.luau requires this, and a module has to return one value
return nil

-- Last verified: 2026-06-17
-- Test coverage: no automated coverage
