--[[
UIParticlePool.lua
Simple 2D UI particle pool using ImageLabels + TweenService.

Usage (client LocalScript or module):
local UIParticlePool = require(path.to.UIParticlePool)
local pool = UIParticlePool.new(parentFrame, { poolSize = 40 })

pool:emit({
    texture = "rbxassetid://...",
    count = 12,
    lifetime = 0.8,
    velocity = NumberRange.new(0.1, 0.2), -- scale units per second
    size = UDim2.fromScale(0.04, 0.04),
    color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 220, 100),
    spread = Vector2.new(1, 0.5),         -- random direction multiplier
})

Cleanup:
pool:destroy()
]]

local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")

export type UIParticlePoolOptions = {
    poolSize: number?,
    maxActive: number?,
    zIndex: number?,
}

export type UIParticleConfig = {
    texture: string?,
    count: number?,
    lifetime: number?,
    velocity: NumberRange | number?, -- scale units per second
    size: UDim2?,
    color: Color3?,
    spread: Vector2?,
    origin: UDim2?,
    startTransparency: number?,
    endTransparency: number?,
    rotation: number?,
    spin: number?,
}

local UIParticlePool = {}
UIParticlePool.__index = UIParticlePool

export type UIParticlePool = typeof(setmetatable(
    {} :: {
        _parent: GuiObject?,
        _pool: { ImageLabel },
        _active: { [ImageLabel]: boolean },
        _tweens: { [ImageLabel]: Tween },
        _connections: { [Tween]: RBXScriptConnection },
        _maxActive: number,
        _zIndex: number,
        _activeCount: number,
        _destroyed: boolean,
    },
    UIParticlePool
))

local function randomInRange(range: NumberRange | number): number
    if typeof(range) == "NumberRange" then
        return range.Min + math.random() * (range.Max - range.Min)
    end
    return range
end

local function createLabel(parent: GuiObject, zIndex: number): ImageLabel
    local label = Instance.new("ImageLabel")
    label.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    label.Visible = false
    label.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
    label.ZIndex = zIndex
    label.Parent = parent
    return label
end

function UIParticlePool.new(parent: GuiObject, options: UIParticlePoolOptions?): UIParticlePool
    assert(
        typeof(parent) == "Instance" and parent:IsA("GuiObject"),
        "UIParticlePool.new expects a GuiObject parent"
    )
    local resolvedOptions: UIParticlePoolOptions = options or {}

    local self = setmetatable({}, UIParticlePool) :: UIParticlePool
    self._parent = parent
    self._pool = {}
    self._active = {}
    self._tweens = {}
    self._connections = {}
    self._maxActive = resolvedOptions.maxActive or 80
    self._zIndex = resolvedOptions.zIndex or 10
    self._activeCount = 0
    self._destroyed = false

    local initialSize = resolvedOptions.poolSize or math.max(30, self._maxActive)
    initialSize = math.min(initialSize, self._maxActive)

    for _ = 1, initialSize do
        table.insert(self._pool, createLabel(parent, self._zIndex))
    end

    return self
end

function UIParticlePool._acquire(self: UIParticlePool): ImageLabel?
    for _, label in ipairs(self._pool) do
        if not self._active[label] then
            return label
        end
    end

    if #self._pool < self._maxActive then
        local parent = self._parent
        assert(parent, "Cannot acquire a particle from a destroyed UIParticlePool")
        local label = createLabel(parent, self._zIndex)
        table.insert(self._pool, label)
        return label
    end

    return nil
end

function UIParticlePool._cleanupTween(self: UIParticlePool, label: ImageLabel)
    local tween = self._tweens[label]
    if tween then
        local conn = self._connections[tween]
        if conn then
            conn:Disconnect()
            self._connections[tween] = nil
        end
        tween:Cancel()
        self._tweens[label] = nil
    end
end

function UIParticlePool._release(self: UIParticlePool, label: ImageLabel)
    self:_cleanupTween(label)
    if self._active[label] then
        self._active[label] = nil
        self._activeCount -= 1
    end
    label.Visible = false
    label.Image = ""
end

function UIParticlePool.emit(self: UIParticlePool, config: UIParticleConfig?)
    assert(not self._destroyed, "Cannot emit from a destroyed UIParticlePool")
    local resolvedConfig: UIParticleConfig = config or {}

    local count = math.min(resolvedConfig.count or 10, self._maxActive - self._activeCount)
    if count <= 0 then
        return
    end

    local texture = resolvedConfig.texture or ""
    local lifetime = resolvedConfig.lifetime or 0.6
    local size = resolvedConfig.size or UDim2.fromScale(0.05, 0.05)
    local color = resolvedConfig.color or Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    local spread = resolvedConfig.spread or Vector2.new(1, 1)
    local origin = resolvedConfig.origin or UDim2.fromScale(0.5, 0.5)
    local velocityRange = resolvedConfig.velocity or NumberRange.new(0.1, 0.2)
    local fadeInfo = TweenInfo.new(lifetime, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)

    for _ = 1, count do
        local label = self:_acquire()
        if not label then
            break
        end

        self._active[label] = true
        self._activeCount += 1

        label.Image = texture
        label.ImageColor3 = color
        label.ImageTransparency = resolvedConfig.startTransparency or 0
        label.Rotation = resolvedConfig.rotation or math.random(0, 360)
        label.Size = size
        label.Position = origin
        label.Visible = true

        local angle = math.random() * math.pi * 2
        local speed = randomInRange(velocityRange)
        local distance = speed * lifetime

        local offset = UDim2.fromScale(
            spread.X * math.cos(angle) * distance,
            spread.Y * math.sin(angle) * distance
        )
        local goal = {
            Position = origin + offset,
            ImageTransparency = resolvedConfig.endTransparency or 1,
            Rotation = label.Rotation + (resolvedConfig.spin or math.random(-90, 90)),
        }

        local tween = TweenService:Create(label, fadeInfo, goal)
        self._tweens[label] = tween
        self._connections[tween] = tween.Completed:Once(function()
            self:_release(label)
        end)
        tween:Play()
    end
end

function UIParticlePool.destroy(self: UIParticlePool)
    self._destroyed = true

    for _, label in ipairs(self._pool) do
        self:_cleanupTween(label)
        label:Destroy()
    end

    table.clear(self._pool)
    table.clear(self._active)
    table.clear(self._tweens)
    table.clear(self._connections)
    self._activeCount = 0
    self._parent = nil
end

return UIParticlePool

-- Player data with session locking: only the server that holds a player's lock may
-- write their data, which prevents duplication and rollbacks when players hop servers.
--
-- DataService.Get(player)            -> data table or nil while loading
-- DataService.WaitFor(player, 15)    -> data table or nil on timeout / player left
-- DataService.Update(player, fn)     -> mutate data inside fn; syncs to the client
-- DataService.Save(player)           -> true when written (autosave runs on its own)
-- DataService.OnChanged(callback)    -> callback(player, data) after load and every Update

local DataStoreService = game:GetService("DataStoreService")
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net)

local DataService = {}

type Profile = { Data: any, Saving: boolean, LockLost: boolean }

local settings = Config.Data
local SERVER_ID = if game.JobId ~= "" then game.JobId else HttpService:GenerateGUID(false)

local store: DataStore? = nil
local mockStore: { [string]: any } = {}
local profiles: { [Player]: Profile } = {}
local releasing: { [number]: boolean } = {} -- UserIds whose lock is being released
local activeSaves = 0
local changedCallbacks: { (Player, any) -> () } = {}

local function deepCopy(value: any): any
	if type(value) ~= "table" then
		return value
	end
	local copy = {}
	for key, item in value do
		copy[deepCopy(key)] = deepCopy(item)
	end
	return copy
end

-- Fill in fields that were added to DefaultData after the player last saved.
local function reconcile(data: any, defaults: any)
	for key, default in defaults do
		if data[key] == nil then
			data[key] = deepCopy(default)
		elseif type(default) == "table" and type(data[key]) == "table" then
			reconcile(data[key], default)
		end
	end
end

local function migrate(data: any)
	local version = data.Version or 1
	while version < settings.Version do
		version += 1
		local migration = settings.Migrations[version]
		if migration then
			migration(data)
		end
		data.Version = version
	end
end

local function keyFor(player: Player): string
	return settings.KeyPrefix .. player.UserId
end

-- UpdateAsync with a mock fallback. transform returns nil to cancel the write.
local function update(key: string, transform: (any) -> any): (boolean, string?)
	local dataStore = store
	if dataStore then
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			dataStore:UpdateAsync(key, transform)
		end)
		return ok, if ok then nil else tostring(err)
	end
	local result = transform(deepCopy(mockStore[key]))
	if result ~= nil then
		mockStore[key] = deepCopy(result)
	end
	return true, nil
end

local function notifyChanged(player: Player, data: any)
	Net.fireClient(player, "DataSync", data)
	for _, callback in changedCallbacks do
		task.spawn(callback, player, data)
	end
end

local function loadData(player: Player): any
	local key = keyFor(player)
	-- Rejoined this same server while the previous session was still releasing.
	while releasing[player.UserId] and player.Parent do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	for attempt = 1, settings.LoadRetries do
		local acquired = false
		local loaded = nil
		local ok, err = update(key, function(old)
			acquired = false
			local now = os.time()
			local record = if type(old) == "table" then old else {}
			local lock = record.Lock
			if lock and lock.ServerId ~= SERVER_ID and now - (lock.Time or 0) < settings.LockExpireSeconds then
				return nil -- another server still owns this player's data
			end
			if type(record.Data) ~= "table" then
				record.Data = deepCopy(Config.DefaultData)
			end
			record.Lock = { ServerId = SERVER_ID, Time = now }
			acquired = true
			loaded = record.Data
			return record
		end)
		if ok and acquired then
			return loaded
		end
		if not ok then
			warn(`[DataService] Load attempt {attempt} failed for {player.UserId}: {err}`)
		end
		if player.Parent == nil then
			return nil
		end
		task.wait(2 * attempt)
	end
	return nil
end

-- Writes the profile's data; release = true also drops the lock (player left / server closing).
local function saveProfile(player: Player, profile: Profile, release: boolean): boolean
	if profile.LockLost then
		return false
	end
	activeSaves += 1 -- counted before waiting so BindToClose never sees a gap
	while profile.Saving do
		task.wait()
	end
	profile.Saving = true
	local snapshot = deepCopy(profile.Data)
	local wrote = false
	local ok, err = update(keyFor(player), function(old)
		wrote = false
		if type(old) ~= "table" or not old.Lock or old.Lock.ServerId ~= SERVER_ID then
			return nil -- lock was taken over: never overwrite the newer session
		end
		old.Data = snapshot
		old.Lock = if release then nil else { ServerId = SERVER_ID, Time = os.time() }
		wrote = true
		return old
	end)
	profile.Saving = false
	activeSaves -= 1
	if not ok then
		warn(`[DataService] Save failed for {player.UserId}: {err}`)
		return false
	end
	if not wrote then
		profile.LockLost = true
		warn(`[DataService] Lost the session lock for {player.UserId}; data not saved here`)
		if player.Parent then
			player:Kick("Your data was opened on another server. Please rejoin.")
		end
	end
	return wrote
end

-- Final save + unlock. The profile is removed first so no autosave or Update touches it again.
local function releaseProfile(player: Player)
	local profile = profiles[player]
	if not profile then
		return
	end
	profiles[player] = nil
	releasing[player.UserId] = true
	saveProfile(player, profile, true)
	releasing[player.UserId] = nil
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player: Player)
	local data = loadData(player)
	if not data then
		if player.Parent then
			player:Kick("Could not load your data. Please rejoin in a moment.")
		end
		return
	end
	migrate(data)
	reconcile(data, Config.DefaultData)
	profiles[player] = { Data = data, Saving = false, LockLost = false }
	if player.Parent == nil then
		-- Left while loading: release the lock straight away.
		releaseProfile(player)
		return
	end
	notifyChanged(player, data)
end

function DataService.Get(player: Player): any
	local profile = profiles[player]
	return if profile then profile.Data else nil
end

function DataService.WaitFor(player: Player, timeout: number?): any
	local deadline = os.clock() + (timeout or 15)
	while not profiles[player] and player.Parent and os.clock() < deadline do
		task.wait(0.1)
	end
	return DataService.Get(player)
end

-- fn must not yield. Returns false if the player's data is not loaded.
function DataService.Update(player: Player, fn: (data: any) -> ()): boolean
	local data = DataService.Get(player)
	if not data then
		return false
	end
	fn(data)
	notifyChanged(player, data)
	return true
end

function DataService.Save(player: Player): boolean
	local profile = profiles[player]
	return if profile then saveProfile(player, profile, false) else false
end

function DataService.OnChanged(callback: (Player, any) -> ())
	table.insert(changedCallbacks, callback)
end

function DataService.Init()
	local dataStore = DataStoreService:GetDataStore(settings.StoreName)
	store = dataStore
	if RunService:IsStudio() and settings.UseMockInStudio then
		local ok = pcall(function()
			dataStore:GetAsync("__probe")
		end)
		if not ok then
			store = nil
			warn("[DataService] DataStores unavailable in Studio: using an in-memory store (nothing is saved).")
		end
	end
end

function DataService.Start()
	Net.handleInvoke("GetData", {}, function(player)
		return DataService.Get(player)
	end)

	Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(releaseProfile)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		task.spawn(onPlayerAdded, player)
	end

	task.spawn(function()
		while true do
			task.wait(settings.AutosaveInterval)
			for player, profile in profiles do
				task.spawn(saveProfile, player, profile, false)
			end
		end
	end)

	game:BindToClose(function()
		for player in profiles do
			task.spawn(releaseProfile, player)
		end
		-- Also waits for releases started by PlayerRemoving during shutdown.
		local deadline = os.clock() + 25
		while (next(profiles) ~= nil or activeSaves > 0) and os.clock() < deadline do
			task.wait()
		end
	end)
end

return DataService

--!strict
-- Status: experimental
-- Last verified: 2026-06-17
-- Test coverage: no automated coverage
-- Intended use: example; adapt and test before production.

--[[
    EffectBurst.lua

    Clone-and-destroy helper for one-shot particle bursts.

    Given a template ParticleEmitter (or a BasePart/Attachment that contains
    emitters), this module clones the emitters, parents them, emits a burst,
    and automatically cleans them up after the longest possible lifetime.

    Why clone-and-destroy?
    - The shared live emitter is never mutated, so there is no race condition
      between bursts and no gap in continuous emitters.
    - One-shot effects become self-contained instances that can outlive their
      caller and be destroyed safely when finished.

    Most one-shot effects should be emitted on the client only. Spawn the
    clone locally and call :Emit() from a LocalScript/Client module. This
    avoids replicating individual particles across the network and keeps
    authoritative ownership simple: the server tells the client *that* an
    effect happened (e.g. via a remote event); the client decides *how* to
    render it.

    Example:
        local EffectBurst = require(path.to.EffectBurst)
        EffectBurst.emitFrom(templateAttachment, {
            count = 25,
            clear = true, -- clear any existing particles before bursting
        })
]]

export type BurstConfig = {
    count: number?,
    clear: boolean?,
    parent: Instance?,
}

local DEFAULT_CONFIG: BurstConfig = {
    count = 20,
    clear = false,
}

local Debris = game:GetService("Debris")

local function getMaxLifetime(emitter: ParticleEmitter): number
    local lifetime = emitter.Lifetime
    if typeof(lifetime) == "NumberRange" then
        return lifetime.Max
    end
    return tonumber(lifetime) or 1
end

local function cloneAndBurst(templateEmitter: ParticleEmitter, config: BurstConfig): ParticleEmitter
    local clone: ParticleEmitter = templateEmitter:Clone()
    clone.Name ..= "_Burst"
    clone.Enabled = false
    clone.Rate = 0

    local burstParent = config.parent or templateEmitter.Parent
    if burstParent then
        clone.Parent = burstParent
    end

    if config.clear then
        clone:Clear()
    end

    local count = config.count or DEFAULT_CONFIG.count
    clone:Emit(count)

    local maxLifetime = getMaxLifetime(clone)
    Debris:AddItem(clone, maxLifetime)

    return clone
end

local function findTemplates(parent: Instance): { ParticleEmitter }
    local templates: { ParticleEmitter } = {}
    for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetDescendants()) do
        if child:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
            table.insert(templates, child)
        end
    end
    return templates
end

local EffectBurst = {}

-- Emit from every ParticleEmitter found inside `parent`.
function EffectBurst.emitFrom(parent: Instance?, config: BurstConfig?): { ParticleEmitter }
    local resolvedConfig = config or DEFAULT_CONFIG
    local clones: { ParticleEmitter } = {}

    if not parent then
        return clones
    end

    local templates = findTemplates(parent)
    for _, templateEmitter in ipairs(templates) do
        local clone = cloneAndBurst(templateEmitter, resolvedConfig)
        table.insert(clones, clone)
    end

    return clones
end

-- Emit from a single ParticleEmitter template.
function EffectBurst.emitFromEmitter(
    templateEmitter: ParticleEmitter?,
    config: BurstConfig?
): ParticleEmitter?
    if not templateEmitter then
        return nil
    end

    local resolvedConfig = config or DEFAULT_CONFIG
    return cloneAndBurst(templateEmitter, resolvedConfig)
end

return EffectBurst

--!strict

-- Starts the cloud side of the messaging probe: a Luau Execution task on the test place's latest
-- version that runs tests/studio/MessagingProbe.luau on one topic and reports what it heard.
-- Start a Studio playtest of the same place while it runs and call the probe there with the
-- role "studio" and the topic printed below. The key comes from ROBLOX_API_KEY, never printed
--
--   lune run scripts/messaging-probe [seconds]

local fs = require("@lune/fs")
local net = require("@lune/net")
local process = require("@lune/process")
local serde = require("@lune/serde")
local stdio = require("@lune/stdio")
local task = require("@lune/task")

local CONFIG_PATH = "tests/studio/live.json"
local PROBE_PATH = "tests/studio/MessagingProbe.luau"
local API = "https://apis.roblox.com"
local DEFAULT_SECONDS = 200
-- leaves room under the five minute task limit for the probe's own wind down
local MAX_SECONDS = 270
local POLL_INTERVAL = 5

local function fail(message: string): never
	stdio.ewrite(`messaging probe: {message}\n`)
	process.exit(1)
	error("unreachable")
end

local function call(key: string, method: "GET" | "POST", path: string, body: string?): any
	local headers: { [string]: string } =
		{ ["x-api-key"] = key, ["content-type"] = "application/json" }
	local response = net.request({
		url = API .. path,
		method = method :: any,
		headers = headers,
		body = body,
	})
	if not response.ok then
		fail(
			`{method} {path} answered {response.statusCode} {response.statusMessage}: {response.body}`
		)
	end
	return if response.body == "" then nil else serde.decode("json", response.body)
end

-- The task runs against whatever version is live, so the probe goes in as source rather than
-- as a module of an uploaded place
local function taskScript(topic: string, seconds: number): string
	local source = fs.readFile(PROBE_PATH)
	return table.concat({
		"local Probe = (function()",
		source,
		"end)()",
		`local result = Probe.run("{topic}", "cloud", {seconds})`,
		'return game:GetService("HttpService"):JSONEncode(result)',
	}, "\n")
end

local function main()
	local key = process.env.ROBLOX_API_KEY
	if key == nil or key == "" then
		fail("ROBLOX_API_KEY isn't set")
	end
	local config = serde.decode("json", fs.readFile(CONFIG_PATH))
	local seconds = math.min(tonumber(process.args[1]) or DEFAULT_SECONDS, MAX_SECONDS)
	local topic = `geode-check-probe-{os.time()}`

	local created = call(
		key :: string,
		"POST",
		`/cloud/v2/universes/{config.universeId}/places/{config.placeId}/luau-execution-session-tasks`,
		serde.encode("json", { script = taskScript(topic, seconds), timeout = "300s" })
	)
	print(`topic {topic}`)
	print(`cloud side listening for {seconds} seconds, start the Studio side now`)

	local path = created.path :: string
	local current = created
	local started = os.clock()
	while
		current.state ~= "COMPLETE"
		and current.state ~= "FAILED"
		and current.state ~= "CANCELLED"
	do
		if os.clock() - started > 360 then
			fail("the task didn't finish in time")
		end
		task.wait(POLL_INTERVAL)
		current = call(key :: string, "GET", `/cloud/v2/{path}`)
	end

	local logs = call(key :: string, "GET", `/cloud/v2/{path}/logs`)
	for _, chunk in logs and logs.luauExecutionSessionTaskLogs or {} do
		for _, line in chunk.messages or {} do
			print(`  {line}`)
		end
	end
	if current.state ~= "COMPLETE" then
		fail(`the task ended {current.state}: {current.error and current.error.message or "?"}`)
	end
	local results = current.output and current.output.results
	print(`cloud result {results and results[1] or "none"}`)
end

main()

return nil

-- Team cash for the current run (not saved). Replicates as workspace attribute "Cash".
-- Plan: SYS-05 (payment and tips); SYS-11 will extend it with rewards and the upgrade shop.
--
-- EconomyService.Get()                              -> cash
-- EconomyService.Add(amount, player?, txType, sku)  -> boolean
-- EconomyService.Spend(amount, player?, txType, sku)-> boolean (false and no change if too poor)
-- `player` is only used to attribute the analytics event.

local AnalyticsService = game:GetService("AnalyticsService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local GameService = require(script.Parent.GameService)

local EconomyService = {}

local CURRENCY = "Cash"

local function isAmount(amount: any): boolean
	return type(amount) == "number"
		and amount == amount
		and amount > 0
		and amount < 1e9
		and math.floor(amount) == amount
end

local function logEvent(
	player: Player?,
	flow: Enum.AnalyticsEconomyFlowType,
	amount: number,
	txType: string,
	sku: string
)
	if not player or player.Parent == nil then
		return
	end
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		-- Order per create.roblox.com: currencyType, amount, endingBalance.
		AnalyticsService:LogEconomyEvent(player, flow, CURRENCY, amount, EconomyService.Get(), txType, sku)
	end)
	if not ok then
		warn(`[EconomyService] LogEconomyEvent failed: {err}`)
	end
end

function EconomyService.Get(): number
	return workspace:GetAttribute(CURRENCY) or 0
end

function EconomyService.Add(amount: number, player: Player?, txType: string?, sku: string?): boolean
	if not isAmount(amount) then
		return false
	end
	workspace:SetAttribute(CURRENCY, EconomyService.Get() + amount)
	GameService.Run.Earned += amount
	logEvent(
		player,
		Enum.AnalyticsEconomyFlowType.Source,
		amount,
		txType or Enum.AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.Gameplay.Name,
		sku or "Unknown"
	)
	return true
end

function EconomyService.Spend(amount: number, player: Player?, txType: string?, sku: string?): boolean
	if not isAmount(amount) or EconomyService.Get() < amount then
		return false
	end
	workspace:SetAttribute(CURRENCY, EconomyService.Get() - amount)
	logEvent(
		player,
		Enum.AnalyticsEconomyFlowType.Sink,
		amount,
		txType or Enum.AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.Gameplay.Name,
		sku or "Unknown"
	)
	return true
end

function EconomyService.Init()
	workspace:SetAttribute(CURRENCY, Config.Run.StartCash)
	GameService.OnStateChanged(function(state)
		if state == "Ready" then
			workspace:SetAttribute(CURRENCY, Config.Run.StartCash)
		end
	end)
end

return EconomyService

--!strict

-- Client side of replication. Holds the data the server shares with this player, read only,
-- and exposes it as atoms you can read, subscribe to and combine. Writes go through declared
-- remote ops, never straight to state

local Document = require("./Matrix/Document")
local Path = require("./Matrix/Path")
local RealServices = require("./Quartz/Real/Services")
local Tree = require("./Matrix/Tree")
local Types = require("./Quartz/Types")

type PathLike = Path.PathLike

export type Atom<T> = {
	get: (self: Atom<T>) -> T,
	subscribe: (self: Atom<T>, callback: (new: T, old: T) -> ()) -> Types.Connection,
}

-- All `charm` needs from Charm: a function that makes an atom, and atoms that read when
-- called with nothing and write when called with a value
export type CharmLike = {
	atom: (initial: any) -> any,
}

type Fields = {
	userId: number,
	_services: Types.ClientServices,
	_replication: Types.ClientRemote,
	_ops: Types.ClientRemote?,
	_owners: { [number]: Document.Document },
	_ready: boolean,
	_readyWaiters: { thread },
}

--[=[
	@class GeodeClient

	Client side of Geode: atoms over the data the server shares with this player. Start it
	with `Geode.Client.start` from a LocalScript
]=]
local GeodeClient = {}
GeodeClient.__index = GeodeClient

export type GeodeClient = typeof(setmetatable({} :: Fields, GeodeClient))

local REPLICATION_REMOTE = "GeodeReplication"
local OPS_REMOTE = "GeodeOps"

-- atoms read inside a `computed` body land here, innermost computation last
local tracking: { { [any]: boolean } } = {}

--[=[
	Connects to the server and asks for a snapshot. Yields until the remotes exist. Tests pass
	client services, live code leaves them out

	@within GeodeClient
]=]
function GeodeClient.start(services: Types.ClientServices?): GeodeClient
	local resolved = services or RealServices.client()
	local self = setmetatable(
		{
			userId = resolved.userId,
			_services = resolved,
			_replication = resolved.remote(REPLICATION_REMOTE),
			_ops = nil,
			_owners = {},
			_ready = false,
			_readyWaiters = {},
		} :: Fields,
		GeodeClient
	)
	self._replication:onEvent(function(changes: unknown)
		self:_apply(changes)
	end)
	self._replication:fire({ kind = "ready" })
	return self
end

function GeodeClient._owner(self: GeodeClient, owner: number): Document.Document
	-- unknown first: Luau won't compare the Document class type with nil
	local existing: unknown = self._owners[owner]
	if existing == nil then
		self._owners[owner] = Document.new({ data = {} })
	end
	return self._owners[owner]
end

function GeodeClient._apply(self: GeodeClient, changes: unknown)
	if type(changes) ~= "table" then
		return
	end
	-- Staged per player, committed once at the end. Otherwise a resync sending the same values
	-- makes subscribers see them vanish and come back
	local staged: { [number]: unknown } = {}
	local function stage(owner: number): unknown
		if staged[owner] == nil then
			local existing: unknown = self._owners[owner]
			staged[owner] = if existing ~= nil then self._owners[owner]:snapshot() else {}
		end
		return staged[owner]
	end
	for _, change in changes :: { any } do
		if change.op == "reset" then
			for owner in self._owners do
				staged[owner] = {}
			end
			for owner in staged do
				staged[owner] = {}
			end
		elseif change.op == "drop" then
			staged[change.owner] = {}
		elseif change.op == "set" then
			staged[change.owner] =
				Tree.set(stage(change.owner), Path.parse(change.path), change.value)
		end
	end
	for owner, state in staged do
		self:_owner(owner):transact(function(tx)
			tx:set({}, state)
		end)
	end
	if not self._ready then
		self._ready = true
		local waiting = self._readyWaiters
		self._readyWaiters = {}
		for _, thread in waiting do
			self._services.clock:resume(thread)
		end
	end
end

--[=[
	Whether the first snapshot has arrived
]=]
function GeodeClient.isReady(self: GeodeClient): boolean
	return self._ready
end

--[=[
	Yields until the first snapshot arrives
]=]
function GeodeClient.waitUntilReady(self: GeodeClient)
	if self._ready then
		return
	end
	table.insert(self._readyWaiters, coroutine.running())
	coroutine.yield()
end

--[=[
	Asks for a full snapshot again, for when the client suspects it missed something
]=]
function GeodeClient.resync(self: GeodeClient)
	self._replication:fire({ kind = "resync" })
end

-- Atoms

local function track(atom: any)
	local current = tracking[#tracking]
	if current then
		current[atom] = true
	end
end

--[=[
	The value at `path` of a player's shared data, your own by default. Nil until it arrives or
	when the server doesn't share it with you

	@within GeodeClient
]=]
function GeodeClient.atom(self: GeodeClient, path: PathLike, userId: number?): Atom<any>
	local document = self:_owner(userId or self.userId)
	local atom = {} :: Atom<any>
	function atom.get(_atom: Atom<any>): any
		track(atom)
		return document:get(path)
	end
	function atom.subscribe(
		_atom: Atom<any>,
		callback: (new: any, old: any) -> ()
	): Types.Connection
		return document:observe(path, function(new: unknown, old: unknown)
			callback(new, old)
		end)
	end
	return atom
end

--[=[
	An atom computed from other atoms. It reruns when any atom it read changes, and notifies only
	when its result changed

	@within GeodeClient
]=]
function GeodeClient.computed<T>(_self: GeodeClient, compute: () -> T): Atom<T>
	local value: T
	local subscribers: { (new: T, old: T) -> () } = {}
	local connections: { Types.Connection } = {}
	local atom = {} :: Atom<T>

	local evaluate: () -> ()
	function evaluate()
		for _, connection in connections do
			connection:disconnect()
		end
		table.clear(connections)
		local reads: { [any]: boolean } = {}
		table.insert(tracking, reads)
		local ok, result = pcall(compute)
		table.remove(tracking)
		-- subscribe even if compute failed, so a later change can revive the atom
		for source in reads do
			table.insert(
				connections,
				(source :: Atom<any>):subscribe(function()
					evaluate()
				end)
			)
		end
		if not ok then
			error(result, 0)
		end
		local old = value
		value = result
		if not Tree.equal(old, value) then
			for _, callback in table.clone(subscribers) do
				callback(value, old)
			end
		end
	end
	evaluate()

	function atom.get(_atom: Atom<T>): T
		track(atom)
		return value
	end
	function atom.subscribe(_atom: Atom<T>, callback: (new: T, old: T) -> ()): Types.Connection
		table.insert(subscribers, callback)
		return {
			disconnect = function(_connection: Types.Connection)
				local index = table.find(subscribers, callback)
				if index then
					table.remove(subscribers, index)
				end
			end,
		}
	end
	return atom
end

--[=[
	Calls back with the new and old value whenever `path` changes

	@within GeodeClient
]=]
function GeodeClient.observe(
	self: GeodeClient,
	path: PathLike,
	callback: (new: any, old: any) -> (),
	userId: number?
): Types.Connection
	return self:atom(path, userId):subscribe(callback)
end

--// intent and adapters

--[=[
	Asks the server to run a remote op on your own data. The server checks the rate limit and
	the arguments, then runs its guards, so the request can be refused without any answer

	@within GeodeClient
]=]
function GeodeClient.op(self: GeodeClient, name: string, ...: any)
	local ops = self._ops
	if ops == nil then
		ops = self._services.remote(OPS_REMOTE)
		self._ops = ops
	end
	(ops :: Types.ClientRemote):fire(name, ...)
end

--[=[
	Makes Charm atoms that follow replicated paths. You pass the Charm module in, Geode has no
	dependency on it

	@within GeodeClient
]=]
function GeodeClient.charm(
	self: GeodeClient,
	charm: CharmLike
): { atom: (path: PathLike, userId: number?) -> any }
	return {
		atom = function(path: PathLike, userId: number?): any
			local source = self:atom(path, userId)
			local charmAtom = charm.atom(source:get())
			source:subscribe(function(new: any)
				charmAtom(new)
			end)
			return charmAtom
		end,
	}
end

return GeodeClient

-- SOFTWARE.

-- Run state machine: Ready -> (Day -> Night -> Shop) x Config.Run.Days -> Results -> Ready
-- (no Shop after the last night).
-- Plan: SYS-02, SYS-11 (Shop phase)
--
-- State replicates through workspace attributes (no remote needed):
--   GameState ("Ready" | "Day" | "Night" | "Shop" | "Results"), StateEndsAt (GetServerTimeNow, 0 = untimed), Day (0 when idle)
--
-- GameService.GetState()            -> state name
-- GameService.Run                   -> { Day, Served, Lost, Earned, Result, Reason } for the current/last run
-- GameService.OnStateChanged(cb)    -> cb(state, day); register in Init so no change is missed
-- GameService.Lose(reason)          -> ends the run as lost (truck destroyed, SYS-07); ignored outside a run
-- GameService.SkipNight()           -> ends the current night early (all waves cleared, SYS-06)

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net)
local Nights = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Nights)
local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)

local GameService = {}

export type RunInfo = {
	Day: number,
	Served: number,
	Lost: number,
	Earned: number,
	Result: string?,
	Reason: string?,
}

local state = "Ready"
local callbacks: { (string, number) -> () } = {}
local lostReason: string? = nil
local skipRequested = false

GameService.Run = { Day = 0, Served = 0, Lost = 0, Earned = 0, Result = nil, Reason = nil } :: RunInfo

local function resetRun()
	local run = GameService.Run
	run.Day, run.Served, run.Lost, run.Earned, run.Result, run.Reason = 0, 0, 0, 0, nil, nil
	lostReason = nil
	skipRequested = false
end

local function setState(newState: string, duration: number)
	state = newState
	workspace:SetAttribute("GameState", newState)
	workspace:SetAttribute("Day", GameService.Run.Day)
	workspace:SetAttribute("StateEndsAt", if duration > 0 then workspace:GetServerTimeNow() + duration else 0)
	for _, callback in callbacks do
		task.spawn(callback, newState, GameService.Run.Day)
	end
end

-- Waits `duration` seconds; returns false as soon as abortCheck() is true.
local function waitTimed(duration: number, abortCheck: () -> boolean): boolean
	local deadline = os.clock() + duration
	while os.clock() < deadline do
		if abortCheck() then
			return false
		end
		task.wait(0.25)
	end
	return not abortCheck()
end

local function enoughPlayers(): boolean
	return #Players:GetPlayers() >= Config.Run.MinPlayers
end

local function phaseAborted(): boolean
	return lostReason ~= nil or skipRequested or not enoughPlayers()
end

local function recordStats(won: boolean, day: number)
	for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
		DataService.Update(player, function(data)
			local stats = data.Stats
			if won then
				stats.RunsWon += 1
			else
				stats.RunsLost += 1
			end
			stats.BestDay = math.max(stats.BestDay, day)
		end)
	end
end

-- Returns true when the run ended with a result worth showing (won or lost).
local function playRun(): boolean
	resetRun()
	local run = GameService.Run
	for day = 1, Config.Run.Days do
		local night = Nights.Days[day]
		run.Day = day

		setState("Day", night.DayDuration)
		if not waitTimed(night.DayDuration, phaseAborted) and not enoughPlayers() then
			return false
		end
		if lostReason then
			break
		end
		skipRequested = false

		setState("Night", night.NightDuration)
		if not waitTimed(night.NightDuration, phaseAborted) and not enoughPlayers() then
			return false
		end
		if lostReason then
			break
		end
		skipRequested = false

		if day < Config.Run.Days then
			setState("Shop", Config.Run.ShopSeconds)
			if not waitTimed(Config.Run.ShopSeconds, phaseAborted) and not enoughPlayers() then
				return false
			end
			if lostReason then
				break
			end
			skipRequested = false
		end
	end

	local won = lostReason == nil
	run.Result = if won then "Won" else "Lost"
	run.Reason = lostReason
	recordStats(won, run.Day)
	setState("Results", Config.Run.ResultsSeconds)
	Net.fireAll("RunResult", {
		Won = won,
		Day = run.Day,
		Served = run.Served,
		Lost = run.Lost,
		Earned = run.Earned,
		Reason = lostReason,
	})
	waitTimed(Config.Run.ResultsSeconds, function()
		return not enoughPlayers()
	end)
	return true
end

function GameService.GetState(): string
	return state
end

function GameService.OnStateChanged(callback: (string, number) -> ())
	table.insert(callbacks, callback)
end

function GameService.Lose(reason: string?)
	if (state == "Day" or state == "Night") and lostReason == nil then
		lostReason = reason or "Lost"
	end
end

function GameService.SkipNight()
	if state == "Night" then
		skipRequested = true
	end
end

function GameService.Init() end

function GameService.Start()
	while true do
		resetRun()
		setState("Ready", 0)
		while not enoughPlayers() do
			task.wait(0.5)
		end
		setState("Ready", Config.Run.ReadySeconds)
		if waitTimed(Config.Run.ReadySeconds, function()
			return not enoughPlayers()
		end) then
			playRun()
		end
	end
end

return GameService

local ROUNDING_PRECISION = 1e9
local function roundToPrecision(value)
	return if value >= 0 then math.floor(value * ROUNDING_PRECISION + 0.5) / ROUNDING_PRECISION else math.ceil(value * ROUNDING_PRECISION - 0.5) / ROUNDING_PRECISION
end
local function resolveSteppedValue(current, direction, step, min, max)
	if direction == "decrement" and min ~= nil and current <= min then
		return nil
	end
	if direction == "increment" and max ~= nil and current >= max then
		return nil
	end
	local candidate = if direction == "increment" then current + step else current - step
	candidate = roundToPrecision(candidate)
	if min ~= nil and candidate < min then
		candidate = min
	end
	if max ~= nil and candidate > max then
		candidate = max
	end
	return candidate
end
return {
	resolveSteppedValue = resolveSteppedValue,
}

--!strict

-- Data that keeps itself consistent: bundles normalize a group of fields together, reactions
-- write one thing when another changes, derived fields are computed on read. Bundles and
-- reactions run inside the triggering transaction, so guards see their writes and a
-- rejection undoes them too

local Document = require("../Matrix/Document")
local Path = require("../Matrix/Path")
local Transaction = require("../Matrix/Transaction")
local Tree = require("../Matrix/Tree")

type Path = Path.Path
type PathLike = Path.PathLike
type Transaction = Transaction.Transaction

export type Bundle = {
	kind: "bundle",
	name: string,
	fields: { Path },
	normalize: (tx: Transaction) -> (),
}

export type Reaction = {
	kind: "reaction",
	name: string,
	deps: { Path },
	writes: { Path },
	run: (tx: Transaction) -> (),
}

export type Derived = {
	kind: "derived",
	name: string,
	deps: { Path },
	compute: (state: unknown) -> unknown,
}

export type BundleOptions = {
	name: string?,
}

export type ReactionOptions = {
	name: string?,
	-- every path the reaction may write. Required, cycle detection runs off this
	writes: { PathLike },
}

export type SetOptions = {
	bundles: { Bundle }?,
	reactions: { Reaction }?,
	derived: { Derived }?,
	-- max rounds of bundles and reactions per transaction, default 8
	maxDepth: number?,
}

local Facet = {}

local DEFAULT_MAX_DEPTH = 8

local function parseAll(paths: { PathLike }, what: string): { Path }
	assert(type(paths) == "table" and #paths > 0, `{what} needs at least one path`)
	local parsed = {}
	for _, path in paths do
		table.insert(parsed, table.freeze(Path.parse(path)))
	end
	return table.freeze(parsed)
end

local function describePaths(paths: { Path }): string
	local parts = {}
	for _, path in paths do
		table.insert(parts, Path.format(path))
	end
	return table.concat(parts, ", ")
end

local function overlaps(a: { Path }, b: { Path }): boolean
	for _, left in a do
		for _, right in b do
			if Path.related(left, right) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Builders

--[=[
	A group of fields kept consistent by one function. It runs whenever any of the fields changes,
	and may only write those fields

	@within Geode
	@param fields { PathLike }
	@param normalize (tx: Transaction) -> ()
	@param options BundleOptions?
	@return Bundle

	```lua
	local progress = Geode.bundle({ "xp", "level" }, function(tx)
		local xp, level = tx:get("xp"), tx:get("level")
		while xp >= level * 100 do
			xp -= level * 100
			level += 1
		end
		tx:set("xp", xp)
		tx:set("level", level)
	end)
	```
]=]
function Facet.bundle(
	fields: { PathLike },
	normalize: (tx: Transaction) -> (),
	options: BundleOptions?
): Bundle
	local parsed = parseAll(fields, "a bundle")
	assert(type(normalize) == "function", "a bundle needs a normalize function")
	return table.freeze({
		kind = "bundle" :: "bundle",
		name = options and options.name or `bundle({describePaths(parsed)})`,
		fields = parsed,
		normalize = normalize,
	})
end

--[=[
	Writes `writes` whenever something in `deps` changes, inside the same transaction

	@within Geode
	@param deps { PathLike }
	@param run (tx: Transaction) -> ()
	@param options ReactionOptions
	@return Reaction

	```lua
	Geode.react({ "level" }, function(tx)
		tx:increment("coins", 50)
	end, { writes = { "coins" } })
	```
]=]
function Facet.react(
	deps: { PathLike },
	run: (tx: Transaction) -> (),
	options: ReactionOptions
): Reaction
	local parsedDeps = parseAll(deps, "a reaction")
	assert(type(run) == "function", "a reaction needs a function to run")
	assert(
		options and options.writes,
		"a reaction has to declare the paths it writes, so cycles can be found before anything runs"
	)
	local parsedWrites = parseAll(options.writes, "a reaction's writes")
	return table.freeze({
		kind = "reaction" :: "reaction",
		name = options.name
			or `reaction({describePaths(parsedDeps)} -> {describePaths(parsedWrites)})`,
		deps = parsedDeps,
		writes = parsedWrites,
		run = run,
	})
end

--[=[
	A top level field computed from `deps` when read. It's never stored or written, and only
	recomputes when a dependency changed

	@within Geode
	@param name string
	@param deps { PathLike }
	@param compute (state: unknown) -> unknown
	@return Derived
]=]
function Facet.derive(
	name: string,
	deps: { PathLike },
	compute: (state: unknown) -> unknown
): Derived
	assert(type(name) == "string" and name ~= "", "a derived field needs a name")
	assert(not string.find(name, ".", 1, true), "a derived field name can't contain dots")
	assert(type(compute) == "function", "a derived field needs a compute function")
	return table.freeze({
		kind = "derived" :: "derived",
		name = name,
		deps = parseAll(deps, "a derived field"),
		compute = compute,
	})
end

-- Graph

type Node = {
	name: string,
	reads: { Path },
	writes: { Path },
	reaction: Reaction?,
}

-- Orders reactions so each runs after everything it depends on, and errors on cycles. Bundles
-- are nodes too (they read and write their own fields), so a loop through one is caught
local function order(bundles: { Bundle }, reactions: { Reaction }): { Reaction }
	local nodes: { Node } = {}
	for _, bundle in bundles do
		table.insert(
			nodes,
			{ name = bundle.name, reads = bundle.fields, writes = bundle.fields, reaction = nil }
		)
	end
	for _, reaction in reactions do
		table.insert(nodes, {
			name = reaction.name,
			reads = reaction.deps,
			writes = reaction.writes,
			reaction = reaction,
		})
	end

	local edges: { [Node]: { Node } } = {}
	local incoming: { [Node]: number } = {}
	for _, node in nodes do
		edges[node] = {}
		incoming[node] = 0
	end
	for _, from in nodes do
		for _, to in nodes do
			local isBundleItself = from == to and from.reaction == nil
			if not isBundleItself and overlaps(from.writes, to.reads) then
				if from == to then
					error(`{from.name} writes a path it depends on, which would trigger itself`, 0)
				end
				table.insert(edges[from], to)
				incoming[to] += 1
			end
		end
	end

	local ready = {}
	for _, node in nodes do
		if incoming[node] == 0 then
			table.insert(ready, node)
		end
	end
	local sorted: { Reaction } = {}
	local visited = 0
	while #ready > 0 do
		local node = table.remove(ready, 1) :: Node
		visited += 1
		if node.reaction then
			table.insert(sorted, node.reaction)
		end
		for _, next in edges[node] do
			incoming[next] -= 1
			if incoming[next] == 0 then
				table.insert(ready, next)
			end
		end
	end

	if visited < #nodes then
		local stuck = {}
		for _, node in nodes do
			if incoming[node] > 0 then
				table.insert(stuck, node.name)
			end
		end
		table.sort(stuck)
		error(`bundles and reactions form a cycle through {table.concat(stuck, ", ")}`, 0)
	end
	return sorted
end

--// facet sets

type Fields = {
	order: { Reaction },
	_bundles: { Bundle },
	_derived: { Derived },
	_maxDepth: number,
}

--[=[
	@class FacetSet

	Bundles, reactions and derived fields checked together. Made with `Geode.Raw.facets`
]=]
local FacetSet = {}
FacetSet.__index = FacetSet

export type FacetSet = typeof(setmetatable({} :: Fields, FacetSet))

--[=[
	Validates bundles and reactions together and fixes their run order. Cycles, and reactions
	that trigger themselves, error here rather than at runtime

	@within FacetSet
	@param options FacetSetOptions
	@return FacetSet
]=]
function Facet.set(options: SetOptions): FacetSet
	local bundles: { Bundle } = if options.bundles then options.bundles else {}
	local reactions: { Reaction } = if options.reactions then options.reactions else {}
	local derived: { Derived } = if options.derived then options.derived else {}

	local names: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	for _, item in derived do
		assert(not names[item.name], `two derived fields are named {item.name}`)
		names[item.name] = true
	end

	local self: Fields = {
		order = table.freeze(order(bundles, reactions)),
		_bundles = table.clone(bundles),
		_derived = table.clone(derived),
		_maxDepth = options.maxDepth or DEFAULT_MAX_DEPTH,
	}
	assert(self._maxDepth >= 1, "maxDepth must be at least 1")
	return setmetatable(self, FacetSet)
end

local function touches(changes: { Tree.DiffEntry }, paths: { Path }): boolean
	for _, entry in changes do
		for _, path in paths do
			if Path.related(entry.path, path) then
				return true
			end
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Runs one bundle or reaction and returns what it changed. Writes outside what it may write are
-- refused, which keeps the definition time cycle check honest
local function step(
	tx: Transaction,
	name: string,
	allowed: { Path },
	writer: Transaction.SourceKind,
	body: (tx: Transaction) -> ()
): { Tree.DiffEntry }
	local before = tx:get()
	body(tx)
	local changes = Tree.diff(before, tx:get())
	for _, entry in changes do
		local inside = false
		for _, path in allowed do
			if Path.startsWith(entry.path, path) then
				inside = true
				break
			end
		end
		if not inside then
			Transaction.fail(
				"error",
				`{name} wrote {Path.format(entry.path)}, which isn't among the paths it may write`
			)
		end
		tx:markWriter(Path.format(entry.path), writer)
	end
	return changes
end

local function append(target: { Tree.DiffEntry }, source: { Tree.DiffEntry })
	table.move(source, 1, #source, #target + 1, target)
end

--[=[
	The pipeline stage. Round one runs bundles touched by the caller's changes, then reactions in
	order. Later rounds only happen when reactions touched bundle members: those bundles normalize
	again and reactions see just their new writes
]=]
function FacetSet.stage(self: FacetSet): (tx: Transaction) -> ()
	return function(tx: Transaction)
		local pending = tx:diff()
		for _, entry in pending do
			tx:markWriter(Path.format(entry.path), tx.source.kind)
		end

		local round = 0
		local triggers = pending
		while true do
			round += 1
			if round > self._maxDepth then
				Transaction.fail(
					"error",
					`bundles and reactions didn't settle within {self._maxDepth} rounds`
				)
			end

			local bundleWrites: { Tree.DiffEntry } = {}
			for _, bundle in self._bundles do
				if touches(pending, bundle.fields) then
					append(
						bundleWrites,
						step(tx, bundle.name, bundle.fields, "bundle", bundle.normalize)
					)
				end
			end
			if round > 1 then
				if #bundleWrites == 0 then
					break
				end
				triggers = {}
			end
			append(triggers, bundleWrites)

			local reactionWrites: { Tree.DiffEntry } = {}
			for _, reaction in self.order do
				if touches(triggers, reaction.deps) then
					local changes =
						step(tx, reaction.name, reaction.writes, "reaction", reaction.run)
					append(triggers, changes)
					append(reactionWrites, changes)
				end
			end

			if #reactionWrites == 0 then
				break
			end
			pending = reactionWrites
		end
	end
end

-- Only recomputes when an input changed. Structural sharing means an unchanged input is the
-- very same value, so a reference compare is enough
local function cached(derived: Derived): (root: unknown) -> unknown
	local lastInputs: { unknown }? = nil
	local lastValue: unknown = nil
	return function(root: unknown): unknown
		local inputs = {}
		for index, dep in derived.deps do
			inputs[index] = Tree.get(root, dep)
		end
		if lastInputs then
			local same = true
			for index, value in inputs do
				if lastInputs[index] ~= value then
					same = false
					break
				end
			end
			if same then
				return lastValue
			end
		end
		lastInputs = inputs
		lastValue = Tree.adopt(derived.compute(root))
		return lastValue
	end
end

--[=[
	Adds the stage and the derived fields to a document. Attach it before any guard set so the
	guards see what bundles and reactions wrote
]=]
function FacetSet.attach(self: FacetSet, document: Document.Document)
	for _, derived in self._derived do
		local deps: { PathLike } = {}
		for _, dep in derived.deps do
			table.insert(deps, dep)
		end
		document:addDerived(derived.name, deps, cached(derived))
	end
	if #self._bundles > 0 or #self.order > 0 then
		document:addStage(self:stage())
	end
end

return Facet

-- The tag/attribute contract is described in README.md.

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Recipes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Recipes)

local GreyboxService = {}

local function addPart(parent: Instance, name: string, size: Vector3, position: Vector3, color: Color3): Part
	local part = Instance.new("Part")
	part.Name = name
	part.Size = size
	part.Position = position
	part.Color = color
	part.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
	part.Anchored = true
	part.Parent = parent
	return part
end

local function label(part: Part, text: string)
	local gui = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
	gui.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(120, 30)
	gui.StudsOffset = Vector3.new(0, part.Size.Y / 2 + 2, 0)
	gui.AlwaysOnTop = true
	local textLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	textLabel.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
	textLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	textLabel.TextScaled = true
	textLabel.Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold
	textLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
	textLabel.TextStrokeTransparency = 0.4
	textLabel.Text = text
	textLabel.Parent = gui
	gui.Parent = part
end

function GreyboxService.Init()
	if not Config.Greybox then
		return
	end
	for _, tag in { "Station", "IngredientCrate", "ServiceWindow", "QueueSlot", "CustomerSpawn" } do
		if #CollectionService:GetTagged(tag) > 0 then
			return
		end
	end

	local folder = Instance.new("Folder")
	folder.Name = "Greybox"

	addPart(folder, "Floor", Vector3.new(120, 1, 120), Vector3.new(0, -0.5, 0), Color3.fromRGB(90, 95, 100))

	local window =
		addPart(folder, "ServiceWindow", Vector3.new(10, 6, 1), Vector3.new(0, 3, -10), Color3.fromRGB(220, 90, 70))
	CollectionService:AddTag(window, "ServiceWindow")
	label(window, "Window")

	for index = 1, 4 do
		local slot = addPart(
			folder,
			"QueueSlot" .. index,
			Vector3.new(4, 0.2, 4),
			Vector3.new((index - 2.5) * 5, 0.1, -18),
			Color3.fromRGB(240, 220, 120)
		)
		slot.CanCollide = false
		slot:SetAttribute("Index", index)
		CollectionService:AddTag(slot, "QueueSlot")
	end

	local spawn = addPart(
		folder,
		"CustomerSpawn",
		Vector3.new(4, 0.2, 4),
		Vector3.new(40, 0.1, -30),
		Color3.fromRGB(120, 120, 120)
	)
	spawn.CanCollide = false
	CollectionService:AddTag(spawn, "CustomerSpawn")

	for index, stationType in Recipes.StationIds do
		local station = addPart(
			folder,
			stationType,
			Vector3.new(6, 4, 4),
			Vector3.new((index - 2) * 12, 2, 8),
			Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 80)
		)
		station:SetAttribute("StationType", stationType)
		CollectionService:AddTag(station, "Station")
		label(station, stationType)
	end

	for index, ingredient in Recipes.IngredientIds do
		local crate = addPart(
			folder,
			ingredient .. "Crate",
			Vector3.new(4, 3, 4),
			Vector3.new((index - 3.5) * 8, 1.5, 28),
			Recipes.Items[ingredient].Color
		)
		crate:SetAttribute("Ingredient", ingredient)
		CollectionService:AddTag(crate, "IngredientCrate")
		label(crate, ingredient)
	end

	if not workspace:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("SpawnLocation") then
		local spawnLocation = Instance.new("SpawnLocation")
		spawnLocation.Anchored = true
		spawnLocation.Size = Vector3.new(8, 1, 8)
		spawnLocation.Position = Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0)
		spawnLocation.Neutral = true
		spawnLocation.Parent = folder
	end

	folder.Parent = workspace
end

return GreyboxService

-- Developer products and passes. Product grants are idempotent: each PurchaseId is
-- stored in the player's data and only acknowledged to Roblox after a successful save.
--
-- PurchaseService.RegisterProduct(Config.Products.Coins100, function(player, data)
--     data.Coins += 100
-- end)
-- PurchaseService.OwnsPass(player, Config.Passes.VIP) -> boolean
-- PurchaseService.OnPassPurchased(function(player, passId) ... end)

local MarketplaceService = game:GetService("MarketplaceService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

local DataService = require(script.Parent.DataService)

local PurchaseService = {}

local HISTORY_LIMIT = 50

local productHandlers: { [number]: (Player, any) -> () } = {}
local passCache: { [Player]: { [number]: boolean } } = {}
local passCallbacks: { (Player, number) -> () } = {}

-- handler mutates `data` to grant the product. It must not yield; validate before changing anything.
function PurchaseService.RegisterProduct(productId: number, handler: (player: Player, data: any) -> ())
	assert(productHandlers[productId] == nil, `Product {productId} already has a handler`)
	productHandlers[productId] = handler
end

local function processReceipt(receipt): Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision
	local player = Players:GetPlayerByUserId(receipt.PlayerId)
	if not player then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet -- Roblox retries when they join again
	end
	local data = DataService.WaitFor(player, 15)
	if not data then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	if table.find(data.PurchaseHistory, receipt.PurchaseId) then
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted -- already granted, earlier save may have failed
	end
	local handler = productHandlers[receipt.ProductId]
	if not handler then
		warn(`[PurchaseService] No handler for product {receipt.ProductId}`)
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	local ok, updated = pcall(DataService.Update, player, function(playerData)
		handler(player, playerData)
		table.insert(playerData.PurchaseHistory, receipt.PurchaseId)
		while #playerData.PurchaseHistory > HISTORY_LIMIT do
			table.remove(playerData.PurchaseHistory, 1)
		end
	end)
	if not ok or updated ~= true then
		warn(`[PurchaseService] Granting product {receipt.ProductId} failed: {updated}`)
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	if not DataService.Save(player) then
		-- Granted in memory and recorded; Roblox will retry and the history check above acknowledges it.
		return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.NotProcessedYet
	end
	return Enum.ProductPurchaseDecision.PurchaseGranted
end

function PurchaseService.OwnsPass(player: Player, passId: number): boolean
	local cache = passCache[player]
	if not cache then
		cache = {}
		passCache[player] = cache
	end
	if cache[passId] ~= nil then
		return cache[passId]
	end
	local ok, owns = pcall(MarketplaceService.UserOwnsGamePassAsync, MarketplaceService, player.UserId, passId)
	if not ok then
		warn(`[PurchaseService] Pass check failed for {player.UserId}: {owns}`)
		return false -- not cached, so the next call retries
	end
	cache[passId] = owns
	return owns
end

function PurchaseService.OnPassPurchased(callback: (Player, number) -> ())
	table.insert(passCallbacks, callback)
end

function PurchaseService.Init() end

function PurchaseService.Start()
	MarketplaceService.ProcessReceipt = processReceipt

	MarketplaceService.PromptGamePassPurchaseFinished:Connect(function(player, passId, purchased)
		if not purchased then
			return
		end
		local cache = passCache[player]
		if cache then
			cache[passId] = true
		end
		for _, callback in passCallbacks do
			task.spawn(callback, player, passId)
		end
	end)

	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		passCache[player] = nil
	end)
end

return PurchaseService

--!strict

-- Cross-server matchmaking. Tickets sit in a MemoryStore sorted map ordered by rating, and any
-- server can add or cancel them. One server per mode and region, elected with a lock, groups
-- them into matches each tick. Claims are atomic updates that only succeed on an unclaimed
-- ticket, so two matchers can never put the same player in two matches

local Premades = require("../Moonstone/Premades")
local RealServices = require("../Quartz/Real/Services")
local VeinBridge = require("../Vein/Bridge")
local Registry = require("../Vein/Registry")
local Scheduler = require("../Quartz/Scheduler")
local Studio = require("../Quartz/Studio")
local Types = require("../Quartz/Types")

export type Band = {
	-- Rating gap allowed right away. Defaults to 100
	start: number?,
	-- How much the band grows each second a ticket waits. Defaults to 10
	widenPerSecond: number?,
	-- The widest it gets. Defaults to 1000
	max: number?,
}

export type Options = {
	name: string,
	placeId: number,
	-- Players per match. Parties count with all their members and are never split
	matchSize: number,
	mode: string?,
	region: string?,
	band: Band?,
	-- Seconds a ticket waits before it expires. Defaults to 300
	ticketTtl: number?,
	-- Seconds between matching passes, default 2
	tick: number?,
	-- Seconds the elected matcher's lock lasts without renewal. Defaults to 10
	lease: number?,
	-- One matcher per mode and region, on by default. Off lets every server match, which
	-- is still safe, just costs more
	elect: boolean?,
	onMatch: ((match: Match) -> ())?,
	services: Types.Services?,
	scheduler: Scheduler.Scheduler?,
	-- Where the queue lives in Studio. Geode.setup's mode, or "mock". See Quartz/Studio
	studio: Studio.Mode?,
	reportError: ((message: string) -> ())?,
}

export type Ticket = {
	id: string,
	players: { number },
	rating: number,
	createdAt: number,
	matchId: string?,
	reservedCode: string?,
	-- set by cancel. The ticket lingers for a second and must not be matched in that time
	cancelled: boolean?,
}

export type Match = {
	id: string,
	placeId: number,
	reservedCode: string,
	players: { number },
	tickets: { string },
}

export type Status = {
	state: "waiting" | "matched" | "gone",
	ticket: Ticket?,
}

type Fields = {
	name: string,
	mode: string,
	region: string,
	_services: Types.Services,
	_scheduler: Scheduler.Scheduler,
	_map: Types.SortedMap,
	_placeId: number,
	_matchSize: number,
	_band: { start: number, widenPerSecond: number, max: number },
	_ticketTtl: number,
	_tick: number,
	_elect: boolean,
	_mutex: Premades.Mutex,
	_lock: Premades.Lock?,
	_running: boolean,
	-- bumped on every start so a loop left over from a quick stop/start exits by itself
	_loop: number,
	_onMatch: ((match: Match) -> ())?,
	_report: (message: string) -> (),
	_handle: Registry.Handle,
}

--[=[
	@class Matchmaker

	Matchmaking across servers. Made with `Geode.Matchmaker.new`
]=]
local Matchmaker = {}
Matchmaker.__index = Matchmaker

export type Matchmaker = typeof(setmetatable({} :: Fields, Matchmaker))

-- GetRangeAsync max
local PAGE = 200
local MAX_PAGES = 5

--[=[
	Creates a matchmaker for one mode and region. Call `start` on every server that should take
	part in electing the matcher

	@within Matchmaker
	@param options MatchmakerOptions
	@return Matchmaker
]=]
function Matchmaker.new(options: Options): Matchmaker
	assert(type(options.name) == "string" and options.name ~= "", "a matchmaker needs a name")
	assert(
		options.matchSize >= 2 and options.matchSize % 1 == 0,
		"matchSize must be a whole number of at least 2"
	)
	local given = options.services or RealServices.live()
	VeinBridge.ensure(given)
	Studio.check(options.studio)
	local report = options.reportError or function(message: string)
		warn(message)
	end
	local studio: Studio.Mode = Studio.mode(options.studio)
	local services = Studio.resolve(given, studio, report)
	local scheduler = options.scheduler
		or Scheduler.new({ clock = services.clock, budget = services.budget })
	local mode = options.mode or "default"
	local region = options.region or "global"
	local band: Band = options.band or {}
	local self = setmetatable(
		{
			name = options.name,
			mode = mode,
			region = region,
			_services = services,
			_scheduler = scheduler,
			_map = services.sortedMap(`geode_mm_{options.name}_{mode}_{region}`),
			_placeId = options.placeId,
			_matchSize = options.matchSize,
			_band = {
				start = band.start or 100,
				widenPerSecond = band.widenPerSecond or 10,
				max = band.max or 1000,
			},
			_ticketTtl = options.ticketTtl or 300,
			_tick = options.tick or 2,
			_elect = options.elect ~= false,
			_mutex = Premades.mutex(`matchmaker_{options.name}`, {
				services = services,
				scheduler = scheduler,
				lease = options.lease or 10,
			}),
			_lock = nil,
			_running = false,
			_loop = 0,
			_onMatch = options.onMatch,
			_report = report,
			_handle = nil :: any,
		} :: Fields,
		Matchmaker
	)
	self._handle = Registry.register("matchmaker", `{options.name}/{mode}/{region}`, function()
		return { matcher = self:isMatcher() }
	end)
	return self
end

-- Tickets

--[=[
	Queues players as a single ticket and returns its id. A party is one ticket, so it always
	lands in the same match
]=]
function Matchmaker.enqueue(
	self: Matchmaker,
	players: { number },
	rating: number
): Types.Result<string>
	assert(
		#players >= 1 and #players <= self._matchSize,
		"a ticket holds between 1 and matchSize players"
	)
	local id = self._services.guid()
	local ticket: Ticket = {
		id = id,
		players = table.clone(players),
		rating = rating,
		createdAt = self._services.clock:now(),
		matchId = nil,
		reservedCode = nil,
	}
	local result = self._scheduler:submit({
		priority = "save",
		run = function()
			return self._map:set(id, ticket, self._ticketTtl, rating)
		end,
	})
	if not result.ok then
		return { ok = false, error = result.error }
	end
	return { ok = true, value = id }
end

--[=[
	Takes a ticket out of the queue. Returns false when it was already matched or gone
]=]
function Matchmaker.cancel(self: Matchmaker, ticketId: string): Types.Result<boolean>
	local cancelled = false
	local result = self._scheduler:submit({
		priority = "save",
		run = function()
			return self._map:update(ticketId, function(current: unknown, sortKey: Types.SortKey?)
				cancelled = false
				if type(current) ~= "table" or (current :: Ticket).matchId ~= nil then
					return nil, nil
				end
				cancelled = true
				-- Mark it and let it expire. Removing it now could race a claim
				-- that's already reading it, and the mark makes every claim refuse it
				local ticket = table.clone(current :: Ticket)
				ticket.cancelled = true
				return ticket, sortKey
			end, 1)
		end,
	})
	if not result.ok then
		return { ok = false, error = result.error }
	end
	return { ok = true, value = cancelled }
end

--[=[
	Where a ticket stands: still waiting, matched with a reserved server, or gone because it was
	cancelled or expired
]=]
function Matchmaker.status(self: Matchmaker, ticketId: string): Types.Result<Status>
	local result = self._scheduler:submit({
		priority = "read",
		run = function()
			return self._map:get(ticketId)
		end,
	})
	if not result.ok then
		return { ok = false, error = result.error }
	end
	local entry = result.value
	if entry == nil or type(entry.value) ~= "table" or (entry.value :: Ticket).cancelled then
		return { ok = true, value = { state = "gone", ticket = nil } }
	end
	local ticket = entry.value :: Ticket
	return {
		ok = true,
		value = { state = if ticket.matchId then "matched" else "waiting", ticket = ticket },
	}
end

--[=[
	Teleports this server's players from a matched ticket to their reserved server
]=]
function Matchmaker.teleport(
	self: Matchmaker,
	ticket: Ticket,
	players: { unknown }
): Types.Result<nil>
	assert(ticket.reservedCode, "the ticket isn't matched yet")
	return self._services.teleport:teleport(self._placeId, players, {
		reservedServerCode = ticket.reservedCode,
		data = { matchId = ticket.matchId },
	})
end

-- Matching

function Matchmaker._bandFor(self: Matchmaker, waited: number): number
	local band = self._band
	return math.min(band.start + band.widenPerSecond * math.max(0, waited), band.max)
end

-- Groups waiting tickets, lowest rating first. Each group fills a match exactly
function Matchmaker._groups(self: Matchmaker, tickets: { Ticket }): { { Ticket } }
	local now = self._services.clock:now()
	local used: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local groups = {}
	for index, anchor in tickets do
		if used[anchor.id] then
			continue
		end
		local band = self:_bandFor(now - anchor.createdAt)
		local group = { anchor }
		local size = #anchor.players
		for other = index + 1, #tickets do
			if size == self._matchSize then
				break
			end
			local candidate = tickets[other]
			if candidate.rating - anchor.rating > band then
				break
			end
			if not used[candidate.id] and size + #candidate.players <= self._matchSize then
				table.insert(group, candidate)
				size += #candidate.players
			end
		end
		if size == self._matchSize then
			for _, ticket in group do
				used[ticket.id] = true
			end
			table.insert(groups, group)
		end
	end
	return groups
end

-- All or nothing: claims every ticket in the group for one match, or none
function Matchmaker._claim(
	self: Matchmaker,
	group: { Ticket },
	matchId: string,
	code: string
): boolean
	local claimed: { string } = {}
	local function setMatch(
		ticketId: string,
		expected: string?,
		matchValue: string?,
		codeValue: string?
	): boolean
		local changed = false
		local result = self._scheduler:submit({
			priority = "load",
			run = function()
				return self._map:update(
					ticketId,
					function(current: unknown, sortKey: Types.SortKey?)
						changed = false
						if
							type(current) ~= "table"
							or (current :: Ticket).matchId ~= expected
							or (current :: Ticket).cancelled
						then
							return nil, nil
						end
						local ticket = table.clone(current :: Ticket)
						ticket.matchId = matchValue
						ticket.reservedCode = codeValue
						changed = true
						return ticket, sortKey
					end,
					self._ticketTtl
				)
			end,
		})
		return result.ok and changed
	end

	for _, ticket in group do
		if setMatch(ticket.id, nil, matchId, code) then
			table.insert(claimed, ticket.id)
		else
			-- Lost one: someone else took it or it's gone. Give back what this pass claimed
			for _, ticketId in claimed do
				setMatch(ticketId, matchId, nil, nil)
			end
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

--[=[
	Runs one matching pass and returns the matches it made. The elected matcher runs this every
	tick, so call it directly only in tests or custom loops
]=]
function Matchmaker.runOnce(self: Matchmaker): { Match }
	-- Matched tickets linger until they expire, so page past them. The bound carries key and
	-- sortKey both: a key-only bound ranks as "no sort key" (found this in testing)
	local tickets: { Ticket } = {}
	local lower: Types.SortedBound? = nil
	for _ = 1, MAX_PAGES do
		local bound = lower
		local range = self._scheduler:submit({
			priority = "read",
			run = function()
				return self._map:getRange({ count = PAGE, lower = bound })
			end,
		})
		if not range.ok then
			self._report(`matchmaker {self.name} couldn't read its queue: {range.error.message}`)
			return {}
		end
		for _, entry in range.value do
			local ticket = entry.value
			if
				type(ticket) == "table"
				and (ticket :: Ticket).matchId == nil
				and not (ticket :: Ticket).cancelled
			then
				table.insert(tickets, ticket :: Ticket)
			end
		end
		local last = range.value[#range.value]
		if #range.value < PAGE or #tickets >= PAGE or last == nil then
			break
		end
		lower = { key = last.key, sortKey = last.sortKey }
	end

	local matches = {}
	for _, group in self:_groups(tickets) do
		local reserved = self._services.teleport:reserveServer(self._placeId)
		if not reserved.ok then
			self._report(
				`matchmaker {self.name} couldn't reserve a server: {reserved.error.message}`
			)
			break
		end
		local matchId = self._services.guid()
		if self:_claim(group, matchId, reserved.value.code) then
			local match: Match = {
				id = matchId,
				placeId = self._placeId,
				reservedCode = reserved.value.code,
				players = {},
				tickets = {},
			}
			for _, ticket in group do
				table.insert(match.tickets, ticket.id)
				for _, userId in ticket.players do
					table.insert(match.players, userId)
				end
			end
			table.insert(matches, match)
			local onMatch = self._onMatch
			if onMatch then
				local ok, err = pcall(function()
					onMatch(match)
				end)
				if not ok then
					self._report(`onMatch handler error: {tostring(err)}`)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return matches
end

--// matcher loop

--[=[
	Whether this server is the elected matcher right now
]=]
function Matchmaker.isMatcher(self: Matchmaker): boolean
	if not self._elect then
		return self._running
	end
	local lock = self._lock
	return lock ~= nil and lock:isHeld()
end

-- True when this server should match this tick. Keeps the role or tries to take it
function Matchmaker._elected(self: Matchmaker): boolean
	if not self._elect then
		return true
	end
	local lock = self._lock
	if lock and lock:isHeld() and lock:renew() then
		return true
	end
	self._lock = nil
	local acquired = self._mutex:acquire(`{self.mode}:{self.region}`)
	if acquired.ok and acquired.value then
		self._lock = acquired.value
		return true
	end
	return false
end

--[=[
	Takes part in matching: tries to become the matcher every tick, and matches while it is.
	When the matcher's server dies, its lock runs out and another server takes over
]=]
function Matchmaker.start(self: Matchmaker)
	if self._running then
		return
	end
	self._running = true
	self._loop += 1
	local loop = self._loop
	local clock = self._services.clock
	clock:spawn(function()
		while self._running and self._loop == loop do
			if self:_elected() then
				self:runOnce()
			end
			clock:wait(self._tick)
		end
	end)
end

--[=[
	Stops taking part in matching and gives up the matcher lock if this server held it

	@within Matchmaker
]=]
function Matchmaker.stop(self: Matchmaker)
	self._running = false
	local lock = self._lock
	self._lock = nil
	if lock then
		self._services.clock:spawn(function()
			lock:release()
		end)
	end
end

--[=[
	Stops it and drops it from the registry that tooling reads

	@within Matchmaker
]=]
function Matchmaker.destroy(self: Matchmaker)
	self:stop()
	self._handle:unregister()
	self._mutex:destroy()
end

return Matchmaker

-- Cooking stations: Grill, Fryer, Oven. Bring ingredients one at a time; when the inputs
-- match a recipe the station cooks, then the dish waits to be collected and burns if left.
-- Plan: SYS-04
--
-- World contract: parts/models tagged "Station" with attribute StationType = <Recipes.Stations id>.
-- A ProximityPrompt is created if missing. Replicated attributes on the station (for progress bars, UI/VFX):
--   State ("Idle" | "Loading" | "Cooking" | "Done" | "Burnt"), Progress (0-1 cooking), BurnProgress (0-1),
--   Dish (dish id while Cooking/Done), Inputs ("Bun,Patty")
-- workspace attribute CookSpeed (default 1) scales cooking speed (upgrade shop, SYS-11).

local CollectionService = game:GetService("CollectionService")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net)
local Recipes = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Recipes)
local CarryService = require(script.Parent.CarryService)
local GameService = require(script.Parent.GameService)
local PlayerUtil = require(script.Parent.Parent.Lib.PlayerUtil)

local StationService = {}

local TICK = 0.1

type Station = {
	instance: Instance,
	stationType: string,
	prompt: ProximityPrompt,
	state: string,
	inputs: { string },
	dish: string?,
	elapsed: number,
	doneAt: number,
}

local stations: { [Instance]: Station } = {}

local function publish(station: Station)
	local instance = station.instance
	instance:SetAttribute("State", station.state)
	instance:SetAttribute("Inputs", table.concat(station.inputs, ","))
	instance:SetAttribute("Dish", station.dish)
	local progress, burn = 0, 0
	if station.dish then
		local recipe = Recipes.Dishes[station.dish]
		if station.state == "Cooking" then
			progress = station.elapsed / recipe.CookTime
		elseif station.state == "Done" then
			progress = 1
			burn = (os.clock() - station.doneAt) / recipe.BurnTime
		elseif station.state == "Burnt" then
			progress, burn = 1, 1
		end
	end
	instance:SetAttribute("Progress", math.floor(math.clamp(progress, 0, 1) * 100) / 100)
	instance:SetAttribute("BurnProgress", math.floor(math.clamp(burn, 0, 1) * 100) / 100)

	local stationName = Recipes.Stations[station.stationType].Name
	station.prompt.ObjectText = stationName
	if station.state == "Done" then
		station.prompt.ActionText = "Take " .. Recipes.Dishes[station.dish :: string].Name
	elseif station.state == "Burnt" then
		station.prompt.ActionText = "Throw away burnt food"
	elseif station.state == "Cooking" then
		station.prompt.ActionText = "Cooking..."
	else
		station.prompt.ActionText = "Add ingredient"
	end
end

local function reset(station: Station)
	station.state = "Idle"
	station.inputs = {}
	station.dish = nil
	station.elapsed = 0
	station.doneAt = 0
	publish(station)
end

local function deposit(player: Player, station: Station)
	local carried = CarryService.Peek(player)
	local item = carried and Recipes.Items[carried]
	if not carried or not item or item.Kind ~= "Ingredient" then
		Net.fireClient(player, "Notify", "Bring an ingredient")
		return
	end
	if not Recipes.canAccept(station.stationType, station.inputs, carried) then
		Net.fireClient(player, "Notify", "That doesn't go in here")
		return
	end
	CarryService.Clear(player)
	table.insert(station.inputs, carried)
	local dish = Recipes.findDish(station.stationType, station.inputs)
	if dish then
		station.state = "Cooking"
		station.dish = dish
		station.elapsed = 0
	else
		station.state = "Loading"
	end
	publish(station)
end

local function onTriggered(station: Station, player: Player)
	local state = GameService.GetState()
	if state ~= "Day" and state ~= "Night" then
		return
	end
	if
		not PlayerUtil.isNear(
			player,
			station.instance,
			Config.Interaction.PromptDistance + Config.Interaction.ServerSlack + 10
		)
	then
		return
	end
	if station.state == "Idle" or station.state == "Loading" then
		deposit(player, station)
	elseif station.state == "Done" then
		if CarryService.Peek(player) then
			Net.fireClient(player, "Notify", "Your hands are full (G to drop)")
			return
		end
		if CarryService.Give(player, station.dish :: string) then
			reset(station)
		end
	elseif station.state == "Burnt" then
		reset(station)
	end
end

local function setupStation(instance: Instance)
	local stationType = instance:GetAttribute("StationType")
	if stations[instance] or type(stationType) ~= "string" or not Recipes.Stations[stationType] then
		if not stations[instance] then
			warn(`[StationService] {instance:GetFullName()} has no valid StationType attribute`)
		end
		return
	end
	local prompt = instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("ProximityPrompt", true)
	if not prompt then
		prompt = Instance.new("ProximityPrompt")
		prompt.HoldDuration = 0
		prompt.MaxActivationDistance = Config.Interaction.PromptDistance
		prompt.RequiresLineOfSight = false
		prompt.Parent = if instance:IsA("Model")
			then (instance.PrimaryPart or instance:FindFirstChildWhichIsA("BasePart"))
			else instance
	end
	local station: Station = {
		instance = instance,
		stationType = stationType,
		prompt = prompt,
		state = "Idle",
		inputs = {},
		dish = nil,
		elapsed = 0,
		doneAt = 0,
	}
	stations[instance] = station
	prompt.Triggered:Connect(function(player)
		onTriggered(station, player)
	end)
	instance.Destroying:Connect(function()
		stations[instance] = nil
	end)
	reset(station)
end

local function step(dt: number)
	local speed = math.clamp(workspace:GetAttribute("CookSpeed") or 1, 0.1, 10)
	local now = os.clock()
	for _, station in stations do
		if station.state == "Cooking" then
			station.elapsed += dt * speed
			if station.elapsed >= Recipes.Dishes[station.dish :: string].CookTime then
				station.state = "Done"
				station.doneAt = now
			end
			publish(station)
		elseif station.state == "Done" then
			if now - station.doneAt >= Recipes.Dishes[station.dish :: string].BurnTime then
				station.state = "Burnt"
			end
			publish(station)
		end
	end
end

function StationService.Init()
	GameService.OnStateChanged(function(state)
		if state == "Ready" then
			for _, station in stations do
				reset(station)
			end
		end
	end)
end

function StationService.Start()
	CollectionService:GetInstanceAddedSignal("Station"):Connect(setupStation)
	for _, instance in CollectionService:GetTagged("Station") do
		setupStation(instance)
	end
	local last = os.clock()
	while true do
		task.wait(TICK)
		local now = os.clock()
		step(now - last)
		last = now
	end
end

return StationService
