-- Truck health for the current run. Replicates as workspace attributes TruckHp / TruckMaxHp,
-- so the HUD needs no remote.
-- Plan: SYS-07 (partial: health model and loss). TODO(SYS-07): hold-to-repair interaction once the
-- truck model exists; SYS-06 zombies call TruckService.Damage.
--
-- TruckService.Get()            -> hp, maxHp
-- TruckService.Damage(amount)   -> remaining hp; reaching 0 ends the run (GameService.Lose("TruckDestroyed"))
-- TruckService.Repair(amount)   -> new hp (never above max)
-- TruckService.RefreshMaxHp()   -> re-reads the TruckHp upgrade; extra max HP is added as health too

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Config = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Config)
local Upgrades = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Upgrades)
local GameService = require(script.Parent.GameService)

local TruckService = {}

local function isAmount(amount: any): boolean
	return type(amount) == "number" and amount == amount and amount > 0 and amount < 1e9
end

local function maxHpFromUpgrades(): number
	local level = workspace:GetAttribute(Upgrades.attribute("TruckHp")) or 0
	return Config.Truck.BaseHp + level * Upgrades.Defs.TruckHp.PerLevel
end

local function set(hp: number, maxHp: number)
	workspace:SetAttribute("TruckMaxHp", maxHp)
	workspace:SetAttribute("TruckHp", math.clamp(hp, 0, maxHp))
end

function TruckService.Get(): (number, number)
	return workspace:GetAttribute("TruckHp") or 0, workspace:GetAttribute("TruckMaxHp") or Config.Truck.BaseHp
end

function TruckService.Damage(amount: number): number
	local hp, maxHp = TruckService.Get()
	local state = GameService.GetState()
	if not isAmount(amount) or hp <= 0 or (state ~= "Day" and state ~= "Night") then
		return hp
	end
	hp = math.max(0, hp - amount)
	set(hp, maxHp)
	if hp == 0 then
		GameService.Lose("TruckDestroyed")
	end
	return hp
end

function TruckService.Repair(amount: number): number
	local hp, maxHp = TruckService.Get()
	if not isAmount(amount) or hp <= 0 then
		return hp
	end
	set(hp + amount, maxHp)
	return (TruckService.Get())
end

function TruckService.RefreshMaxHp()
	local hp, oldMax = TruckService.Get()
	local newMax = maxHpFromUpgrades()
	set(hp + math.max(0, newMax - oldMax), newMax)
end

function TruckService.Init()
	set(Config.Truck.BaseHp, Config.Truck.BaseHp)
	GameService.OnStateChanged(function(state)
		if state == "Ready" then
			-- New run: upgrades are reset too, so the base values apply.
			set(Config.Truck.BaseHp, Config.Truck.BaseHp)
		end
	end)
end

return TruckService

-- In-memory state with a single write path. Every change runs as a transaction that lands whole
-- or not at all, and each landed change produces a commit record for listeners.
-- Profiles and shared stores wrap a document and add persistence

local Path = require("./Path")
local Transaction = require("./Transaction")
local Tree = require("./Tree")
local Types = require("../Quartz/Types")

type Path = Path.Path
type PathLike = Path.PathLike
type Transaction = Transaction.Transaction

export type DiffEntry = Tree.DiffEntry

export type CommitRecord = {
	revision: number,
	source: Transaction.Source,
	ops: { Transaction.OpCall },
	diff: { [string]: DiffEntry },
	timestamp: number,
	note: string?,
}

export type TxResult =
	{ ok: true, record: CommitRecord?, dryRun: DryRun? }
	| { ok: false, error: Transaction.TxError }

-- What a dry run found: the paths it would change and what stages such as guards reported
export type DryRun = {
	paths: { string },
	findings: { unknown },
}

export type TransactOptions = {
	source: Transaction.SourceLike?,
	note: string?,
	-- run the body and every stage, then throw the draft away. Nothing commits, no listener or
	-- deferred callback runs, and stages report what they found instead of acting on it
	dryRun: boolean?,
}

-- Runs after the transaction body and before commit. It may change the draft or reject the whole
-- transaction by throwing. Guards, bundles and reactions plug in here
export type Stage = (tx: Transaction) -> ()

export type Options = {
	data: unknown?,
	revision: number?,
	ops: { string }?,
	stages: { Stage }?,
	clock: Types.Clock?,
	-- Where listener errors go. Defaults to warn
	reportError: ((message: string) -> ())?,
	-- Hold deferred callbacks until `runHeld` instead of running them after each transaction.
	-- For callers that may throw away a transaction that already committed here, e.g. a write
	-- UpdateAsync retries
	holdDeferred: boolean?,
}

type Held = {
	callbacks: { (outcome: Transaction.Outcome) -> () },
	outcome: Transaction.Outcome,
}

export type Observer = (new: unknown, old: unknown, record: CommitRecord) -> ()

-- Computed from stored state. Reads like data, but is never written or saved
type Derived = {
	name: string,
	deps: { Path },
	read: (root: unknown) -> unknown,
}

type Listener = {
	path: Path?,
	callback: (...any) -> (),
	connected: boolean,
}

type Fields = {
	_root: unknown,
	_revision: number,
	_allowed: { [string]: boolean },
	_stages: { Stage },
	_clock: Types.Clock?,
	_reportError: (message: string) -> (),
	_observers: { Listener },
	_commitListeners: { Listener },
	_busy: boolean,
	_readOnly: string?,
	_derived: { [string]: Derived },
	_holdDeferred: boolean,
	_held: { Held },
}

--[=[
	@class Document

	In-memory state with the full transaction pipeline. Profiles and shared stores are built on it,
	and `Geode.Raw.document` makes a bare one
]=]
local Document = {}
Document.__index = Document

export type Document = typeof(setmetatable({} :: Fields, Document))

--[=[
	Creates a document holding a frozen copy of `options.data`

	@within Document
	@param options DocumentOptions?
	@return Document
]=]
function Document.new(options: Options?): Document
	local allowed: { [string]: boolean } = {}
	local ops: { string } = if options and options.ops then options.ops else {}
	for _, name in ops do
		allowed[name] = true
	end
	local self: Fields = {
		_root = Tree.adopt(if options and options.data ~= nil then options.data else {}),
		_revision = options and options.revision or 0,
		_allowed = allowed,
		_stages = if options and options.stages then table.clone(options.stages) else {},
		_clock = options and options.clock,
		_reportError = options and options.reportError or function(message: string)
			warn(message)
		end,
		_observers = {},
		_commitListeners = {},
		_busy = false,
		_readOnly = nil,
		_derived = {},
		_holdDeferred = options ~= nil and options.holdDeferred == true,
		_held = {},
	}
	return setmetatable(self, Document)
end

-- Reading

--[=[
	The frozen value at a path, or the whole state with no path
]=]
function Document.get(self: Document, path: PathLike?): unknown
	local parsed = Path.parse(path)
	local derived = self:_derivedAt(parsed)
	if derived then
		return Tree.get(derived.read(self._root), table.move(parsed, 2, #parsed, 1, {}))
	end
	return Tree.get(self._root, parsed)
end

function Document._derivedAt(self: Document, path: Path): Derived?
	local first = path[1]
	return if type(first) == "string" then self._derived[first] else nil
end

--[=[
	Adds a top level field computed from `deps`. Reads like any other field through `get` and
	`observe`, but it can't be written and isn't in the snapshot. The name can't clash with a
	stored field
]=]
function Document.addDerived(
	self: Document,
	name: string,
	deps: { PathLike },
	read: (root: unknown) -> unknown
)
	assert(type(name) == "string" and name ~= "", "a derived field needs a name")
	assert(self._derived[name] == nil, `a derived field named {name} already exists`)
	assert(
		Tree.get(self._root, { name }) == nil,
		`derived field {name} clashes with a stored field of the same name`
	)
	local parsed = {}
	for _, dep in deps do
		table.insert(parsed, Path.parse(dep))
	end
	self._derived[name] = { name = name, deps = parsed, read = read }
end

--[=[
	The whole state, frozen
]=]
function Document.snapshot(self: Document): unknown
	return self._root
end

--[=[
	How many commits so far. A transaction that changed nothing doesn't count
]=]
function Document.revision(self: Document): number
	return self._revision
end

--// writing

--[=[
	Refuses every transaction from now on, with `reason` as the error. For stores that can't
	save anymore, like a profile that lost its session
]=]
function Document.setReadOnly(self: Document, reason: string)
	self._readOnly = reason
end

--[=[
	Accepts transactions again after setReadOnly
]=]
function Document.clearReadOnly(self: Document)
	self._readOnly = nil
end

--[=[
	Whether writes are refused right now

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.isReadOnly(self: Document): boolean
	return self._readOnly ~= nil
end

--[=[
	Adds a stage that runs on every transaction before it commits
]=]
function Document.addStage(self: Document, stage: Stage)
	table.insert(self._stages, stage)
end

local function failure(kind: Transaction.TxErrorKind, message: string): TxResult
	return { ok = false, error = { kind = kind, message = message } }
end

--[=[
	Runs `body` against a draft and commits the result. Anything thrown inside discards the draft
	and comes back as an error. A transaction that changes nothing commits nothing

	@param body (tx: Transaction) -> ()
	@param options TransactOptions?
	@return TxResult

	```lua
	local result = document:transact(function(tx)
		tx:decrement("coins", 100)
		tx:append("inventory", { id = "sword" })
	end, { source = "system", note = "shop purchase" })
	```
]=]
function Document.transact(
	self: Document,
	body: (tx: Transaction) -> (),
	options: TransactOptions?
): TxResult
	if self._readOnly then
		return failure("readOnly", self._readOnly)
	end
	if self._busy then
		return failure("busy", "another transaction is still running on this document")
	end

	local source = Transaction.source(options and options.source)
	local tx = Transaction.new(self._root, source, self._allowed)
	local dryRun = options ~= nil and options.dryRun == true
	tx._dryRun = dryRun
	self._busy = true
	local ok, thrown = pcall(function()
		body(tx)
		for _, stage in self._stages do
			stage(tx)
		end
	end)
	self._busy = false
	tx:_close()
	if not ok then
		local err = Transaction.toError(thrown)
		self:_settle(tx, { committed = false, record = nil, error = err })
		return { ok = false, error = err }
	end

	local entries = Tree.diff(self._root, tx._root)
	for _, entry in entries do
		local derived = self:_derivedAt(entry.path)
		if derived then
			local err: Transaction.TxError = {
				kind = "rejected",
				message = `{derived.name} is a derived field and can't be written`,
			}
			self:_settle(tx, { committed = false, record = nil, error = err })
			return { ok = false, error = err }
		end
	end
	if dryRun then
		local paths = {}
		for _, entry in entries do
			table.insert(paths, Path.format(entry.path))
		end
		table.sort(paths)
		return { ok = true, record = nil, dryRun = { paths = paths, findings = tx._findings } }
	end
	if #entries == 0 then
		self:_settle(tx, { committed = false, record = nil, error = nil })
		return { ok = true, record = nil }
	end

	local diff: { [string]: DiffEntry } = {}
	for _, entry in entries do
		diff[Path.format(entry.path)] = table.freeze({
			path = table.freeze(entry.path),
			old = entry.old,
			new = entry.new,
		})
	end

	local previous = self._root
	self._root = tx._root
	self._revision += 1
	local record: CommitRecord = table.freeze({
		revision = self._revision,
		source = source,
		ops = table.freeze(tx._ops),
		diff = table.freeze(diff),
		timestamp = if self._clock then self._clock:now() else os.time(),
		note = options and options.note,
	})
	self:_notify(previous, entries, record)
	self:_settle(tx, { committed = true, record = record, error = nil })
	return { ok = true, record = record }
end

-- Runs what stages deferred. After listeners, so a deferred write sees committed state
function Document._settle(self: Document, tx: Transaction, outcome: Transaction.Outcome)
	if self._holdDeferred then
		table.insert(self._held, { callbacks = table.clone(tx._deferred), outcome = outcome })
		return
	end
	self:_runDeferred(tx._deferred, outcome)
end

function Document._runDeferred(
	self: Document,
	callbacks: { (outcome: Transaction.Outcome) -> () },
	outcome: Transaction.Outcome
)
	for _, callback in callbacks do
		local ok, err = pcall(function()
			callback(outcome)
		end)
		if not ok then
			self._reportError(`deferred callback error: {tostring(err)}`)
		end
	end
end

--[=[
	Runs the callbacks a `holdDeferred` document kept, oldest first. `outcome` overrides the one
	they were held with, for a transaction that committed here and was then thrown away
]=]
function Document.runHeld(self: Document, outcome: Transaction.Outcome?)
	local held = self._held
	self._held = {}
	for _, entry in held do
		self:_runDeferred(entry.callbacks, outcome or entry.outcome)
	end
end

--[=[
	Sets `path` to `value` as its own transaction

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.set(self: Document, path: PathLike, value: unknown): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:set(path, value)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Replaces the value at `path` with what `transform` returns, as its own transaction

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.update(
	self: Document,
	path: PathLike,
	transform: (current: unknown) -> unknown
): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:update(path, transform)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Adds `amount`, 1 by default, to the number at `path`

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.increment(self: Document, path: PathLike, amount: number?): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:increment(path, amount)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Subtracts `amount`, 1 by default, from the number at `path`

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.decrement(self: Document, path: PathLike, amount: number?): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:decrement(path, amount)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Adds `value` to the end of the list at `path`

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.append(self: Document, path: PathLike, value: unknown): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:append(path, value)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Inserts `value` into the list at `path` at `index`

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.insert(self: Document, path: PathLike, index: number, value: unknown): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:insert(path, index, value)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Removes the value at `path`

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.remove(self: Document, path: PathLike): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:remove(path)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Empties the table at `path`, or everything with no path

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.clear(self: Document, path: PathLike?): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:clear(path)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Copies the fields of `partial` into the table at `path`

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.merge(self: Document, path: PathLike?, partial: { [string]: unknown }): TxResult
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:merge(path, partial)
	end)
end

--[=[
	Runs the custom op `name` with the given arguments as its own transaction

	@within Document
]=]
function Document.op(self: Document, name: string, ...: any): TxResult
	local args = table.pack(...)
	return self:transact(function(tx)
		tx:op(name, table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
	end)
end

-- Listening

local function connect(list: { Listener }, listener: Listener): Types.Connection
	table.insert(list, listener)
	return {
		disconnect = function()
			listener.connected = false
			local index = table.find(list, listener)
			if index then
				table.remove(list, index)
			end
		end,
	}
end

--[=[
	Calls `callback` after every commit that changed the value at `path`, with the new and old
	values. Changes inside the value and replacements of a parent both count

	@return Connection
]=]
function Document.observe(self: Document, path: PathLike, callback: Observer): Types.Connection
	return connect(self._observers, {
		path = Path.parse(path),
		callback = callback,
		connected = true,
	})
end

--[=[
	Calls `callback` with the record of every commit
]=]
function Document.onCommit(self: Document, callback: (record: CommitRecord) -> ()): Types.Connection
	return connect(self._commitListeners, {
		path = nil,
		callback = callback,
		connected = true,
	})
end

function Document._call(self: Document, listener: Listener, ...: any)
	local args = table.pack(...)
	local ok, err = pcall(function()
		listener.callback(table.unpack(args, 1, args.n))
	end)
	if not ok then
		self._reportError(`listener error: {tostring(err)}`)
	end
end

-- Observers run first, then commit listeners, each group in the order it connected. A copy of each
-- list is walked so listeners can connect or disconnect while being called
function Document._notify(
	self: Document,
	previous: unknown,
	entries: { DiffEntry },
	record: CommitRecord
)
	for _, observer in table.clone(self._observers) do
		if not observer.connected then
			continue
		end
		local path = observer.path :: Path
		local derived = self:_derivedAt(path)
		local watched: { Path } = if derived then derived.deps else { path }
		local touched = false
		for _, entry in entries do
			for _, watchedPath in watched do
				if Path.related(entry.path, watchedPath) then
					touched = true
					break
				end
			end
			if touched then
				break
			end
		end
		if not touched then
			continue
		end
		if derived then
			local rest = table.move(path, 2, #path, 1, {})
			local old = Tree.get(derived.read(previous), rest)
			local new = Tree.get(derived.read(self._root), rest)
			if not Tree.equal(old, new) then
				self:_call(observer, new, old, record)
			end
		else
			local old = Tree.get(previous, path)
			local new = Tree.get(self._root, path)
			if old ~= new then
				self:_call(observer, new, old, record)
			end
		end
	end
	for _, listener in table.clone(self._commitListeners) do
		if listener.connected then
			self:_call(listener, record)
		end
	end
end

return Document

local Slider = React.forwardRef(function(props, ref)

			_condition = 0

			local _value = props.value

				local _value = props.value

					_result = props.value
				else
					local _condition = props["min-value"]
					if _condition == nil then
						_condition = 0
					end
					_result = Vector2.new(_condition, props["max-value"])
				end
				return _result
			end
			local _value = props.value
			local _result
			if type(_value) == "number" then
				_result = props.value
			else
				local _condition = props["min-value"]
				if _condition == nil then
					_condition = 0
				end
				_result = _condition
			end
			return _result
		end
		return value
	end, { props.controlled, props.range, props.value, props["min-value"], props["max-value"], value })
	local currentValueRef = React.useRef(currentValue)
	currentValueRef.current = currentValue
	local updateValue = React.useCallback(function(nextValue)
		if not propsRef.current.controlled then
			currentValueRef.current = nextValue
		end
		setValue(nextValue)
	end, {})
	local getNumberFromInput = React.useCallback(function(input)
		local container = containerRef.current
		if not container then
			return nil
		end
		local containerWidth = container.AbsoluteSize.X
		if containerWidth <= 0 then
			return nil
		end
		local inputX = input.Position.X
		local containerStart = container.AbsolutePosition.X
		local percentage = math.clamp((inputX - containerStart) / containerWidth, 0, 1)
		local currentProps = propsRef.current
		local _condition = currentProps["min-value"]
		if _condition == nil then
			_condition = 0
		end
		local minValue = _condition
		local maxValue = currentProps["max-value"]
		local nextValue = minValue + percentage * (maxValue - minValue)
		local step = currentProps.step
		if step ~= nil and step > 0 then
			nextValue = minValue + math.round((nextValue - minValue) / step) * step
			local parts = string.split(tostring(step), ".")
			local decimals = if #parts > 1 then #parts[2] else 0
			local scale = 10 ^ decimals
			nextValue = math.round(nextValue * scale) / scale

		local inputValue = getNumberFromInput(input)

		if not currentProps.range then
			return inputValue

		local _result
		if typeof(_current) == "Vector2" then
			_result = currentValueRef.current
		else

			if _condition == nil then
				_condition = 0
			end
			_result = Vector2.new(_condition, currentProps["max-value"])
		end

		if activeHandleRef.current == 0 then
			return Vector2.new(math.min(inputValue, rangeValue.Y), rangeValue.Y)
		end

		end

	end, { getNumberFromInput })
	local beginDragging = React.useCallback(function(handle, input)
		if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			return nil
		end

		isDraggingRef.current = true
		local nextValue = getValueFromInput(input)
		setDragging(true)
		if nextValue ~= nil then
			updateValue(nextValue)
			local _result = propsRef.current.onDragged
			if _result ~= nil then
				_result(nextValue)
			end

	end, { getValueFromInput, updateValue })
	React.useEffect(function()
		local inputChangedListener = CustomInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				return nil
			end
			if not isDraggingRef.current then
				return nil
			end
			local nextValue = getValueFromInput(input)
			if nextValue == nil then
				return nil
			end
			updateValue(nextValue)
			local _result = propsRef.current.onDragged
			if _result ~= nil then
				_result(nextValue)
			end
		end)
		local inputEndedListener = CustomInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
			if input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 and input.UserInputType ~= Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
				return nil
			end
			if not isDraggingRef.current then
				return nil
			end
			isDraggingRef.current = false
			local nextValue = getValueFromInput(input)
			activeHandleRef.current = nil
			setDragging(false)
			setHoveredHandle(nil)
			if nextValue ~= nil then
				updateValue(nextValue)
				local _result = propsRef.current.onChanged
				if _result ~= nil then
					_result(nextValue)
				end
			end
		end)
		return function()
			isDraggingRef.current = false
			activeHandleRef.current = nil
			inputChangedListener:Disconnect()
			inputEndedListener:Disconnect()
		end
	end, { getValueFromInput, updateValue })
	local _condition = props["min-value"]
	if _condition == nil then
		_condition = 0
	end
	local minValue = _condition
	local maxValue = props["max-value"]
	local valueRange = maxValue - minValue
	local firstValue

-- Upgrade shop: the team spends run cash on Upgrades.Defs during the Shop phase.
-- Plan: SYS-11 (upgrade shop), UI-06
--
-- Remote BuyUpgrade(id) -> "Bought" | "TooPoor" | "Maxed" | "Closed" (shop only open in the Shop phase)
-- UpgradeService.GetLevel(id) -> level this run
-- Effects: TruckHp -> TruckService.RefreshMaxHp; CookSpeed -> workspace attribute CookSpeed
-- (read by StationService); ExtraSlot -> workspace attribute TurretSlots (for SYS-08 build mode).

local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")

local Guard = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Guard)
local Net = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Net)
local Upgrades = require(ReplicatedStorage.Shared.Upgrades)
local EconomyService = require(script.Parent.EconomyService)
local GameService = require(script.Parent.GameService)
local TruckService = require(script.Parent.TruckService)

local UpgradeService = {}

function UpgradeService.GetLevel(id: string): number
	return workspace:GetAttribute(Upgrades.attribute(id)) or 0
end

local function applyEffects()
	local cookLevel = UpgradeService.GetLevel("CookSpeed")
	workspace:SetAttribute("CookSpeed", 1 / (1 - Upgrades.Defs.CookSpeed.Reduction) ^ cookLevel)
	workspace:SetAttribute("TurretSlots", Upgrades.BaseTurretSlots + UpgradeService.GetLevel("ExtraSlot"))
	TruckService.RefreshMaxHp()
end

local function resetLevels()
	for _, id in Upgrades.Ids do
		workspace:SetAttribute(Upgrades.attribute(id), 0)
	end
	workspace:SetAttribute("CookSpeed", 1)
	workspace:SetAttribute("TurretSlots", Upgrades.BaseTurretSlots)
end

local function buy(player: Player, id: string): string
	if GameService.GetState() ~= "Shop" then
		return "Closed"
	end
	local level = UpgradeService.GetLevel(id)
	local cost = Upgrades.nextCost(id, level)
	if not cost then
		return "Maxed"
	end
	-- Spend and level-up happen without yielding, so two players can't buy the same level twice.
	if not EconomyService.Spend(cost, player, Enum.AnalyticsEconomyTransactionType.Shop.Name, "Upgrade_" .. id) then
		return "TooPoor"
	end
	workspace:SetAttribute(Upgrades.attribute(id), level + 1)
	applyEffects()
	return "Bought"
end

function UpgradeService.Init()
	resetLevels()
	GameService.OnStateChanged(function(state)
		if state == "Ready" then
			resetLevels()
		end
	end)
end

function UpgradeService.Start()
	Net.handleInvoke("BuyUpgrade", { Guard.oneOf(Upgrades.Ids) }, buy, { rate = 3, burst = 4 })
end

return UpgradeService

	StoreName = "PlayerData_v1",

	UseMockInStudio = true,

	Version = 1,
	Stats = {

		RunsLost = 0,
		BestDay = 0,
		CustomersServed = 0,
		DishesServed = 0,
	},

	},
	TutorialStep = 0,
	PurchaseHistory = {},
}

	ResultsSeconds = 12,
	ShopSeconds = 25, -- upgrade shop between a night and the next day (SYS-11)
	StartCash = 0,
}

}

	PromptDistance = 10, -- studs, ProximityPrompt.MaxActivationDistance

	GripOffset = CFrame.new(0, -0.4, -0.7),

}

	TipRate = 0.5, -- tip = dish price * TipRate * remaining patience fraction
	ArriveDistance = 3,
	WalkTimeout = 30, -- seconds before a stuck customer is teleported to its slot

-- Validators for values that arrive from the client. Each builder returns a function
-- (value) -> boolean. Never trust a client value that has not passed one of these.

export type Check = (value: any) -> boolean

local Guard = {}

local function isFiniteNumber(value: any): boolean
	return type(value) == "number" and value == value and value ~= math.huge and value ~= -math.huge
end

function Guard.number(min: number?, max: number?): Check
	return function(value)
		return isFiniteNumber(value) and (min == nil or value >= min) and (max == nil or value <= max)
	end
end

function Guard.integer(min: number?, max: number?): Check
	local isNumber = Guard.number(min, max)
	return function(value)
		return isNumber(value) and math.floor(value) == value
	end
end

function Guard.string(maxLength: number?): Check
	local limit = maxLength or 200
	return function(value)
		return type(value) == "string" and #value <= limit and utf8.len(value) ~= nil
	end
end

function Guard.boolean(): Check
	return function(value)
		return type(value) == "boolean"
	end
end

-- Only one of the listed strings/numbers, e.g. Guard.oneOf({ "Sword", "Bow" }).
function Guard.oneOf(allowed: { any }): Check
	local set = {}
	for _, item in allowed do
		set[item] = true
	end
	return function(value)
		return (type(value) == "string" or type(value) == "number") and set[value] == true
	end
end

-- An Instance of the class, optionally required to be inside `ancestor` (e.g. workspace.Map).
function Guard.instance(className: string, ancestor: Instance?): Check
	return function(value)
		return typeof(value) == "Instance"
			and value:IsA(className)
			and (ancestor == nil or value:IsDescendantOf(ancestor))
	end
end

function Guard.vector3(maxMagnitude: number?): Check
	return function(value)
		return typeof(value) == "Vector3"
			and isFiniteNumber(value.X)
			and isFiniteNumber(value.Y)
			and isFiniteNumber(value.Z)
			and (maxMagnitude == nil or value.Magnitude <= maxMagnitude)
	end
end

-- A plain array (keys 1..n) of at most maxLength items that all pass `check`.
function Guard.array(check: Check, maxLength: number): Check
	return function(value)
		if type(value) ~= "table" then
			return false
		end

		for key, item in value do
			count += 1
			if type(key) ~= "number" or key ~= count or count > maxLength or not check(item) then
				return false
			end
		end
		return true
	end
end

function Guard.optional(check: Check): Check
	return function(value)
		return value == nil or check(value)
	end
end

-- budget_curve.luau — what the kit's own curve rule (src/kit/AnimCurve thin / lost) would do to built clips, without
-- Studio: for kit/anim/budget.py.
--   lune run kit/anim/budget_curve.luau <out.json> <clip.json> [<clip.json> ...]
-- Per clip: its tracks' keys (a turn and a place count once each a frame; the joints AND the weapon's Handle
-- joint - `grip` / `grip_left` - which the exporter writes and thins too), the keys a curve within the kit's
-- tolerances (AnimCurve.ROT_TOL degrees, AnimCurve.POS_TOL studs) keeps, the most the engine's 30-a-second curve
-- playback would lose (degrees, studs), what a curve animation would be off by AT AN EVENT's own frame (the
-- thinning AND the engine's 30-a-second grid together: a Hit on an odd frame of a 60-a-second clip is not played),
-- and the clip's POPS: a joint that turns more than 90 degrees in one frame is a broken frame, not motion - its
-- loss is counted apart.
local AnimCurve = require("../../src/kit/AnimCurve")
local fs = require("@lune/fs")
local process = require("@lune/process")
local serde = require("@lune/serde")

type Q = { number }

local function slerp(a: Q, b: Q, u: number): Q
	local dot = a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2] + a[3] * b[3] + a[4] * b[4]
	local sign = if dot < 0 then -1 else 1
	dot = math.abs(dot)
	local wa, wb = 1 - u, u
	if dot < 0.9995 then
		local th = math.acos(dot)
		wa, wb = math.sin((1 - u) * th) / math.sin(th), math.sin(u * th) / math.sin(th)
	end
	local q = {
		wa * a[1] + sign * wb * b[1],
		wa * a[2] + sign * wb * b[2],
		wa * a[3] + sign * wb * b[3],
		wa * a[4] + sign * wb * b[4],
	}
	local n = math.sqrt(q[1] ^ 2 + q[2] ^ 2 + q[3] ^ 2 + q[4] ^ 2)
	return { q[1] / n, q[2] / n, q[3] / n, q[4] / n }
end

local function angle(a: Q, b: Q): number
	local dot = math.clamp(math.abs(a[1] * b[1] + a[2] * b[2] + a[3] * b[3] + a[4] * b[4]), 0, 1)
	return math.deg(2 * math.acos(dot))
end

local function lerp3(a: { number }, b: { number }, u: number): { number }
	return { a[1] + (b[1] - a[1]) * u, a[2] + (b[2] - a[2]) * u, a[3] + (b[3] - a[3]) * u }
end

local function dist3(a: { number }, b: { number }): number
	return math.sqrt((a[1] - b[1]) ^ 2 + (a[2] - b[2]) ^ 2 + (a[3] - b[3]) ^ 2)
end

-- the track's value at a time (the line between the keys either side)
local function sample<T>(times: { number }, values: { T }, t: number, lerp: (T, T, number) -> T): T
	local n = #times
	if t <= times[1] then
		return values[1]
	elseif t >= times[n] then
		return values[n]
	end
	for k = 2, n do
		if times[k] >= t then
			return lerp(values[k - 1], values[k], (t - times[k - 1]) / (times[k] - times[k - 1]))
		end
	end
	return values[n]
end

-- what a curve animation plays at key i: the thinned track, sampled by the engine at 30 a second
local function engineAt<T>(times: { number }, values: { T }, kept: { number }, i: number, lerp: (T, T, number) -> T): T
	local kt: { number }, kv: { T } = {}, {}
	for _, k in kept do
		table.insert(kt, times[k])
		table.insert(kv, values[k])
	end
	local g = times[i] * AnimCurve.GRID
	local before, after = math.floor(g) / AnimCurve.GRID, math.ceil(g) / AnimCurve.GRID
	if after == before then
		return sample(kt, kv, times[i], lerp)
	end
	return lerp(sample(kt, kv, before, lerp), sample(kt, kv, after, lerp), g - math.floor(g))
end

local POP = 90 -- degrees in one frame: a broken frame, not motion

local out = {}
for i = 2, #process.args do
	local path = process.args[i]
	local ok, clip = pcall(function()
		return serde.decode("json", fs.readFile(path))
	end)
	if not ok or type(clip) ~= "table" or type(clip.times) ~= "table" or type(clip.joints) ~= "table" then
		out[path] = { error = "not a clip" }
		continue
	end
	local times: { number } = clip.times
	local fps = tonumber(clip.fps) or 30
	local eventFrames: { number } = {}
	for _, ev in clip.events or {} do
		if type(ev) == "table" and type(ev.t) == "number" then
			table.insert(eventFrames, math.clamp(math.floor(ev.t * fps + 0.5) + 1, 1, #times))
		end
	end
	local row = {
		frames = #times,
		tracks = 0,
		keys = 0,
		kept = 0,
		lostDeg = 0,
		lostStuds = 0,
		eventDeg = 0,
		eventStuds = 0,
		moving = 0,
		pops = 0,
		popLostDeg = 0,
	}
	local tracks: { any } = {}
	for _, joint in clip.joints do
		table.insert(tracks, joint.frames)
	end
	for _, key in { "grip", "grip_left" } do -- (the weapon's Handle joint: written and thinned by the exporter)
		if type(clip[key]) == "table" then
			table.insert(tracks, clip[key])
		end
	end
	for _, frames in tracks do
		if type(frames) ~= "table" or #frames ~= #times then
			continue
		end
		local rots: { Q }, places: { { number } } = {}, {}
		local turns, slides = false, false
		for k, f in frames do
			rots[k] = { f[1], f[2], f[3], f[4] }
			places[k] = { f[5], f[6], f[7] }
			if angle(rots[k], rots[1]) > 0.01 then -- (a hundredth of a degree: a held pose's float noise is no motion)
				turns = true
			end
			if dist3(places[k], places[1]) > 1e-4 then
				slides = true
			end
		end
		local popped = false
		for k = 2, #rots do
			if angle(rots[k], rots[k - 1]) > POP then
				popped = true
				row.pops += 1
			end
		end
		row.tracks += 1
		row.keys += 2 * #times
		if turns or slides then
			row.moving += 1
		end
		local keptR = AnimCurve.thin(times, rots, AnimCurve.ROT_TOL, slerp, angle)
		local keptP = AnimCurve.thin(times, places, AnimCurve.POS_TOL, lerp3, dist3)
		row.kept += #keptR + #keptP
		local lostDeg = AnimCurve.lost(times, rots, slerp, angle)
		if popped then
			row.popLostDeg = math.max(row.popLostDeg, lostDeg) -- (a broken frame's "loss" is not the compression's price)
		else
			row.lostDeg = math.max(row.lostDeg, lostDeg)
		end
		row.lostStuds = math.max(row.lostStuds, AnimCurve.lost(times, places, lerp3, dist3))
		if not popped then
			for _, e in eventFrames do
				row.eventDeg = math.max(row.eventDeg, angle(rots[e], engineAt(times, rots, keptR, e, slerp)))
				row.eventStuds = math.max(row.eventStuds, dist3(places[e], engineAt(times, places, keptP, e, lerp3)))
			end
		end
	end
	out[path] = row
end
fs.writeFile(process.args[1], serde.encode("json", out))
print(#process.args - 1)

-- One place for every remote. The server creates them (Net.setup), validates and
-- rate-limits every client call; the client only fires intents.
--
-- Server: Net.handle("BuyItem", { Guard.oneOf(itemIds) }, function(player, itemId) ... end)
-- Client: Net.fire("BuyItem", "Sword")

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local ReplicatedStorage = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")

local Guard = require(script.Parent.Guard)

local Net = {}

-- Add a name here before using it on either side.
Net.Events = { "DataSync", "DropItem", "Notify", "RunResult" } -- RemoteEvents
Net.Functions = { "GetData", "BuyUpgrade" } -- RemoteFunctions, client -> server only (never InvokeClient)

type Options = { rate: number?, burst: number? }

local FOLDER_NAME = "Remotes"
local DEFAULT_RATE = 10 -- calls per second per player per remote
local IS_SERVER = RunService:IsServer()

local folder: Folder? = nil

local function getFolder(): Folder
	if folder then
		return folder
	end
	local found = if IS_SERVER
		then ReplicatedStorage:FindFirstChild(FOLDER_NAME)
		else ReplicatedStorage:WaitForChild(FOLDER_NAME)
	if not found then
		local created = Instance.new("Folder")
		created.Name = FOLDER_NAME
		created.Parent = ReplicatedStorage
		found = created
	end
	folder = found :: Folder
	return folder :: Folder
end

local function getRemote(name: string, className: string): any
	local remotes = getFolder()
	local remote = if IS_SERVER then remotes:FindFirstChild(name) else remotes:WaitForChild(name, 10)
	assert(
		remote and remote:IsA(className),
		`Remote "{name}" ({className}) is missing: add it to Net.Events or Net.Functions`
	)
	return remote
end

-- Token bucket per player per remote.
local buckets: { [Player]: { [string]: { tokens: number, last: number } } } = {}

local function allow(player: Player, name: string, rate: number, burst: number): boolean
	local playerBuckets = buckets[player]
	if not playerBuckets then
		playerBuckets = {}
		buckets[player] = playerBuckets
	end
	local now = os.clock()
	local bucket = playerBuckets[name]
	if not bucket then
		bucket = { tokens = burst, last = now }
		playerBuckets[name] = bucket
	end
	bucket.tokens = math.min(burst, bucket.tokens + (now - bucket.last) * rate)
	bucket.last = now
	if bucket.tokens < 1 then
		return false
	end
	bucket.tokens -= 1
	return true
end

local function argsValid(validators: { Guard.Check }, ...: any): boolean
	if select("#", ...) > #validators then
		return false
	end
	for index, check in validators do
		if not check((select(index, ...))) then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

local function limits(options: Options?): (number, number)
	local rate = options and options.rate or DEFAULT_RATE
	local burst = options and options.burst or math.max(rate, 1)
	return rate, burst
end

-- Server ----------------------------------------------------------------------

function Net.setup()
	assert(IS_SERVER, "Net.setup is server-only")
	local remotes = getFolder()
	for _, name in Net.Events do
		if not remotes:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local remote = Instance.new("RemoteEvent")
			remote.Name = name
			remote.Parent = remotes
		end
	end
	for _, name in Net.Functions do
		if not remotes:FindFirstChild(name) then
			local remote = Instance.new("RemoteFunction")
			remote.Name = name
			remote.Parent = remotes
		end
	end
	Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
		buckets[player] = nil
	end)
end

-- Rejected calls (bad arguments, too many calls) are dropped silently.
function Net.handle(name: string, validators: { Guard.Check }, handler: (Player, ...any) -> (), options: Options?)
	local remote = getRemote(name, "RemoteEvent")
	local rate, burst = limits(options)
	remote.OnServerEvent:Connect(function(player: Player, ...)
		if allow(player, name, rate, burst) and argsValid(validators, ...) then
			handler(player, ...)
		end
	end)
end

-- Rejected calls return nil to the client.
function Net.handleInvoke(
	name: string,
	validators: { Guard.Check },
	handler: (Player, ...any) -> ...any,
	options: Options?
)
	local remote = getRemote(name, "RemoteFunction")
	local rate, burst = limits(options)
	remote.OnServerInvoke = function(player: Player, ...)
		if allow(player, name, rate, burst) and argsValid(validators, ...) then
			return handler(player, ...)
		end
		return nil
	end
end

function Net.fireClient(player: Player, name: string, ...: any)
	getRemote(name, "RemoteEvent"):FireClient(player, ...)
end

function Net.fireAll(name: string, ...: any)
	getRemote(name, "RemoteEvent"):FireAllClients(...)
end

-- Client ----------------------------------------------------------------------

function Net.fire(name: string, ...: any)
	getRemote(name, "RemoteEvent"):FireServer(...)
end

function Net.invoke(name: string, ...: any): ...any
	return getRemote(name, "RemoteFunction"):InvokeServer(...)
end

function Net.on(name: string, handler: (...any) -> ()): RBXScriptConnection
	return getRemote(name, "RemoteEvent").OnClientEvent:Connect(handler)
end

return Net

-- clip_of.luau — `lune run kit/anim/clip_of.luau <spec.json | clip.json> <out.clip.json> [R6]`: one spec -> its
-- neutral clip (and, with R6, the folded R6 clip), nothing else. Given a CLIP (a gait's or a bake's output: it has
-- `times` and `joints[...].frames`) it only folds. The Python tests use it to check kit/anim/clip.py's sampler
-- against the kit's own (kit/lib/anim.luau) — two implementations of the spec's semantics must agree — and to run
-- the R6 fold (Anim.foldToR6) on generated gaits exactly as `kit anim` does.
local fs = require("@lune/fs")
local process = require("@lune/process")
local serde = require("@lune/serde")

local Anim = require("../lib/anim")

local inPath, outPath, rig = process.args[1], process.args[2], process.args[3]
if not inPath or not outPath then
	print("usage: lune run kit/anim/clip_of.luau <spec.json | clip.json> <out.clip.json> [R6]")
	process.exit(7)
end
local data = serde.decode("json", fs.readFile(inPath))
local clip, issues
if type(data.times) == "table" and type(data.joints) == "table" then
	clip, issues = data, {} -- already a clip: fold it as kit anim would
else
	clip, issues = Anim.clipFromSpec(data, { source = { kind = "spec", file = inPath } })
end
for _, i in issues do
	print(`[{i.severity}] {i.path}: {i.message}`)
end
if not clip then
	process.exit(6)
end
if rig == "R6" then
	clip = (Anim.foldToR6(clip))
end
fs.writeFile(outPath, serde.encode("json", clip, true))
print(`clip {clip.name} ({clip.rig}): {#clip.times} frames -> {outPath}`)

-- kfs_dump.luau — `lune run kit/anim/kfs_dump.luau <file.rbxm|rbxmx> <out.json> [<KeyframeSequence name>]`
-- A Roblox model file (a community animation pack, a Roblox-owned default animation fetched as reference) ->
-- one KeyframeSequence as JSON: its keyframes (time, name), every Pose (joint-space CFrame components, easing
-- style/direction, weight), the sequence's Loop and Priority, and the names of every KeyframeSequence in the file.
-- The file is DATA: only Keyframes and Poses are read; nothing in it runs. kit/anim/kfs_import.py turns the JSON
-- into the kit's R6 clip.
local fs = require("@lune/fs")
local process = require("@lune/process")
local roblox = require("@lune/roblox")
local serde = require("@lune/serde")

local function emit(status: string, summary: string, nextAction: string, extra: { [string]: any }?)
	local rec: { [string]: any } = { schema = 1, status = status, summary = summary, next_action = nextAction }
	for k, v in extra or {} do
		rec[k] = v
	end
	print(serde.encode("json", rec))
	process.exit(if status == "pass" then 0 else 1)
end

local inPath, outPath, want = process.args[1], process.args[2], process.args[3]
if not inPath or not outPath then
	emit(
		"fail",
		"kfs_dump: needs <file.rbxm> <out.json> [<KeyframeSequence name>]",
		"lune run kit/anim/kfs_dump.luau <file.rbxm> <out.json> Walk"
	)
end
local okRead, raw = pcall(fs.readFile, inPath)
if not okRead then
	emit("fail", `kfs_dump: cannot read {inPath}`, "check the path")
end
local okModel, model = pcall(function()
	if string.match(string.lower(inPath), "%.rbxlx?$") then
		-- a place file: its DataModel's services are the roots
		local dm = roblox.deserializePlace(raw)
		return dm:GetChildren()
	end
	return roblox.deserializeModel(raw)
end)
if not okModel then
	emit(
		"fail",
		`kfs_dump: {inPath} is not a Roblox model file ({tostring(model)})`,
		"a .rbxm / .rbxmx saved from Studio"
	)
end

local all, scripts = {}, {}
local function findAll(list)
	for _, inst in list do
		if inst.ClassName == "KeyframeSequence" then
			table.insert(all, inst)
		elseif inst.ClassName == "Script" or inst.ClassName == "LocalScript" or inst.ClassName == "ModuleScript" then
			table.insert(scripts, inst:GetFullName())
		end
		findAll(inst:GetChildren())
	end
end
findAll(model)
if #all == 0 then
	emit(
		"fail",
		`kfs_dump: no KeyframeSequence in {inPath}`,
		"a file holding KeyframeSequence objects (the Animation Editor's 'Save to Roblox' or a free model)"
	)
end
local names = {}
for _, k in all do
	table.insert(names, k.Name)
end
local kfs = all[1]
if want then
	kfs = nil
	for _, k in all do
		if k.Name == want then
			kfs = k
		end
	end
	if not kfs then
		emit("fail", `kfs_dump: no KeyframeSequence named "{want}" in {inPath}`, `one of: {table.concat(names, ", ")}`)
	end
end

local out = {
	name = kfs.Name,
	loop = kfs.Loop,
	priority = string.gsub(tostring(kfs.Priority), "^Enum%.AnimationPriority%.", ""),
	keyframes = {},
	all = names,
	scripts = scripts,
	file = inPath,
}
local function walkPoses(pose, acc)
	for _, child in pose:GetChildren() do
		if child.ClassName == "Pose" then
			local x, y, z, r00, r01, r02, r10, r11, r12, r20, r21, r22 = child.CFrame:GetComponents()
			acc[child.Name] = {
				cf = { x, y, z, r00, r01, r02, r10, r11, r12, r20, r21, r22 },
				easing = string.gsub(tostring(child.EasingStyle), "^Enum%.PoseEasingStyle%.", ""),
				dir = string.gsub(tostring(child.EasingDirection), "^Enum%.PoseEasingDirection%.", ""),
				weight = child.Weight,
			}
			walkPoses(child, acc)
		end
	end
end
for _, kf in kfs:GetChildren() do
	if kf.ClassName == "Keyframe" then
		local poses = {}
		walkPoses(kf, poses)
		local markers = {}
		for _, m in kf:GetChildren() do
			if m.ClassName == "KeyframeMarker" then
				table.insert(markers, { name = m.Name, value = m.Value })
			end
		end
		table.insert(out.keyframes, { t = kf.Time, name = kf.Name, poses = poses, markers = markers })
	end
end
table.sort(out.keyframes, function(a, b)
	return a.t < b.t
end)
fs.writeFile(outPath, serde.encode("json", out, true))
emit(
	"pass",
	`kfs_dump {kfs.Name}: {#out.keyframes} keyframes, loop={tostring(kfs.Loop)}, priority={out.priority}{if #scripts
			> 0
		then ` — {#scripts} script(s) in the file (not run)`
		else ""}`,
	`python kit/anim/kfs_import.py {outPath}`,
	{ all = names, scripts = scripts }
)

-- Ingredients, dishes, stations and recipes. All numbers are tuning placeholders.
-- Plan: SYS-01, SYS-04
--
-- Recipes.Items[id]   -> { Name, Kind = "Ingredient" | "Dish", Color }
-- Recipes.Dishes[id]  -> { Name, Station, Inputs, CookTime, BurnTime, Price, Color }
-- Recipes.Stations[id]-> { Name }
-- Recipes.IngredientIds / DishIds / StationIds -> sorted arrays for Guard.oneOf
-- Recipes.findDish(stationType, inputs) -> dishId? (exact match)
-- Recipes.canAccept(stationType, inputs, ingredient) -> boolean (can still become a recipe)
--
-- Rule: at one station no recipe's Inputs may be a subset of another's, because a station
-- starts cooking as soon as its inputs match a recipe exactly.

local Recipes = {}

Recipes.Stations = {
	Grill = { Name = "Grill" },
	Fryer = { Name = "Fryer" },
	Oven = { Name = "Oven" },
}

local ingredients = {
	Bun = { Name = "Bun", Color = Color3.fromRGB(222, 184, 120) },
	Patty = { Name = "Patty", Color = Color3.fromRGB(140, 80, 60) },
	Sausage = { Name = "Sausage", Color = Color3.fromRGB(200, 90, 80) },
	Potato = { Name = "Potato", Color = Color3.fromRGB(190, 160, 90) },
	Dough = { Name = "Dough", Color = Color3.fromRGB(240, 230, 200) },
	Cheese = { Name = "Cheese", Color = Color3.fromRGB(250, 205, 60) },
}

Recipes.Dishes = {
	Burger = {
		Name = "Burger",
		Station = "Grill",
		Inputs = { "Bun", "Patty" },
		CookTime = 8,
		BurnTime = 10,
		Price = 12,
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(205, 120, 60),
	},
	HotDog = {
		Name = "Hot Dog",
		Station = "Grill",
		Inputs = { "Bun", "Sausage" },
		CookTime = 7,
		BurnTime = 10,
		Price = 10,
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(225, 110, 80),
	},
	Fries = {
		Name = "Fries",
		Station = "Fryer",
		Inputs = { "Potato" },
		CookTime = 6,
		BurnTime = 8,
		Price = 6,
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(250, 215, 90),
	},
	Pizza = {
		Name = "Pizza",
		Station = "Oven",
		Inputs = { "Dough", "Cheese" },
		CookTime = 12,
		BurnTime = 12,
		Price = 18,
		Color = Color3.fromRGB(230, 120, 70),
	},
}

Recipes.Items = {}
Recipes.IngredientIds = {}
Recipes.DishIds = {}
Recipes.StationIds = {}

for id, item in ingredients do
	Recipes.Items[id] = { Name = item.Name, Kind = "Ingredient", Color = item.Color }
	table.insert(Recipes.IngredientIds, id)
end
for id, dish in Recipes.Dishes do
	Recipes.Items[id] = { Name = dish.Name, Kind = "Dish", Color = dish.Color }
	table.insert(Recipes.DishIds, id)
end
for id in Recipes.Stations do
	table.insert(Recipes.StationIds, id)
end
table.sort(Recipes.IngredientIds)
table.sort(Recipes.DishIds)
table.sort(Recipes.StationIds)

local function count(list: { string }): { [string]: number }
	local counts = {}
	for _, id in list do
		counts[id] = (counts[id] or 0) + 1
	end
	return counts
end

-- true if every ingredient in `have` appears in `need` at least as often as in `have`.
local function isSubset(have: { [string]: number }, need: { [string]: number }): boolean
	for id, amount in have do
		if (need[id] or 0) < amount then
			return false
		end
	end
	return true
end

function Recipes.findDish(stationType: string, inputs: { string }): string?
	local have = count(inputs)
	for id, dish in Recipes.Dishes do
		if dish.Station == stationType and #dish.Inputs == #inputs and isSubset(have, count(dish.Inputs)) then
			return id
		end
	end
	return nil
end

function Recipes.canAccept(stationType: string, inputs: { string }, ingredient: string): boolean
	local combined = table.clone(inputs)
	table.insert(combined, ingredient)
	local have = count(combined)
	for _, dish in Recipes.Dishes do
		if dish.Station == stationType and isSubset(have, count(dish.Inputs)) then
			return true
		end
	end
	return false
end

-- Catch data mistakes at require time instead of in the middle of a run.
for id, dish in Recipes.Dishes do
	assert(Recipes.Stations[dish.Station], `Dish {id} uses unknown station {dish.Station}`)
	for _, input in dish.Inputs do
		assert(ingredients[input], `Dish {id} uses unknown ingredient {input}`)
	end
	for otherId, other in Recipes.Dishes do
		if otherId ~= id and other.Station == dish.Station then
			assert(not isSubset(count(dish.Inputs), count(other.Inputs)), `{id} is a subset of {otherId}`)
		end
	end
end

return Recipes

-- kfs_studio.luau — run INSIDE Roblox Studio (execute_luau, Edit mode, logged in): fetch Creator Store models by
-- asset id, find every KeyframeSequence inside, and return them as the kit's dump JSON (the same shape as
-- kit/anim/kfs_dump.luau writes), one entry per sequence. Nothing from the model is parented into the place and no
-- script in it runs: the model is loaded, read, and destroyed.
--
--   local IDS = { 8304861128, 125909948357929 }   -- edit, then execute this whole file as the code
--
-- Save the returned text to _downloads/creator_store/<assetId>.kfs.json (one file per asset) and import a sequence:
--   lune run kit anim import _downloads/creator_store/<assetId>.kfs.json --clip <KeyframeSequence name> --as <Name>
local IDS = { 8304861128 }

local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local InsertService = game:GetService("InsertService")

local function enumName(v)
	return tostring(v):gsub("^Enum%.%w+%.", "")
end

local function walkPoses(pose, acc)
	for _, child in pose:GetChildren() do
		if child:IsA("Pose") then
			local x, y, z, r00, r01, r02, r10, r11, r12, r20, r21, r22 = child.CFrame:GetComponents()
			acc[child.Name] = {
				cf = { x, y, z, r00, r01, r02, r10, r11, r12, r20, r21, r22 },
				easing = enumName(child.EasingStyle),
				dir = enumName(child.EasingDirection),
				weight = child.Weight,
			}
			walkPoses(child, acc)
		end
	end
end

local function dumpSequence(kfs, assetId)
	local out = { name = kfs.Name, loop = kfs.Loop, priority = enumName(kfs.Priority), keyframes = {}, asset = assetId }
	for _, kf in kfs:GetChildren() do
		if kf:IsA("Keyframe") then
			local poses, markers = {}, {}
			walkPoses(kf, poses)
			for _, m in kf:GetChildren() do
				if m:IsA("KeyframeMarker") then
					table.insert(markers, { name = m.Name, value = m.Value })
				end
			end
			table.insert(out.keyframes, { t = kf.Time, name = kf.Name, poses = poses, markers = markers })
		end
	end
	table.sort(out.keyframes, function(a, b)
		return a.t < b.t
	end)
	return out
end

local report = {}
for _, id in IDS do
	local ok, model = pcall(function()
		return InsertService:LoadAsset(id)
	end)
	if not ok or not model then
		report[tostring(id)] = { error = tostring(model) }
		continue
	end
	local sequences, scripts, animations = {}, {}, {}
	for _, inst in model:GetDescendants() do
		if inst:IsA("KeyframeSequence") then
			table.insert(sequences, dumpSequence(inst, id))
		elseif inst:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") then
			table.insert(scripts, inst:GetFullName())
		elseif inst:IsA("Animation") then
			table.insert(animations, { name = inst.Name, id = inst.AnimationId })
		end
	end
	report[tostring(id)] = { name = model.Name, sequences = sequences, scripts = scripts, animations = animations }
	model:Destroy()
end
return HttpService:JSONEncode(report)

--!strict
--#define PLATFORM server
--#define VERSION_MAJOR 2
--#define VERSION_MINOR 14
--#define ASSERT(cond, msg) if not (cond) then error(msg, 2) end
--#define LOG(level, a, b) print("[" .. level .. "]", a, b)
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Module = {}
Module.__index = Module

export type State = {
	count: number,
	names: { string },
}

function Module.new(count: number): State
	ASSERT(count >= 0, "count must be positive")
	local self = setmetatable({ count = count, names = {} }, Module)
	--#ifeq PLATFORM server
	self.isServer = true
	--#else
	self.isServer = false
	--#endif
	return self
end

function Module:describe(): string
	local version = `{--[[# VERSION_MAJOR ]]}.{--[[# VERSION_MINOR ]]}`
	--#if VERSION_MAJOR >= 2 && VERSION_MINOR > 10
	return string.format("v%s (%d items, %d names)", version, self.count, #self.names)
	--#elif VERSION_MAJOR == 1
	return "legacy"
	--#else
	return "unknown"
	--#endif
end

function Module:add(name: string)
	table.insert(self.names, name)
	LOG("info", name, #self.names)
end

for _, player in Players:GetPlayers() do
	print(player.Name, (function(a, b) return a + b end)(1, 2))
end

-- Run upgrades sold in the Shop phase (between a night and the next day). Shared so the
-- shop UI shows the same costs the server charges; the server is the only one that charges.
-- Plan: SYS-11 (upgrade shop), UI-06
--
-- Levels replicate as workspace attributes "Upgrade_<Id>" (reset every run).

local Upgrades = {}

export type Def = {
	MaxLevel: number,
	Costs: { number }, -- Costs[n] = price of level n
}

Upgrades.Defs = {
	-- +PerLevel max HP (and heals by the same amount when bought).
	TruckHp = { MaxLevel = 5, Costs = { 150, 250, 400, 600, 850 }, PerLevel = 25 },
	-- Each level cuts cooking time by Reduction (multiplicative): time x (1 - Reduction)^level.
	CookSpeed = { MaxLevel = 5, Costs = { 200, 325, 500, 725, 1000 }, Reduction = 0.12 },
	-- +1 turret slot per level on top of BaseTurretSlots (read by the build mode, SYS-08).
	ExtraSlot = { MaxLevel = 3, Costs = { 300, 550, 900 } },
}

Upgrades.Ids = {} :: { string }
for id in Upgrades.Defs do
	table.insert(Upgrades.Ids, id)
end
table.sort(Upgrades.Ids)

Upgrades.BaseTurretSlots = 3

function Upgrades.attribute(id: string): string
	return "Upgrade_" .. id
end

-- Price of the next level, or nil when maxed.
function Upgrades.nextCost(id: string, level: number): number?
	local def = Upgrades.Defs[id]
	if not def or level >= def.MaxLevel then
		return nil
	end
	return def.Costs[level + 1]
end

return Upgrades

-- look_probe.luau — run INSIDE Roblox Studio (Studio MCP: execute_luau, datamodel_type = "Edit") by `kit anim look <Name>`:
-- a LIVE loop of the clip on a fresh humanoid of its rig, far from the place's own content, on a lit pad, stepped by
-- Heartbeat in Edit mode (no Play needed) — select Workspace._kit_anim_look in the Explorer and press F to look.
-- Nothing of the place is touched; `kit anim look --stop` (or Workspace._kit_anim_look.Stop.Value = true, then
-- delete the model) removes everything. The poses come from the kit's compiled model: what the game plays.
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local KeyframeSequenceProvider = game:GetService("KeyframeSequenceProvider")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local NAME = "Walk" -- @kit:name
local RIG = "R15" -- @kit:rig
local SPOT = { -60, 0, 60 } -- @kit:spot
local DATA_JSON = [==[{}]==] -- @kit:data

local data = HttpService:JSONDecode(DATA_JSON)
local old = Workspace:FindFirstChild("_kit_anim_look")
if old then
	old:Destroy()
end
local seq = Instance.new("KeyframeSequence")
seq.Name = NAME
seq.Loop = data.loop ~= false
seq.Priority = (Enum.AnimationPriority :: any)[data.priority or "Movement"] or Enum.AnimationPriority.Movement
for i, t in data.times do
	local kf = Instance.new("Keyframe")
	kf.Time = t
	kf.Parent = seq
	local poses = {}
	local function poseOf(n: string): Pose
		if poses[n] then
			return poses[n]
		end
		local p = Instance.new("Pose")
		p.Name = n
		p.Weight = if data.poses[n] then 1 else 0
		p.EasingStyle = Enum.PoseEasingStyle.Linear
		poses[n] = p
		if n == data.root then
			p.Parent = kf
		else
			p.Parent = poseOf(data.parent[n])
		end
		return p
	end
	poseOf(data.root)
	for n, frames in data.poses do
		local f = frames[i]
		poseOf(n).CFrame = CFrame.new(f[1], f[2], f[3], f[4], f[5], f[6], f[7], f[8], f[9], f[10], f[11], f[12])
	end
end
local model =
	Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(Instance.new("HumanoidDescription"), (Enum.HumanoidRigType :: any)[RIG])
model.Name = "_kit_anim_look"
local stop = Instance.new("BoolValue")
stop.Name = "Stop"
stop.Parent = model
local spot = Vector3.new(SPOT[1], SPOT[2], SPOT[3])
local pad = Instance.new("Part")
pad.Name = "_kit_anim_look_pad"
pad.Anchored = true
pad.Size = Vector3.new(12, 1, 12)
pad.CFrame = CFrame.new(spot - Vector3.new(0, 0.5, 0))
pad.Color = Color3.fromRGB(70, 70, 76)
pad.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
pad.Parent = model
model.Parent = Workspace
model:PivotTo(CFrame.new(spot + Vector3.new(0, if RIG == "R6" then 3.0 else 3.2, 0)))
local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") :: BasePart?
if root then
	local lamp = Instance.new("PointLight")
	lamp.Name = "_kit_lamp"
	lamp.Brightness = 3
	lamp.Range = 24
	lamp.Shadows = false
	lamp.Parent = root
end
local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator")
animator.Parent = humanoid
local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
animation.AnimationId = KeyframeSequenceProvider:RegisterKeyframeSequence(seq)
local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
local t0 = os.clock()
while track.Length <= 0 and os.clock() - t0 < 5 do
	task.wait(0.05)
end
seq:Destroy()
track.Looped = data.loop ~= false
track:Play(0, 1, 1)
local conn
conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	if stop.Value or not model.Parent then
		conn:Disconnect()
		return
	end
	animator:StepAnimations(math.min(dt, 0.05))
end)
return ("looping %s (%s) on Workspace._kit_anim_look at (%d, %d, %d): select it in the Explorer and press F; length %.2f s, %d keyframes"):format(
	NAME,
	RIG,
	SPOT[1],
	SPOT[2],
	SPOT[3],
	track.Length,
	#data.times
)

-- match_run.luau — `lune run kit/anim/match_run.luau <table.json> <queries.json>`: asks the GAME's own matcher
-- (src/kit/AnimMatch.luau) and prints its answers as one JSON line, so the build side (kit/anim/match_tables.py) can
-- be held to it. queries: a list of
--   { "pose": { joint: [x, y, z, w] } }                       on a pose table      -> a frame
--   { "distance": d }                                         on a distance table  -> a frame (between two)
--   { "pose": [...], "vel": [...], "current": [clip, frame]? } on a motion database -> [clip, frame]
--   { "a": [x, y, z, w], "b": [x, y, z, w], "fps": n }         (any table)          -> a velocity
--   { "want": [vx, vz, turn], "only": { clip: true } }         (with a motion query) steering, allowed clips
--   { "wanted": [mx, mz, lx, lz, speed, turnIn?] }             (any table)          -> [vx, vz, turn]
--   { "blend": { set, meta, move: [x, z], speed } }            (any table)          -> the blend route's top clip
--   { "enter": true, "pose": {...} | "distance": d }          on { "match": the build's tables } -> seconds
local fs = require("@lune/fs")
local process = require("@lune/process")
local serde = require("@lune/serde")

local AnimBlend = require("../../src/kit/AnimBlend")
local AnimMatch = require("../../src/kit/AnimMatch")

local tablePath, queryPath = process.args[1], process.args[2]
if not tablePath or not queryPath or not fs.isFile(tablePath) or not fs.isFile(queryPath) then
	print(serde.encode("json", { status = "fail", summary = "usage: match_run.luau <table.json> <queries.json>" }))
	process.exit(1)
end
local t = serde.decode("json", fs.readFile(tablePath))
local queries = serde.decode("json", fs.readFile(queryPath))
local answers = {}
for i, q in queries do
	if q.step ~= nil then
		-- the game's own loop step (src/kit/Anim.motion calls exactly this)
		local name, frame, jump = AnimMatch.motionStep(t, q.prev, q.pose, q.dt, q.current, q.want, q.only)
		answers[i] = { clip = name, frame = frame, jump = jump }
	elseif q.enter ~= nil then
		-- the game's own entry (src/kit/Anim.play calls this on Meta.<clip>): seconds, or -1 for "no such table"
		answers[i] = AnimMatch.enterTime(t, q.pose, q.distance) or -1
	elseif q.blend ~= nil then
		-- THE BLEND ROUTE's answer to the same ask (src/kit/AnimBlend.weights): the clip it gives the most weight
		local Vector3 = (require("@lune/roblox") :: any).Vector3
		local plays = AnimBlend.weights(
			q.blend.set,
			q.blend.meta,
			Vector3.new(q.blend.move[1], 0, q.blend.move[2]),
			q.blend.speed
		)
		local top, most = "", -1
		for name, play in plays do
			if play.weight > most then
				top, most = name, play.weight
			end
		end
		answers[i] = top
	elseif q.wanted ~= nil then
		-- where the player wants to go, in the body's own frame: [mx, mz, lx, lz, speed, turnIn?]
		answers[i] = AnimMatch.wanted(q.wanted[1], q.wanted[2], q.wanted[3], q.wanted[4], q.wanted[5], q.wanted[6])
	elseif q.a then
		answers[i] = AnimMatch.velocity(q.a, q.b, q.fps)
	elseif t.kind == "pose" then
		answers[i] = AnimMatch.poseFrame(t, q.pose)
	elseif t.kind == "distance" then
		answers[i] = AnimMatch.distanceFrame(t, q.distance)
	else
		answers[i] = AnimMatch.motionNext(t, q.pose, q.vel, q.current, q.want, q.only)
	end
end
print(serde.encode("json", { status = "pass", answers = answers }))

-- play_probe.luau — run INSIDE Roblox Studio (Studio MCP: execute_luau, datamodel_type = "Edit") by `kit anim play <Name>`:
-- builds the clip's KeyframeSequence from the kit's compiled model, plays it on a fresh humanoid of the clip's rig
-- through its Animator and STEPS it frame by frame (Animator:StepAnimations — Edit mode, no Play needed), returning
-- every joint's Transform per frame and every marker's time as one JSON string. Save that string to a file and run
-- `kit anim record <Name> <file>`: the engine's motion is compared with the clip, frame by frame.
-- Nothing is left in the place: the humanoid and the sequence are destroyed after the run.
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local KeyframeSequenceProvider = game:GetService("KeyframeSequenceProvider")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local NAME = "Slash" -- @kit:name
local RIG = "R15" -- @kit:rig
local FPS = 30 -- @kit:fps
local FRAMES = 24 -- @kit:frames
local EVENTS = { "Hit" } -- @kit:events
local MODEL_JSON = [==[{}]==] -- @kit:model

local function round(x: number): number
	return math.floor(x * 1e5 + 0.5) / 1e5
end

local function cframeOf(v: any): CFrame
	local p, o = v.position, v.orientation
	return CFrame.new(p[1], p[2], p[3], o[1][1], o[1][2], o[1][3], o[2][1], o[2][2], o[2][3], o[3][1], o[3][2], o[3][3])
end

-- the Rojo JSON model -> instances
local function build(node: any): Instance
	local inst = Instance.new(node.ClassName)
	inst.Name = node.Name or node.ClassName
	for k, v in node.Properties or {} do
		if type(v) == "table" and v.CFrame then
			(inst :: any)[k] = cframeOf(v.CFrame)
		elseif k == "Priority" then
			(inst :: any)[k] = (Enum.AnimationPriority :: any)[v]
		elseif k == "EasingStyle" then
			(inst :: any)[k] = (Enum.PoseEasingStyle :: any)[v]
		elseif k == "EasingDirection" then
			(inst :: any)[k] = (Enum.PoseEasingDirection :: any)[v]
		else
			(inst :: any)[k] = v
		end
	end
	for _, c in node.Children or {} do
		build(c).Parent = inst
	end
	return inst
end

local seq = build(HttpService:JSONDecode(MODEL_JSON))
seq.Name = NAME
local model =
	Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(Instance.new("HumanoidDescription"), (Enum.HumanoidRigType :: any)[RIG])
model.Name = "_kit_anim_play"
model.Parent = Workspace
local out: any = { name = NAME, rig = RIG, fps = FPS, frames = {}, markers = {} }
local ok, err = pcall(function()
	local humanoid = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") :: Humanoid
	local animator = humanoid:FindFirstChildOfClass("Animator") or Instance.new("Animator")
	animator.Parent = humanoid
	local animation = Instance.new("Animation")
	animation.AnimationId = KeyframeSequenceProvider:RegisterKeyframeSequence(seq)
	local track = animator:LoadAnimation(animation)
	-- a registered sequence loads asynchronously: give it a moment (StepAnimations on an unloaded track does nothing)
	local t0 = os.clock()
	while track.Length <= 0 and os.clock() - t0 < 5 do
		task.wait(0.05)
	end
	out.length = round(track.Length)
	out.loadSeconds = round(os.clock() - t0)
	if track.Length <= 0 then
		error("the animation never loaded (track.Length stayed 0 after 5 s)")
	end
	-- every joint by the part it moves (Motor6D or AnimationConstraint: both carry the animated Transform)
	local joints: { [string]: any } = {}
	for _, d in model:GetDescendants() do
		if d:IsA("Motor6D") and d.Part1 then
			joints[d.Part1.Name] = d
		elseif d:IsA("AnimationConstraint") and d.Attachment1 and d.Attachment1.Parent then
			joints[d.Attachment1.Parent.Name] = d
		end
	end
	for _, name in EVENTS do
		track:GetMarkerReachedSignal(name):Connect(function(value)
			table.insert(out.markers, { name = name, t = round(track.TimePosition), value = value })
		end)
	end
	track:Play(0, 1, 1)
	animator:StepAnimations(0)
	for i = 0, FRAMES - 1 do
		if i > 0 then
			animator:StepAnimations(1 / FPS)
		end
		local rec: any = { t = round(track.TimePosition), joints = {} }
		for part, j in joints do
			local c = { j.Transform:GetComponents() }
			local rest = true
			for k, v in c do
				c[k] = round(v)
				local ident = if k <= 3 then 0 else (if k == 4 or k == 8 or k == 12 then 1 else 0)
				if math.abs(v - ident) > 1e-5 then
					rest = false
				end
			end
			if not rest then
				rec.joints[part] = c
			end
		end
		table.insert(out.frames, rec)
	end
	track:Stop(0)
end)
model:Destroy()
seq:Destroy()
if not ok then
	out.error = tostring(err)
end
return HttpService:JSONEncode(out)

-- runs it and holds the clip to the prop's joints BEFORE the model is kept.
-- ONE NUMBER poses a hinge or a slide by itself ({"Lid": 90}: degrees about the joint's own axis, whichever way it
-- points; {"Tray": 1.2}: studs along its runner). A hinge posed so is turned key to key in DEGREES after sampling, with
-- the key's easing (the compiler's slerp takes the short way: a wheel keyed 0 then 270 would turn back 90); its clip
-- keeps the degrees as a "turn" track, and when a key-to-key turn reaches HALF a turn the model is written frame by
-- frame (the engine, too, takes the short way between two keyframes).
local fs = require("@lune/fs")
local process = require("@lune/process")
local serde = require("@lune/serde")

local Rig = require("../lib/animrig")

local rigDir, specPath, outDir = process.args[1], process.args[2], process.args[3]
local function say(status: string, summary: string, extra: { [string]: any }?)
	local v: { [string]: any } = { schema = 1, status = status, summary = summary }
	for k, x in extra or {} do
		v[k] = x
	end
	print(serde.encode("json", v))
	process.exit(if status == "pass" then 0 else 1)
end
if not rigDir or not specPath or not outDir then
	say("fail", "usage: lune run kit/anim/prop_clip.luau <rigs dir> <spec.json> <out dir>")
end
if not fs.isDir(rigDir) or not fs.isFile(specPath) then
	say("fail", `prop clip: no rigs folder at {rigDir} or no spec at {specPath}`)
end

-- the character rigs stay known (a spec that names R6 by mistake is told so by the compiler), the prop's is added
local own = Rig.RIG_DIR
Rig.loadRigs()
local known: { [string]: any } = table.clone(Rig.RIGS)
Rig.RIG_DIR = rigDir
Rig.loadRigs()
for name, rig in known do
	if Rig.RIGS[name] == nil then
		Rig.RIGS[name] = rig
	end
end
Rig.RIG_DIR = own
local Anim = require("../lib/anim") -- (Anim.RIGS is Rig.RIGS: the same table, filled above)

local okS, spec = pcall(serde.decode, "json" :: any, fs.readFile(specPath))
if not okS or type(spec) ~= "table" then
	say("fail", `prop clip: {specPath} is not valid JSON`)
end
local rig = if type(spec.rig) == "string" then Rig.RIGS[spec.rig] else nil
if not rig or rig.kind ~= "prop" then
	say("fail", `prop clip: the spec's rig "{tostring(spec.rig)}" is not a prop's rig in {rigDir}`)
end
local HALF = 179 -- degrees key to key from which the engine's own interpolation could turn the wrong way

-- a turn of `deg` degrees about a unit-able axis -> the 3x3 rotation (columns), Rodrigues
local function axisTurn(ax: { number }, deg: number): { { number } }
	local n = math.sqrt(ax[1] * ax[1] + ax[2] * ax[2] + ax[3] * ax[3])
	local x, y, z = ax[1] / n, ax[2] / n, ax[3] / n
	local c, s = math.cos(math.rad(deg)), math.sin(math.rad(deg))
	local t = 1 - c
	return {
		{ t * x * x + c, t * x * y - s * z, t * x * z + s * y },
		{ t * x * y + s * z, t * y * y + c, t * y * z - s * x },
		{ t * x * z - s * y, t * y * z + s * x, t * z * z + c },
	}
end

local limits: { [string]: any } = (rig :: any).limits or {}
local scalar: { [string]: { [number]: number } } = {} -- part -> key time -> degrees / studs
local shaped: { [string]: boolean } = {} -- parts posed by a triple or {rot, pos} in some key
for _, key in (if type(spec.keys) == "table" then spec.keys else {}) do
	if type(key) ~= "table" or type(key.pose) ~= "table" or type(key.t) ~= "number" then
		continue -- (the compiler says what is wrong with it)
	end
	for part, v in key.pose do
		if type(v) ~= "number" then
			shaped[part] = true
			continue
		end
		local lim = limits[part]
		if type(lim) ~= "table" or (lim.kind ~= "hinge" and lim.kind ~= "slide") then
			say(
				"fail",
				`prop clip {tostring(spec.name)}: {part} is posed by one number - only a hinge (degrees) or a slide (studs) is`
			)
		end
		if v ~= v or math.abs(v) == math.huge then
			say("fail", `prop clip {tostring(spec.name)}: {part} is posed by a number that is not one`)
		end
		scalar[part] = scalar[part] or {}
		scalar[part][key.t] = v
		local ax = lim.axis
		if lim.kind == "hinge" then
			key.pose[part] = Rig.eulerOf(axisTurn(ax, v))
		else
			key.pose[part] = { rot = { 0, 0, 0 }, pos = { ax[1] * v, ax[2] * v, ax[3] * v } }
		end
	end
end
for part in scalar do
	if shaped[part] then
		say(
			"fail",
			`prop clip {tostring(spec.name)}: {part} is posed by one number in one key and by a turn in another - one way in every key`
		)
	end
end

local function issuesOf(list: { any }): ({ string }, boolean)
	local out, bad = {}, false
	for _, i in list do
		table.insert(out, `[{i.severity}] {i.path}: {i.message}`)
		if i.severity == "error" then
			bad = true
		end
	end
	return out, bad
end
local clip, issues = Anim.clipFromSpec(spec, { source = { kind = "spec", file = specPath } })
local said, bad = issuesOf(issues)
if not clip or bad then
	say(
		"fail",
		`prop clip {tostring(spec.name)}: the spec does not compile - {said[1] or "no clip"}`,
		{ issues = said }
	)
end
local dense = Anim.sample(clip :: any)
-- a hinge posed by numbers: its frames turned in degrees, key to key with the key's easing (as the compiler eases)
local frameByFrame = false
for part, byTime in scalar do
	local lim = limits[part]
	local j = dense.joints[part]
	if lim.kind ~= "hinge" or not j or not j.keys or not j.frames then
		continue
	end
	local keys = j.keys :: { any }
	local values, prev = {}, 0 -- (every spec key time: a hold of the last value, rest before the first)
	for k, key in keys do
		local v = byTime[key.t]
		if v == nil then
			v = prev
		end
		values[k] = v
		prev = v
		if k > 1 and math.abs(v - values[k - 1]) >= HALF then
			frameByFrame = true
		end
	end
	local ax = lim.axis
	local n = math.sqrt(ax[1] * ax[1] + ax[2] * ax[2] + ax[3] * ax[3])
	local turn = {}
	for i, t in dense.times do
		local v = values[#keys]
		if t <= keys[1].t then
			v = values[1]
		else
			for k = 1, #keys - 1 do
				local a, b = keys[k], keys[k + 1]
				if t >= a.t and t < b.t then
					v = values[k] + (values[k + 1] - values[k]) * Anim.ease(a.ease, a.dir, (t - a.t) / (b.t - a.t))
					break
				end
			end
		end
		turn[i] = v
		local h = math.rad(v) / 2
		local sh = math.sin(h)
		local f = j.frames[i]
		j.frames[i] = { ax[1] / n * sh, ax[2] / n * sh, ax[3] / n * sh, math.cos(h), f[5], f[6], f[7] }
	end
	(j :: any).turn = turn
end
if frameByFrame then
	for _, j in dense.joints do
		j.keys = nil -- (modelFromClip then writes the dense frames: one keyframe a frame)
	end
end
local model, _, more = Anim.modelFromClip(dense, spec.rig)
local said2, bad2 = issuesOf(more)
if not model or bad2 then
	say("fail", `prop clip {spec.name}: no animation model - {said2[1] or "no model"}`, { issues = said2 })
end
if not fs.isDir(outDir) then
	fs.writeDir(outDir)
end
local clipOut, modelOut = `{outDir}/{spec.name}.clip.json`, `{outDir}/{spec.name}.model.json`
fs.writeFile(clipOut, serde.encode("json", dense))
fs.writeFile(modelOut, serde.encode("json", model))
say("pass", `prop clip {spec.name}: compiled on {spec.rig}`, { clip = clipOut, model = modelOut, issues = said })

-- rig_probe.luau — run INSIDE Roblox Studio (Studio MCP: execute_luau, datamodel_type = "Edit") to read rigs the way
-- the engine builds them: every joint (Motor6D C0/C1, or an AnimationConstraint's rig attachments), every part's
-- class, size and rest offset from the root. It returns ONE JSON string: save it to a file (for example
-- _artifacts/anim/rig_probe.json) and run `lune run kit anim rig --from <that file>`.
-- Nothing is left in the place: the humanoids it makes are destroyed after reading.
-- A custom rig (a creature, a weapon with joints): set TARGET to the model's path, e.g. "ReplicatedStorage.Rigs.Wolf";
-- that model is read in place (and not touched).
local HttpService = game:GetService("HttpService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")

local TARGET: string? = nil -- @kit:target

local function round(x: number): number
	return math.floor(x * 1e5 + 0.5) / 1e5
end

local function cf(c: CFrame): { number }
	local t = { c:GetComponents() }
	for i, v in t do
		t[i] = round(v)
	end
	return t
end

local function readModel(model: Model, rigName: string)
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart
	if not root or not root:IsA("BasePart") then
		error(`{model:GetFullName()} has no HumanoidRootPart / PrimaryPart`)
	end
	local out = { rig = rigName, root = root.Name, parts = {}, motors = {}, constraints = {}, attachments = {} }
	for _, p in model:GetDescendants() do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then
			out.parts[p.Name] = {
				class = p.ClassName,
				size = { round(p.Size.X), round(p.Size.Y), round(p.Size.Z) },
				offset = cf(root.CFrame:ToObjectSpace(p.CFrame)),
			}
		elseif p:IsA("Motor6D") then
			table.insert(out.motors, {
				name = p.Name,
				parent = p.Parent and p.Parent.Name,
				part0 = p.Part0 and p.Part0.Name,
				part1 = p.Part1 and p.Part1.Name,
				c0 = cf(p.C0),
				c1 = cf(p.C1),
			})
		elseif p:IsA("AnimationConstraint") then
			local a0, a1 = p.Attachment0, p.Attachment1
			table.insert(out.constraints, {
				name = p.Name,
				parent = p.Parent and p.Parent.Name,
				a0 = a0 and a0.Parent and { part = a0.Parent.Name, name = a0.Name, cframe = cf(a0.CFrame) },
				a1 = a1 and a1.Parent and { part = a1.Parent.Name, name = a1.Name, cframe = cf(a1.CFrame) },
			})
		elseif
			p:IsA("Attachment")
			and p.Parent
			and p.Parent:IsA("BasePart")
			and string.find(p.Name, "RigAttachment")
		then
			table.insert(out.attachments, { part = p.Parent.Name, name = p.Name, cframe = cf(p.CFrame) })
		end
	end
	local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	out.hipHeight = if hum then round(hum.HipHeight) else nil
	return out
end

local function readHumanoid(rigType: Enum.HumanoidRigType)
	local model = Players:CreateHumanoidModelFromDescription(Instance.new("HumanoidDescription"), rigType)
	model.Name = "_kit_rig_probe"
	model.Parent = Workspace
	local ok, out = pcall(readModel, model, rigType.Name)
	model:Destroy()
	if not ok then
		error(out)
	end
	return out
end

local result = { probe = "kit anim rig --probe", date = os.date("!%Y-%m-%d") }
if TARGET then
	local node: Instance = game
	for _, name in string.split(TARGET, ".") do
		node = node:FindFirstChild(name) or error(`no {TARGET} ({name} not found)`)
	end
	assert(node:IsA("Model"), `{TARGET} is not a Model`)
	result.custom = readModel(node, node.Name)
else
	local ok15, r15 = pcall(readHumanoid, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R15)
	local ok6, r6 = pcall(readHumanoid, Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6)
	result.r15 = if ok15 then r15 else { error = tostring(r15) }
	result.r6 = if ok6 then r6 else { error = tostring(r6) }
end
return HttpService:JSONEncode(result)
