--!strict
-- alike.luau — `kit alike`: search by LOOK (2026-11-08, sprint 4: proposal 8 of
-- board/plans/archive/2026-11-08-pipeline-rag-learning-research.md; kit/vision/alike.py). Every picture of our past pieces and
-- every reference, embedded once with the pinned SigLIP 2 in a local index (build/look/, git-ignored):
--   kit alike index [--lane L]                       embed what is new (by content); a second run embeds nothing
--   kit alike <picture | piece> [--lane L] [--k N]   the past pieces that LOOK closest, each with the owner's verdict
--   kit alike dupes [--lane L] [--min 0.985]         the same reference filed more than once
-- ("kit look" is the 3D lane's close-up command: kit/cmd/look.luau.)
local Alike = require("../lib/alike")
local Cli = require("../lib/cli")
local Run = require("../lib/run")

local Command = {}

function Command.register(Cli_: typeof(Cli))
	Cli_.command(
		"work",
		"alike",
		"alike index [--lane L] | alike <picture | piece> [--lane L] [--k N] [--refs] | alike dupes [--lane L] [--min 0.985]",
		"search by look: the past pieces that LOOK closest to a picture or a piece, each with the owner's verdict on it (SigLIP 2, local index build/look/), and the same reference filed twice",
		function(rawArgs)
			local args, flags = Cli.parse(rawArgs)
			local sub = args[1]
			if not sub then
				return Run.report(
					"alike",
					{},
					Run.CODES.USAGE,
					"alike: index | <picture | piece> | dupes",
					"lune run kit alike index, then: lune run kit alike <picture | piece>"
				)
			end
			local step = Run.content(`alike {sub}`, Run.tool("python"), Alike.argv(args, flags))
			local r = step.result or {}
			for _, line in (if type(r.lines) == "table" then r.lines else {}) :: { any } do
				print("  " .. tostring(line))
			end
			local code = if step.ok
				then Run.CODES.PASS
				elseif step.result then Run.CODES.CONTENT
				else Run.CODES.TOOLCHAIN
			return Run.report(
				"alike",
				{ step },
				code,
				tostring(r.summary or `alike {sub}: the vision tool gave no verdict`),
				tostring(r.next_action or "lune run kit vision doctor")
			)
		end
	)
	-- the taste model per lane (kit/vision/taste.py; 2026-11-08, sprint 5): the owner's own scores, leave-one-out
	Cli_.command(
		"work",
		"taste",
		"taste train <lane> | taste order <lane> <Move/rK | picture | piece ...> | taste off|on <lane>",
		"a taste model per lane from the owner's OWN scores (never a guess): tested leave-one-out, on only with 20+ scored pieces ordering pairs the owner's way 60%+; it only orders candidates, the owner can switch it off",
		function(rawArgs)
			local args = Cli.parse(rawArgs)
			local sub, lane = args[1], args[2]
			if not sub or not lane then
				return Run.report(
					"taste",
					{},
					Run.CODES.USAGE,
					"taste: train <lane> | order <lane> <Move/rK ...> | off|on <lane>",
					"lune run kit taste train anim"
				)
			end
			local step = Run.content(
				`taste {sub} {lane}`,
				Run.tool("python"),
				{ "kit/vision/run.py", "taste", table.unpack(args) }
			)
			local r = step.result or {}
			for _, line in (if type(r.lines) == "table" then r.lines else {}) :: { any } do
				print("  " .. tostring(line))
			end
			local code = if step.ok
				then Run.CODES.PASS
				elseif step.result then Run.CODES.CONTENT
				else Run.CODES.TOOLCHAIN
			return Run.report(
				"taste",
				{ step },
				code,
				tostring(r.summary or `taste {sub}: the vision tool gave no verdict`),
				tostring(r.next_action or "lune run kit vision doctor")
			)
		end
	)
end

return Command

-- approve.luau — `kit approve <lane> <name> "<the owner's words>" --by owner [--waive <step,...>]`: the ONE place the
-- owner's go-ahead for a new piece is written (board/locks.json). Every lane's build command refuses a new piece whose
-- quality step (scene chart, real references, brief, evidence, verdict) has no owner record; a model may PROPOSE
-- (no --by owner: recorded as model-proposed, which no lock accepts), never approve its own work.
-- `--stage <step>` (3d: sheet, blockout; vfx: style, animatic) records his yes to ONE stage's artefact - the model
-- sheet, the blockout, an effect's style sheet, a scene set's timing animatic (the name is then the SET's) - with
-- the artefact's id as he saw it and, where it names them, the pictures (and the video) he
-- saw ("drawn"): the lock asks again when either changed (LaneLocks.holds). An artefact that does not exist, is out
-- of date or still has a problem cannot be approved: there is nothing true to show him yet.
-- `--expect <step:id:drawn>`: record only if the artefact is STILL the one named (kit review's page sends what it
-- showed; between its look and this command the artefact may have been drawn again).
-- `--locks <file>` with `--models <dir>` / `--effects <dir>`: a FIXTURE project's piece, recorded in that project's
-- own locks file (the kit's tests) - never the project's own record under another spelling (Locks.useFixture).
local Config = require("../lib/config")
local Locks = require("../lib/locks")
local Run = require("../lib/run")

local C = Run.CODES

local LANES = { "3d", "vfx", "ui", "anim", "world", "sfx" }

-- the steps a waiver may name, per lane ("verdict" = the open-pieces cap in kit new)
local STEPS: { [string]: { string } } = {
	vfx = { "chart", "frames", "verdict", "methods", "style", "animatic" }, -- (methods: the method gate, kit/vfx/methods.py; style / animatic: the stage locks)
	ui = { "refs", "verdict" },
	sfx = { "refs", "verdict" },
	-- methods: the methods lock (a new piece's plan names each coded part's builder call; kit/blender/rbx_plan.py)
	["3d"] = { "brief", "study", "verdict", "sheet", "blockout", "methods" },
	world = { "refs", "verdict", "layout", "streaming" },
	anim = { "evidence", "verdict" },
}

-- the stages whose artefact the owner approves one by one (`--stage`), per lane
local STAGES: { [string]: { string } } = {
	["3d"] = { "sheet", "blockout" },
	-- style: every beat's look, ours beside the scene's (kit vfx stylesheet <effect>; the VFX studio-route plan, V1)
	-- animatic: a scene SET's motion in flat shapes at the chart's timing (kit vfx animatic <set>; V2) - the name
	-- given with it is the set's
	vfx = { "style", "animatic" },
	-- blocking: a move's key poses held large (kit anim block <Move> --sheet); design: an attack set's page (kit anim
	-- design <Set>) - recorded where the lane's own --approve writes them (AnimCmd.stageApprove; card rpdz)
	anim = { "blocking", "design" },
	-- greybox: the world with no mesh, walked with him (kit world greybox <Name>; V3 W1); corner: one 40 x 40 corner at
	-- full size, his 7 or more (kit world corner <Name> --at <station>; V3 W2)
	world = { "greybox", "corner" },
}

-- the command that makes a stage's artefact, to name in a refusal
local function makes(lane: string, step: string, name: string): string
	return if lane == "vfx" and step == "animatic"
		then `lune run kit vfx animatic {name}`
		elseif lane == "vfx" then `lune run kit vfx stylesheet {name}`
		elseif lane == "anim" and step == "blocking" then `lune run kit anim block {name} --sheet`
		elseif lane == "anim" then `lune run kit anim design {name}`
		elseif lane == "world" and step == "corner" then `lune run kit world corner {name} --at <station>`
		elseif lane == "world" then `lune run kit world greybox {name}`
		else `lune run kit {step} {name}`
end

local function today(): string
	return os.date("%Y-%m-%d") :: string
end

local function list(lane: string?): number
	local data = Locks.load()
	local n = 0
	for _, key in { "approvals", "waivers", "proposals" } do
		local records = data[key]
		if type(records) == "table" then
			for l, byLane in records do
				if (not lane or l == lane) and type(byLane) == "table" then
					for name, rec in byLane do
						n += 1
						local state = if Locks.isOwner(rec) then "owner" else "PENDING (not the owner's)"
						local steps = if type(rec.steps) == "table" then ` steps={table.concat(rec.steps, ",")}` else ""
						print(`  {key}  {l}/{name}  [{state}]{steps}  "{rec.words or ""}"  {rec.date or ""}`)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	-- the stage approvals (--stage): one record per piece and stage, with the artefact's id he saw
	local stages = data.stages
	if type(stages) == "table" then
		for l, byLane in stages do
			if (not lane or l == lane) and type(byLane) == "table" then
				for name, steps in byLane do
					if type(steps) == "table" then
						for step, rec in steps do
							n += 1
							local state = if Locks.isOwner(rec) then "owner" else "PENDING (not the owner's)"
							print(
								`  stages  {l}/{name}  [{state}] stage={step} id={tostring(rec.id)}  "{rec.words or ""}"  {rec.date or ""}`
							)
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
	return n
end

return function(Cli: any)
	Cli.command(
		"work",
		"approve",
		'approve <lane> <name> "<the owner\'s words>" --by owner [--waive <step,...> | --stage <sheet|blockout|style|animatic|blocking|design> [--id <id>] [--expect <step:id:drawn>]] | approve list [<lane>]',
		"record the OWNER's go-ahead (or a waiver of one step) for a new piece; --stage: his yes to ONE stage's artefact as it is now (3d: the model sheet, the blockout; vfx: an effect's style sheet, a scene set's timing animatic - asked again when it changes or is made again); --expect: only if it is still the one that was looked at; the lane locks accept nothing else",
		function(rawArgs)
			local args, flags = Cli.parse(rawArgs)
			if args[1] == "list" then
				local n = list(args[2])
				return Run.report(
					"approve",
					{},
					C.PASS,
					`approve: {n} record(s){if args[2] then " in " .. args[2] else ""}`,
					'record one only when the owner said it: lune run kit approve <lane> <name> "<their words>" --by owner'
				)
			end
			local lane, name, words = args[1], args[2], args[3]
			if not lane or not table.find(LANES, lane) or not name or not words or words == "" then
				return Run.report(
					"approve",
					{},
					C.USAGE,
					`approve: name the lane ({table.concat(LANES, "|")}), the piece and the owner's own words`,
					'lune run kit approve vfx FlameArcSlash "approved, go" --by owner'
				)
			end
			local by = if flags.by == "owner" then "owner" else "model-proposed"
			local rec: any = { by = by, words = words, date = today() }
			-- how the record was made, when not typed: kit review's page says "review-page" (a click, not a session)
			if type(flags.via) == "string" then
				rec.via = flags.via
			end
			-- --locks <file>: a FIXTURE project's own record (the kit's tests, kit review on a fixture). Whatever this
			-- command records then lands there, never in the project's board/locks.json
			if type(flags.locks) == "string" then
				local why = Locks.useFixture(flags.locks)
				if why then
					return Run.report(
						"approve",
						{},
						C.USAGE,
						`approve: {why}`,
						`lune run kit approve {lane} {name} "<their words>" --by owner`
					)
				end
			end
			local key = "approvals"
			if flags.stage ~= nil then
				-- ONE stage's artefact (3d: the model sheet, the blockout), approved as it is now
				local steps = STAGES[lane]
				local step = flags.stage
				if type(step) ~= "string" or not steps or not table.find(steps, step) or flags.waive ~= nil then
					return Run.report(
						"approve",
						{},
						C.USAGE,
						if steps
							then `approve: --stage names one of {lane}'s stages ({table.concat(steps, ", ")}), without --waive`
							else `approve: the {lane} lane has no stage approvals (3d: sheet, blockout; vfx: style, animatic; anim: blocking, design)`,
						`lune run kit approve {if steps then lane else "3d"} {name} "<their words>" --by owner --stage {if steps
							then steps[1]
							else "sheet"}`
					)
				end
				if lane == "anim" then
					-- the animation lane keeps these records itself (its blocking and design files, which its locks read): his
					-- yes goes there, held to the id of the sheet or page he saw (--id), never a proposal
					if by ~= "owner" or type(flags.id) ~= "string" or flags.id == "" then
						return Run.report(
							"approve",
							{},
							C.USAGE,
							`approve: an animation {step} is approved only by the owner, for the id on what he saw: --by owner --id <id>`,
							`{makes(lane, step :: string, name)}, show it, then: lune run kit approve anim {name} "<their words>" --by owner --stage {step} --id <id>`
						)
					end
					local AnimCmd = require("./anim")
					local s = AnimCmd.stageApprove(step :: string, name, words, by, flags.id :: string)
					local said = if s.result and type(s.result.summary) == "string" then s.result.summary else s.tail
					return Run.report(
						"approve",
						{ s },
						if s.ok then C.PASS else C.CONTENT,
						if s.ok
							then `approve: anim/{name} {step} {flags.id} recorded as the owner's ("{words}")`
							else `approve: anim/{name} {step}: nothing recorded - {said}`,
						if s.ok
							then `commit its record with the move; it holds while the {step} stays as he saw it`
							else `{makes(lane, step :: string, name)}, look at it, show the owner, then record their words`
					)
				end
				-- (--models <folder> / --effects <folder>: a FIXTURE project's piece, as kit review --models --locks
				-- shows it, recorded in that project's own locks file (--locks <file>, above). Refused while the
				-- record is the project's own: another folder's sheet id written there would read as "changed")
				local models = if type(flags.models) == "string" then flags.models else nil
				if models and not Locks.fixture then
					return Run.report(
						"approve",
						{},
						C.USAGE,
						"approve: --models is for a fixture project's piece with a locks file of its own (--models <dir> --locks <file>)",
						`lune run kit approve {lane} {name} "<their words>" --by owner --stage {step}`
					)
				end
				local LaneLocks = require("../lib/lanelocks")
				-- an effect is the ACTIVE project's (the folder kit vfx stylesheet draws from): another folder's
				-- preset must never be recorded under this project's name
				local effects = Config.path("vfx")
				if lane == "vfx" and type(flags.effects) == "string" and not Locks.fixture then
					if string.lower(Locks.normal(flags.effects)) ~= string.lower(Locks.normal(effects)) then
						return Run.report(
							"approve",
							{},
							C.USAGE,
							`approve: --effects {flags.effects} is not this project's effects folder ({effects}); another game's piece: --game <Name>`,
							`lune run kit approve vfx {name} "<their words>" --by owner --stage {step}`
						)
					end
				elseif lane == "vfx" and type(flags.effects) == "string" then
					effects = flags.effects
				end
				local art = if lane == "vfx"
					then LaneLocks.vfxStageState(name, step :: string, effects)
					elseif lane == "world" then LaneLocks.worldStageState(name, step :: string)
					else LaneLocks.stageState(name, step :: string, models)
				if not art.ok then
					return Run.report(
						"approve",
						{},
						C.CONTENT,
						`approve: {lane}/{name} has no {step} he can approve - {art.why}`,
						`{makes(lane, step :: string, name)}, LOOK at it, show the owner, then record their words`
					)
				end
				-- a yes is for what was LOOKED AT: a caller that knows what that was says so (--expect: kit review's
				-- page sends what it showed), and an artefact that changed between the look and this command is refused
				local now = `{step}:{tostring(art.id or "")}:{tostring((art :: any).drawn or "")}`
				if type(flags.expect) == "string" and flags.expect ~= now then
					return Run.report(
						"approve",
						{},
						C.CONTENT,
						`approve: {lane}/{name}'s {step} is not the one that was looked at (it changed since): nothing recorded`,
						`look at it again as it is now, then approve`
					)
				end
				rec.id = art.id
				rec.stage = step
				if (art :: any).drawn ~= nil then
					rec.drawn = (art :: any).drawn -- (the pictures he saw: the same id drawn again is asked again)
				end
				Locks.reset() -- (the file as it is NOW: a record another session wrote meanwhile is kept)
				local data = Locks.load()
				local into = if by == "owner" then "stages" else "proposals"
				data[into] = if type(data[into]) == "table" then data[into] else {}
				data[into][lane] = if type(data[into][lane]) == "table" then data[into][lane] else {}
				if by == "owner" then
					local byName = data.stages[lane][name]
					data.stages[lane][name] = if type(byName) == "table" then byName else {}
					data.stages[lane][name][step] = rec
				else -- (a proposal lives in its own table: it never reads as the owner's record)
					rec.kind = "stages"
					data.proposals[lane][`{name}@{step}`] = rec
				end
				Locks.save(data)
				if by ~= "owner" then
					return Run.report(
						"approve",
						{},
						C.PASS,
						`approve: {lane}/{name} {step} PROPOSED (model-proposed: no lock accepts it)`,
						`show {art.png or step} to the owner; when they approve, record their words: lune run kit approve {lane} {name} "<their words>" --by owner --stage {step}`
					)
				end
				return Run.report(
					"approve",
					{},
					C.PASS,
					`approve: {lane}/{name} {step} {tostring(art.id)} recorded as the owner's ("{words}")`,
					`commit board/locks.json with the piece; it holds while the {step} stays as he saw it`
				)
			end
			if flags.waive ~= nil then
				if type(flags.waive) ~= "string" then
					return Run.report(
						"approve",
						{},
						C.USAGE,
						`approve: --waive needs the step(s) ({table.concat(STEPS[lane], ",")})`,
						`lune run kit approve {lane} {name} "<their words>" --by owner --waive {STEPS[lane][1]}`
					)
				end
				local steps = string.split(flags.waive :: string, ",")
				for _, step in steps do
					if not table.find(STEPS[lane], step) then
						return Run.report(
							"approve",
							{},
							C.USAGE,
							`approve: "{step}" is not a {lane} step ({table.concat(STEPS[lane], ", ")})`,
							`lune run kit approve {lane} {name} "<their words>" --by owner --waive {STEPS[lane][1]}`
						)
					end
				end
				rec.steps = steps
				key = "waivers"
			end
			local what = if key == "waivers" then `waiver of {table.concat(rec.steps, ",")}` else "approval"
			-- a proposal lives in its own table: it never replaces (or reads as) the owner's record
			if by ~= "owner" then
				rec.kind = key
				key = "proposals"
			end
			local data = Locks.load()
			data[key] = if type(data[key]) == "table" then data[key] else {}
			data[key][lane] = if type(data[key][lane]) == "table" then data[key][lane] else {}
			local old = data[key][lane][name]
			-- a second owner waiver adds its steps to the first (--waive verdict keeps an earlier refs waiver)
			if key == "waivers" and Locks.isOwner(old) and type(old.steps) == "table" then
				for _, step in old.steps do
					if not table.find(rec.steps, step) then
						table.insert(rec.steps, step)
					end
				end
				table.sort(rec.steps)
			end
			data[key][lane][name] = rec
			Locks.save(data)
			if by ~= "owner" then
				return Run.report(
					"approve",
					{},
					C.PASS,
					`approve: {lane}/{name} {what} PROPOSED (model-proposed: no lock accepts it)`,
					`show it to the owner; when they approve, record their words: lune run kit approve {lane} {name} "<their words>" --by owner`
				)
			end
			return Run.report(
				"approve",
				{},
				C.PASS,
				`approve: {lane}/{name} {what} recorded as the owner's ("{words}")`,
				`commit board/locks.json with the piece, then run its build command`
			)
		end
	)
end

-- board.luau — `kit board`: the project's own Trello, local (the owner, 2026-10-28: "we're not going to use Trello.
-- We're going to make our own ... even better"). A page on 127.0.0.1 over the SAME markdown task files the CLI and every
-- model write (kit/lib/boardweb.luau): every board (the project and each game), columns by status, drag a card to move
-- it, tick its done-when items, add notes and cards; each card shows its claim (stale ones flagged), what it waits on
-- and the pipeline pieces it names with their preview and the owner's last verdict. A model's change to a task file
-- shows up within seconds. Nothing leaves the machine: it listens on 127.0.0.1 only, writes need the page's own token.
--   kit board [--port 8790] [--no-open]      serve it (Ctrl+C stops); opens the active game's board in the browser
--   kit board stop                           end the background one kit start / kit game use started
-- kit start and kit game use start it hidden when nothing answers on 8790 (off: KIT_NO_BOARD=1 or "board_auto": false)
local fs = require("@lune/fs")
local net = require("@lune/net")
local process = require("@lune/process")
local serde = require("@lune/serde")
local task = require("@lune/task")

local BoardWeb = require("../lib/boardweb")
local Config = require("../lib/config")
local LocalPage = require("../lib/localpage")
local Run = require("../lib/run")

local PAGE = "kit/board/index.html"
local PREVIEW = "^[%w_/%-]*build/renders/[%w_%-%.]+%.png$" -- the only files the page may fetch

-- the page's write token: from the OS's CSPRNG (python's secrets); the hash fallback only when python is missing
local function token(): string
	local ok, r = pcall(process.exec, Run.tool("python"), { "-c", "import secrets; print(secrets.token_hex(24))" })
	if ok and r.ok and string.match(r.stdout, "^%x+%s*$") then
		return (string.gsub(r.stdout, "%s+", ""))
	end
	local seed = `{os.time()}|{os.clock()}|{tostring({})}|{math.random()}`
	local out = {}
	for round = 1, 4 do
		local h = 2166136261 + round
		for i = 1, #seed do
			h = bit32.bxor(h, string.byte(seed, i))
			h = (h * 16777619) % 4294967296
		end
		table.insert(out, string.format("%08x", h))
		seed ..= out[#out]
	end
	return table.concat(out)
end

local function json(status: number, data: any): any
	return {
		status = status,
		headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "application/json; charset=utf-8", ["Cache-Control"] = "no-store" },
		body = serde.encode("json", data),
	}
end

-- the page's board summaries: name + how many cards in each column
local function summaries(): { any }
	local out = {}
	for _, b in BoardWeb.boards() do
		local counts = {}
		for _, t in BoardWeb.tasks(b) do
			counts[t.status] = (counts[t.status] or 0) + 1
		end
		table.insert(out, { key = b.key, name = b.name, counts = counts })
	end
	return out
end

-- every board's cards together (the "all games" view): each card tagged with its board
local function readAll(): any
	local cards, stamps = {}, {}
	for _, b in BoardWeb.boards() do
		local r = BoardWeb.read(b)
		for _, c in r.tasks do
			c.board = b.key
			c.boardName = b.name
			table.insert(cards, c)
		end
		table.insert(stamps, r.stamp)
	end
	return { key = "all", name = "All boards", stamp = table.concat(stamps, ","), tasks = cards }
end

local function stampOf(key: string): string?
	if key == "all" then
		local s = {}
		for _, b in BoardWeb.boards() do
			table.insert(s, BoardWeb.stamp(b))
		end
		return table.concat(s, ",")
	end
	local b = BoardWeb.board(key)
	return if b then BoardWeb.stamp(b) else nil
end

local function handler(secret: string, port: number)
	-- DNS rebinding: only a page loaded from this machine by its own name and port talks to the board (an exact
	-- match: a prefix test would let 127.0.0.1.evil.example through). The bare names too: lune's own client (kit start
	-- asking whether the board is up) sends no port, and a browser always sends the name + port it loaded
	local hosts = {
		[`127.0.0.1:{port}`] = true,
		[`localhost:{port}`] = true,
		["127.0.0.1"] = true,
		["localhost"] = true,
	}
	local origins = { [`http://127.0.0.1:{port}`] = true, [`http://localhost:{port}`] = true }
	return function(req: any): any
		local host = string.lower(tostring(req.headers.host or ""))
		if not hosts[host] then
			return json(403, { error = "forbidden host" })
		end
		local q = req.query or {}
		if req.method == "GET" and (req.path == "/" or req.path == "/index.html") then
			if not fs.isFile(PAGE) then
				return { status = 500, body = `{PAGE} is missing (kit install / kit sync restores it)` }
			end
			-- the page carries its write token: never shown inside another page's frame (clickjacking), the same
			-- headers as kit review's page (LocalPage; the V3 list's kit hygiene: "add LocalPage.pageHeaders in kit board")
			if LocalPage.framed(req.headers) then
				return { status = 403, body = "the board is not shown inside another page" }
			end
			local html = string.gsub(fs.readFile(PAGE), "__BOARD_TOKEN__", secret)
			return { status = 200, headers = LocalPage.pageHeaders(), body = html }
		elseif req.method == "GET" and req.path == "/api/boards" then
			local active = Config.game()
			return json(200, { boards = summaries(), active = if active then active else "root" })
		elseif req.method == "GET" and req.path == "/api/board" then
			if q.key == "all" then
				return json(200, readAll())
			end
			local b = BoardWeb.board(q.key)
			if not b then
				return json(404, { error = "no such board" })
			end
			return json(200, BoardWeb.read(b))
		elseif req.method == "GET" and req.path == "/api/stamp" then
			local s = stampOf(tostring(q.key or ""))
			return if s then json(200, { stamp = s }) else json(404, { error = "no such board" })
		elseif req.method == "GET" and req.path == "/file" then
			local p = tostring(q.p or "")
			if not string.match(p, PREVIEW) or string.find(p, "..", 1, true) or not fs.isFile(p) then
				return { status = 404, body = "not found" }
			end
			return {
				status = 200,
				headers = { ["Content-Type"] = "image/png", ["Cache-Control"] = "no-store" },
				body = fs.readFile(p),
			}
		elseif req.method == "POST" and req.path == "/api/act" then
			-- a custom header no other site can send without a CORS preflight this server never grants
			if req.headers["x-board-token"] ~= secret then
				return json(403, { error = "missing or wrong board token (reload the page)" })
			end
			-- and from this page only: a browser always names the page that sent a write
			local origin, site = req.headers.origin, req.headers["sec-fetch-site"]
			if
				(origin and not origins[string.lower(origin)]) or (site and site ~= "same-origin" and site ~= "none")
			then
				return json(403, { error = "writes come from the board page only" })
			end
			local b = BoardWeb.board(q.key)
			if not b then
				return json(404, { error = "no such board" })
			end
			local ok, body = pcall(serde.decode, "json" :: any, req.body or "")
			if not ok then
				return json(400, { error = "the body is not JSON" })
			end
			local done, message, id = BoardWeb.act(b, body)
			if done then
				print(`board: {b.name} {message}`)
			end
			return json(if done then 200 else 400, { ok = done, message = message, id = id })
		end
		return json(404, { error = "not found" })
	end
end

return function(Cli: any)
	Cli.command(
		"work",
		"board",
		"board [--port 8790] [--no-open] | board stop",
		"the project's own Trello, local: every board (the project + each game) as columns by status over the same task files the CLI writes; drag cards, tick done-when items, add notes and cards; each card shows its claim (stale flagged), what it waits on and the pipeline pieces it names with preview + the owner's last verdict",
		function(rawArgs)
			local args, flags = Cli.parse(rawArgs)
			if args[1] == "stop" then
				local ok, msg = BoardWeb.stop()
				return Run.report(
					"board",
					{},
					if ok then Run.CODES.PASS else Run.CODES.USAGE,
					`board: {msg}`,
					if ok then "none" else "lune run kit board (to serve one)"
				)
			end
			local port = tonumber(flags.port) or BoardWeb.PORT
			if #BoardWeb.boards() == 0 then
				return Run.report(
					"board",
					{},
					Run.CODES.USAGE,
					"board: no board here (no board/tasks/, no games/<Name>/board/)",
					'lune run kit task add "the first task"'
				)
			end
			local secret = token()
			local ok, err =
				pcall(net.serve, port, { address = "http://127.0.0.1", handleRequest = handler(secret, port) })
			if not ok then
				return Run.report(
					"board",
					{},
					Run.CODES.USAGE,
					`board: could not listen on 127.0.0.1:{port} ({err})`,
					"lune run kit board --port <another port>"
				)
			end
			local active = Config.game()
			local url = `http://127.0.0.1:{port}/` .. (if active then `?board={active}` else "")
			print(`board: {url}   ({#BoardWeb.boards()} board(s); Ctrl+C stops it)`)
			print(`summary: board serving at {url}`)
			print("next_action: open it in the browser; leave this running while you work")
			if not flags["no-open"] then
				if process.os == "windows" then
					pcall(process.exec, "cmd", { "/c", "start", "", url })
				elseif process.os == "macos" then
					pcall(process.exec, "open", { url })
				else
					pcall(process.exec, "xdg-open", { url })
				end
			end
			while true do
				task.wait(3600)
			end
		end
	)
end

--!strict
-- contract.luau — `kit contract ...`: the CROSS-LANE CONTRACT of a hero weapon (LIMITATIONS_FIXES_V4 §10 item 1 /
-- §13.8 item 1): assets/contracts/<hero>.json binds the built model (its files' SHA-256, sockets, length at 1 stud =
-- 0.28 m), the move set's authored Hit / Cancel / Hitstop frames, the VFX it plays, the sound events swing / hit /
-- parry, the UI trigger and the PROMPT-X packet. Every value is READ from its lane's own files, never typed; any
-- hash change, moved frame, lost socket or sound with no recipe fails `check` by name ("any hash change invalidates
-- downstream builds cleanly"). The rules are kit/lib/contract.luau (pure, kit/test/spec/contract.spec.luau).
--
--   kit contract new <hero> --model <asset | path.manifest.json> --moves <set | path.json> [--from <Game>]
--                    [--vfx <preset | sequence>] [--ui <screen>] [--packet <sha | path>] [--dir <folder>] [--force]
--       --from <Game>: the move set, its clips, effects and sounds live in games/<Game>/ (never Sample Game)
--   kit contract check [<hero>] [--dir <folder>]    re-reads every source; fails by name on any drift
--   kit contract list [--dir <folder>]
-- (default folder: assets/contracts of the active project; kit/selftest/contract/{good,bad} are the self-test's)
local fs = require("@lune/fs")
local serde = require("@lune/serde")

local Cli = require("../lib/cli")
local Config = require("../lib/config")
local Contract = require("../lib/contract")
local Run = require("../lib/run")

local ContractCmd = {}

local TEXT = { json = true, luau = true, lua = true, md = true, py = true, txt = true }

local function sha256(path: string): string
	if not fs.isFile(path) then
		return Contract.MISSING
	end
	local bytes = fs.readFile(path)
	local ext = string.match(path, "%.([%w]+)$")
	if ext and TEXT[string.lower(ext)] then
		-- a checkout with core.autocrlf writes CRLF: the same file hashes the same everywhere
		bytes = (string.gsub(bytes, "\r\n", "\n"))
	end
	return serde.hash("sha256", bytes)
end

local function hashString(s: string): string
	return serde.hash("sha256", s)
end

local function readJson(path: string): any?
	if not fs.isFile(path) then
		return nil
	end
	local ok, v = pcall(serde.decode, "json" :: any, fs.readFile(path))
	return if ok then v else nil
end

local function dirOf(path: string): string
	return string.match(path, "^(.*)/[^/]*$") or ""
end

-- `rel` inside the content root (a game's folder) when it has one, else the project's
local function inRoot(root: string, rel: string): string?
	if root ~= "" and fs.isFile(root .. rel) then
		return root .. rel
	end
	if fs.isFile(rel) then
		return rel
	end
	return nil
end

-- a project's private games (profiles.core.exclude_games in its kit.config.json) are never read by kit contract
local function guardGame(path: string?): string?
	if not path then
		return nil
	end
	-- the path as segments ("a/./b/../c" -> "a/c"), lower case, either slash: a game is matched as a whole folder name
	-- ("minigames/<name>" is not it; "games/Other/../<name>" is)
	local parts = {}
	for seg in string.gmatch(string.lower((string.gsub(path, "\\", "/"))), "[^/]+") do
		if seg == ".." then
			table.remove(parts)
		elseif seg ~= "." then
			table.insert(parts, seg)
		end
	end
	local p = "/" .. table.concat(parts, "/") .. "/"
	local core = (Config.load().profiles or {}).core or {}
	for _, g in core.exclude_games or {} do
		local name = tostring(g)
		local low = string.lower(name)
		if p == "/" .. low .. "/" or string.find(p, "/games/" .. low .. "/", 1, true) then
			return `kit contract never reads {name} (games/{name}, profiles.core.exclude_games): pick a hero outside it`
		end
	end
	return nil
end

-- the default kit scale: rbx_transfer.MM_PER_STUD (the 3D lane's own constant), read, not typed here
local function defaultMmPerStud(): (number, string)
	local src = "kit/blender/rbx_transfer.py"
	if fs.isFile(src) then
		local n = tonumber(string.match(fs.readFile(src), "\nMM_PER_STUD%s*=%s*([%d%.]+)"))
		if n then
			return n, `{src} MM_PER_STUD (no real_scale on the model)`
		end
	end
	return 0, `{src}: MM_PER_STUD not found`
end

-- every mm_per_stud the 3D build recorded (facts.cad[*].mm_per_stud: the scale each CAD part was built at; a
-- real_scale model's own) -> one value and where it was read; parts that disagree give the odd one (it fails 0.28)
local function findMm(manifest: any): (number?, string?)
	local found: { { v: number, at: string } } = {}
	local function walk(t: any, at: string)
		if type(t) ~= "table" then
			return
		end
		if type(t.mm_per_stud) == "number" then
			table.insert(found, { v = t.mm_per_stud, at = at .. ".mm_per_stud" })
		end
		-- in a fixed order (the source line is compared by check: it must read the same every time)
		for i = 1, #t do
			walk(t[i], `{at}[{i}]`)
		end
		local keys = {}
		for k in t do
			if type(k) == "string" then
				table.insert(keys, k)
			end
		end
		table.sort(keys)
		for _, k in keys do
			walk(t[k], `{at}.{k}`)
		end
	end
	walk(manifest, "manifest")
	if #found == 0 then
		return nil, nil
	end
	for _, f in found do
		if f.v ~= found[1].v then
			return f.v, `{f.at} disagrees with {found[1].at} ({found[1].v})`
		end
	end
	return found[1].v, `{found[1].at} (and {#found - 1} more alike)`
end

local function madeSounds(dirs: { string }): ({ [string]: boolean }?, string?)
	local args = { "kit/tools/contract_sounds.py" }
	for _, d in dirs do
		table.insert(args, d)
	end
	local step = Run.spawn("contract sounds", Run.tool("python"), args, true)
	local r = step.result
	if not step.ok or type(r) ~= "table" or type(r.names) ~= "table" then
		return nil, if type(r) == "table" then tostring(r.summary) else step.tail
	end
	local made = {}
	for _, n in r.names :: { any } do
		made[tostring(n)] = true
	end
	return made, nil
end

-- every source the contract binds, read into kit/lib/contract.luau's Inputs; madeWith = the resolved arguments
function ContractCmd.gather(hero: string, madeWith: { [string]: any }): (any?, string?)
	-- the model ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local manifestPath = tostring(madeWith.model)
	local refused = guardGame(manifestPath) or guardGame(madeWith.moves) or guardGame(madeWith.from)
	if refused then
		return nil, refused
	end
	local manifest = readJson(manifestPath)
	if type(manifest) ~= "table" then
		return nil, `no built model manifest at {manifestPath} (build the model first: kit asset <name>)`
	end
	local asset = tostring(manifest.asset or string.match(manifestPath, "([^/]+)%.manifest%.json$"))
	local files = {}
	for _, g in (if type(manifest.groups) == "table" then manifest.groups else {}) :: { [string]: any } do
		if type(g) == "table" then
			if type(g.fbx) == "string" then
				files[g.fbx] = sha256(g.fbx)
			end
			for _, p in (if type(g.textures) == "table" then g.textures else {}) :: { [string]: any } do
				if type(p) == "string" then
					files[p] = sha256(p)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if next(files) == nil then
		return nil, `{manifestPath} names no model file (groups[*].fbx)`
	end
	local mm, mmAt = findMm(manifest)
	local mmSource = `{manifestPath} {tostring(mmAt)}`
	if not mm then
		mm, mmSource = defaultMmPerStud()
	end

	-- the move set and its content root ------------------------------------------------------------------------
	local setPath = tostring(madeWith.moves)
	local set = readJson(setPath)
	if type(set) ~= "table" or type(set.moves) ~= "table" then
		return nil, `no compiled move set at {setPath} (kit moves build first)`
	end
	local root = string.match(setPath, "^(.-)src/moves/[^/]+$") or ""
	local moveFiles = {}
	local clips = {}
	local cues = {}
	local function clip(anim: string)
		local c = { files = {}, sword = nil :: any }
		for _, rel in { `assets/animations/{anim}.move.json`, `src/animations/{anim}.model.json` } do
			local p = inRoot(root, rel)
			if p then
				c.files[p] = sha256(p)
				if string.sub(rel, -10) == ".move.json" then
					local mj = readJson(p)
					c.sword = if type(mj) == "table" then mj.sword else nil
				end
			end
		end
		clips[anim] = c
	end
	local function preset(name: string): any
		local seq = inRoot(root, `assets/effects/sequences/{name}.seq.json`)
		if seq then
			return { kind = "sequence", path = seq, sha = sha256(seq) }
		end
		local p = inRoot(root, `assets/effects/{name}.json`)
		if p then
			return { kind = "preset", path = p, sha = sha256(p) }
		end
		return false
	end
	for name, m in set.moves :: { [string]: any } do
		local mp = inRoot(root, `assets/moves/{name}.json`)
		moveFiles[name] = if mp then { path = mp, sha = sha256(mp) } else false
		if type(m) == "table" then
			if type(m.anim) == "string" then
				clip(m.anim)
			end
			for _, v in (if type(m.vfx) == "table" then m.vfx else {}) :: { any } do
				if type(v) == "table" and type(v.preset) == "string" then
					cues[v.preset] = preset(v.preset)
				end
			end
		end
	end
	if type(set.parry) == "table" and type(set.parry.anim) == "string" then
		clip(set.parry.anim)
	end

	local vfx: any = nil
	if type(madeWith.vfx) == "string" then
		local where = preset(madeWith.vfx)
		vfx = if where then { name = madeWith.vfx, kind = where.kind, path = where.path, sha = where.sha } else false
	end

	-- the sounds: the catalogue beside the set, the names its recipes and sets make, the parry's event
	local sfx: any = false
	local catalogPath = inRoot(root, "assets/sounds/_events.json")
	if catalogPath then
		local cat = readJson(catalogPath)
		-- the recipes and sets beside the catalogue, then the project's own (a game's events play the kit
		-- project's sound sets: the SampleDojo's SwordSwing is made by assets/sounds/sets/sword_combat.json) - the same
		-- game-first, project-second rule as every other source here
		local dirs = {}
		for _, d in { dirOf(catalogPath), "assets/sounds" } do
			if fs.isDir(d) and not table.find(dirs, d) then
				table.insert(dirs, d)
			end
		end
		local made, err = madeSounds(dirs)
		if not made then
			return nil, `the sounds in {table.concat(dirs, ", ")} could not be listed: {tostring(err)}`
		end
		sfx = {
			path = catalogPath,
			sha = sha256(catalogPath),
			events = if type(cat) == "table" and type(cat.events) == "table" then cat.events else {},
			made = made,
		}
	end
	local parryEvent = nil
	if type(set.parry) == "table" then
		if type(set.parry.sfx) == "string" then
			parryEvent = { event = set.parry.sfx, source = `{setPath} parry.sfx` }
		else
			-- the runtime plays the parry's sound itself (Moves.luau: Sfx.broadcast("<event>", pos) on a landed parry)
			local rt = inRoot(root, "src/kit/Moves.luau")
			if rt then
				local ev = string.match(fs.readFile(rt), 'broadcast%("([%w_]*[Pp]arry[%w_]*)"')
				if ev then
					-- the label names the kit's runtime, not where it was read: a game's src/kit is a generated sync
					-- of it (gitignored: games/*/src/kit/), so a fresh checkout (kit prove's sandbox) reads
					-- src/kit/Moves.luau and a label of games/<Game>/src/kit/... drifted on nothing but the place
					local label = string.gsub(rt, "^games/[^/]+/src/kit/", "src/kit/")
					parryEvent = { event = ev, source = `{label} (broadcast on a landed parry)` }
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- the UI screen, the PROMPT-X packet, the uploaded id ------------------------------------------------------
	local ui: any = nil
	if type(madeWith.ui) == "string" then
		local p = inRoot(root, `assets/ui/{madeWith.ui}.json`) or inRoot(root, `assets/ui/screens/{madeWith.ui}.json`)
		ui = if p then { name = madeWith.ui, path = p, sha = sha256(p) } else false
	end
	local packet, packetReason = nil, nil
	if type(madeWith.packet) == "string" then
		local p = madeWith.packet
		if not fs.isFile(p) then
			p = Config.build(`prompt/packets/{madeWith.packet}.json`)
		end
		if fs.isFile(p) then
			packet = { path = p, sha256 = sha256(p) }
		else
			packetReason = `--packet {madeWith.packet}: no such packet`
		end
	else
		local dir = Config.build("prompt/packets")
		local named = {}
		if fs.isDir(dir) then
			local names = fs.readDir(dir)
			table.sort(names)
			for _, f in names do
				if string.sub(f, -5) == ".json" then
					local pk = readJson(`{dir}/{f}`)
					if type(pk) == "table" and (pk.piece == asset or pk.piece == hero) then
						table.insert(named, `{dir}/{f}`)
					end
				end
			end
		end
		if #named == 1 then
			packet = { path = named[1], sha256 = sha256(named[1]) }
		elseif #named > 1 then
			packetReason = `{#named} PROMPT-X packets name {asset}: pick one with --packet <sha>`
		else
			packetReason =
				`no PROMPT-X packet in {dir} names {if hero == asset then asset else `{asset} or {hero}`} (kit prompt compile ... --piece {asset} writes one)`
		end
	end
	local assetId, assetIdReason = nil, nil
	for _, idsPath in { inRoot(root, "assets/ids.json"), "assets/ids.json" } do
		local ids = idsPath and readJson(idsPath)
		if type(ids) == "table" and type(ids.models) == "table" and ids.models[asset] ~= nil then
			assetId = tostring(ids.models[asset])
			break
		end
	end
	if not assetId then
		assetIdReason = `not uploaded: assets/ids.json models has no {asset} (an upload is the owner's: kit upload)`
	end

	return {
		hero = hero,
		madeWith = madeWith,
		model = {
			asset = asset,
			manifestPath = manifestPath,
			manifest = manifest,
			files = files,
			mmPerStud = mm,
			mmPerStudSource = mmSource,
		},
		set = { path = setPath, sha = sha256(setPath), data = set },
		moveFiles = moveFiles,
		clips = clips,
		vfx = vfx,
		cues = cues,
		sfx = sfx,
		parryEvent = parryEvent,
		ui = ui,
		packet = packet,
		packetReason = packetReason,
		assetId = assetId,
		assetIdReason = assetIdReason,
	},
		nil
end

local function defaultDir(): string
	return Config.root() .. "assets/contracts"
end

local function heroes(dir: string): { string }
	local out = {}
	if fs.isDir(dir) then
		for _, f in fs.readDir(dir) do
			if string.sub(f, -5) == ".json" then
				table.insert(out, string.sub(f, 1, -6))
			end
		end
	end
	table.sort(out)
	return out
end

-- check every contract in `dir` (or one hero): the step the self-test and `kit contract check` share
-- opts.emptyOk: no contract in `dir` passes (kit verify on a project with none yet); opts.unbuiltOk: a contract whose
-- model files are ALL absent (build/ is git-ignored: a fresh checkout or a kit prove sandbox has none) is skipped
-- and named, never passed as checked
function ContractCmd.step(dir: string, only: string?, opts: { emptyOk: boolean?, unbuiltOk: boolean? }?): Run.Step
	local o = opts or {}
	local names = if only then { only } else heroes(dir)
	if #names == 0 and o.emptyOk then
		return Run.step("contract", true, "", {
			status = "pass",
			summary = `contract check: no contract in {dir} yet`,
			next_action = "none",
		})
	end
	if #names == 0 then
		return Run.step("contract", false, `no contract in {dir}`, {
			status = "fail",
			summary = `contract check: no contract in {dir}`,
			next_action = "lune run kit contract new <hero> --model <asset> --moves <set> [--from <Game>] --game none",
		})
	end
	local lines, failed, warned, skipped = {}, {}, 0, 0
	local firstFix: string? = nil
	for _, hero in names do
		local path = `{dir}/{hero}.json`
		local stored = readJson(path)
		if type(stored) ~= "table" then
			table.insert(failed, `{hero}: {path} is missing or not JSON`)
			continue
		end
		if o.unbuiltOk and type(stored.model) == "table" and type(stored.model.files) == "table" then
			local built = false
			for p in stored.model.files do
				built = built or fs.isFile(p)
			end
			if not built then
				skipped += 1
				table.insert(lines, `[skip] {hero}: its model is not built in this checkout (build/ is git-ignored)`)
				continue
			end
		end
		local inp, err = ContractCmd.gather(hero, if type(stored.madeWith) == "table" then stored.madeWith else {})
		local problems = if inp
			then Contract.check(stored, Contract.build(inp, hashString))
			else { `sources {tostring(err)}` }
		if #problems == 0 then
			table.insert(
				lines,
				`[ok] {hero}: model {tostring(stored.model and stored.model.asset)} {string.sub(
					tostring(stored.modelSha256),
					1,
					12
				)}, set {tostring(stored.animSet and stored.animSet.name)}, hit frame {tostring(
					stored.movesTimeline and stored.movesTimeline.hitFrame
				)}`
			)
		else
			table.insert(lines, `[FAIL] {hero}: {#problems} problem(s)`)
			for _, p in problems do
				table.insert(lines, `    {hero} {p}`)
			end
			table.insert(failed, `{hero} {problems[1]}`)
			if not firstFix then
				local mw = stored.madeWith or {}
				local args = `--model {tostring(mw.model)} --moves {tostring(mw.moves)}`
				for _, k in { "vfx", "ui", "packet" } do
					if type(mw[k]) == "string" then
						args ..= ` --{k} {mw[k]}`
					end
				end
				firstFix =
					`a lane changed what {hero} binds: rebuild or re-check what reads it, then re-sign only after looking: lune run kit contract new {hero} {args} --dir {dir} --force --game none`
			end
		end
		for _, w in Contract.warnings(stored) do
			warned += 1
			table.insert(lines, `    {hero} warn: {w}`)
		end
	end
	local ok = #failed == 0
	local summary = if ok
		then `contract check: {#names - skipped} contract(s) match their sources{if skipped > 0
			then `, {skipped} not built here`
			else ""}{if warned > 0 then ` ({warned} warning(s))` else ""}`
		else `contract check: {#failed} of {#names} drifted - {failed[1]}`
	return Run.step("contract", ok, table.concat(lines, "\n"), {
		status = if ok then "pass" else "fail",
		summary = summary,
		next_action = if ok then "none - proceed" else firstFix or "read the problems above",
		lines = lines,
	})
end

local function resolveArgs(flags: { [string]: any }): ({ [string]: any }?, string?)
	if type(flags.model) ~= "string" or type(flags.moves) ~= "string" then
		return nil, "contract new needs --model <asset | manifest> and --moves <set | path>"
	end
	local from = if type(flags.from) == "string" then flags.from else nil
	local refused = guardGame(from)
	if refused then
		return nil, refused
	end
	if from and not fs.isDir(`games/{from}`) then
		return nil, `--from {from}: no games/{from}`
	end
	local root = if from then `games/{from}/` else Config.root()
	local model = flags.model
	if not fs.isFile(model) then
		model = Config.build(`models/{model}.manifest.json`)
	end
	local moves = flags.moves
	if not fs.isFile(moves) then
		moves = `{root}src/moves/{moves}.json`
	end
	return {
		model = model,
		moves = moves,
		from = from,
		vfx = if type(flags.vfx) == "string" then flags.vfx else nil,
		ui = if type(flags.ui) == "string" then flags.ui else nil,
		packet = if type(flags.packet) == "string" then flags.packet else nil,
	},
		nil
end

local USAGE =
	"contract new <hero> --model <asset|manifest> --moves <set|path> [--from <Game>] [--vfx <preset>] [--ui <screen>] [--packet <sha>] [--force] | check [<hero>] | list   [--dir <folder>]"

function ContractCmd.register(Cli_: any)
	Cli_.command(
		"work",
		"contract",
		USAGE,
		"the cross-lane contract of a hero weapon (assets/contracts/<hero>.json): model hash + sockets at 1 stud = 0.28 m, the move set's Hit / Cancel / Hitstop frames, VFX, swing / hit / parry sounds, UI trigger, PROMPT-X packet - read from the sources; check fails by name on any drift",
		function(rawArgs)
			local args, flags = Cli.parse(rawArgs)
			local sub = args[1]
			local dir = if type(flags.dir) == "string" then flags.dir else defaultDir()
			if sub == "check" then
				local step = ContractCmd.step(dir, args[2])
				if step.ok then
					print(step.tail) -- (a failing step's lines are printed by Run.report)
				end
				local r = step.result
				return Run.report(
					"contract",
					{ step },
					if step.ok then Run.CODES.PASS else Run.CODES.CONTENT,
					r.summary,
					r.next_action
				)
			elseif sub == "list" then
				local names = heroes(dir)
				for _, hero in names do
					local c = readJson(`{dir}/{hero}.json`) or {}
					print(
						`  {hero}: model {tostring(c.model and c.model.asset)}, set {tostring(
							c.animSet and c.animSet.name
						)} ({tostring(c.animSet and c.animSet.file)}), modelSha256 {string.sub(
							tostring(c.modelSha256),
							1,
							12
						)}`
					)
				end
				return Run.report(
					"contract",
					{},
					Run.CODES.PASS,
					`contract list: {#names} contract(s) in {dir}`,
					if #names > 0
						then "lune run kit contract check --game none"
						else "lune run kit contract new <hero> --model <asset> --moves <set> --game none"
				)
			elseif sub == "new" and type(args[2]) == "string" then
				local hero = args[2]
				local path = `{dir}/{hero}.json`
				if fs.isFile(path) and not flags.force then
					return Run.report(
						"contract",
						{},
						Run.CODES.USAGE,
						`contract new: {path} exists (re-signing a contract invalidates what was built on it)`,
						`lune run kit contract check {hero} --game none (or add --force after looking at what changed)`
					)
				end
				local madeWith, err = resolveArgs(flags)
				local inp, gerr = nil, nil
				if madeWith then
					inp, gerr = ContractCmd.gather(hero, madeWith)
				end
				if not inp then
					return Run.report(
						"contract",
						{},
						if madeWith then Run.CODES.CONTENT else Run.CODES.USAGE,
						`contract new: {tostring(err or gerr)}`,
						"lune run kit help --all (kit contract)"
					)
				end
				local c = Contract.build(inp, hashString)
				local problems = Contract.validate(c)
				if #problems > 0 then
					for _, p in problems do
						print(`  {hero} {p}`)
					end
					return Run.report(
						"contract",
						{},
						Run.CODES.CONTENT,
						`contract new: {#problems} problem(s) in the sources - {problems[1]}`,
						"fix the lane that owns it (a sound with no recipe: kit sfx catalog; a missing file: build it), then run this again"
					)
				end
				Config.ensureDir(dir)
				fs.writeFile(path, Contract.encode(c))
				local nulls = {}
				for k in c.whyNull do
					table.insert(nulls, k)
				end
				table.sort(nulls)
				for _, k in nulls do
					print(`  null {k}: {c.whyNull[k]}`)
				end
				for _, w in Contract.warnings(c) do
					print(`  warn: {w}`)
				end
				return Run.report(
					"contract",
					{},
					Run.CODES.PASS,
					`contract new: {path} written (model {c.model.asset} {string.sub(c.modelSha256, 1, 12)}, hit frame {tostring(
						c.movesTimeline.hitFrame
					)}, {#nulls} field(s) null with a reason)`,
					`lune run kit contract check {hero} --game none`
				)
			end
			return Run.report("contract", {}, Run.CODES.USAGE, "contract: new | check | list", "lune run kit " .. USAGE)
		end
	)
end

return ContractCmd

-- docs.luau — `kit docs <words | Class.member>`: the Roblox Engine API reference, searched locally (2026-11-08, sprint 5:
-- proposal 11 - the code lane had no API docs). The source is the reference Roblox Studio ships on this machine (its
-- content/api_docs/en-us.json; nothing downloaded, nothing of Roblox's text copied into the repo); the declared type
-- of a member comes from the kit's own type file (kit/types/globalTypes.d.luau). kit/tools/docs.py does the search.
local Cli = require("../lib/cli")
local Run = require("../lib/run")

local Docs = {}

function Docs.register(Cli_: typeof(Cli))
	Cli_.command(
		"code",
		"docs",
		"docs <words | Class.member> [--k 6]",
		"the Roblox Engine API reference, searched locally (Roblox Studio's own en-us.json): an exact Class.member first, then by words, each with its declared type from the kit's type file",
		function(rawArgs)
			local args, flags = Cli.parse(rawArgs)
			if #args == 0 then
				return Run.report(
					"docs",
					{},
					Run.CODES.USAGE,
					"docs: which words or Class.member?",
					'lune run kit docs Players.PlayerAdded  /  lune run kit docs "raycast exclude list"'
				)
			end
			local argv = { "kit/tools/docs.py", table.concat(args, " ") }
			if type(flags.k) == "string" then
				table.insert(argv, "--k")
				table.insert(argv, flags.k)
			end
			local step = Run.spawn("docs", Run.tool("python"), argv, true)
			local r = step.result or {}
			for _, line in (if type(r.lines) == "table" then r.lines else {}) :: { any } do
				print("  " .. tostring(line))
			end
			local code = if step.ok
				then Run.CODES.PASS
				elseif step.result then Run.CODES.CONTENT
				else Run.CODES.TOOLCHAIN
			return Run.report(
				"docs",
				{ step },
				code,
				tostring(r.summary or "docs: the search gave no verdict"),
				tostring(r.next_action or "lune run kit doctor")
			)
		end
	)
end

return Docs

-- fit.luau — FITTING against references (CMA-ES, kit/blender/cmaes.py) — never against the quality score:
--   kit fit <asset> [--evals 120] [--only a,b] [--write]
--        the asset's a.param() numbers fitted to its references (silhouette IoU per view + proportions) over --geo
--        builds through a persistent Blender -> --write keeps them in assets/models/<asset>.params.json
--   kit fit camera <photo> --asset <name> [--blend <file>] [--fov <deg>] [--evals 3200] [--ignore <groups>]
--        [--exclude "x0,y0,x1,y1;..."]
--        which camera took the photo: the model's silhouette matched to the photo's cut-out (yaw, pitch, roll, framing,
--        lens; the lens comes from the photo's EXIF when it has one) -> build/camfit/<name>/camera.json + overlay.png
local fs = require("@lune/fs")

local Config = require("../lib/config")
local Run = require("../lib/run")
local Worker = require("../lib/worker")

local function option(rest: { string }, flag: string): string?
	for i, a in rest do
		if a == flag then
			return rest[i + 1]
		end
	end
	return nil
end

local function camera(rest: { string }): Run.Step
	local photo = rest[1]
	local asset = option(rest, "--asset")
	local blend = option(rest, "--blend") or (if asset then `{Config.build("models")}/{asset}.blend` else nil)
	if not photo or not fs.isFile(photo) or not blend or not fs.isFile(blend) then
		return Run.step("fit camera", false, "", {
			summary = `fit camera: needs a photo and a built asset ({photo or "<photo>"}, {blend or "<asset>.blend"})`,
			next_action = "lune run kit asset <name> first (a full build saves its .blend), then: lune run kit fit camera <photo> --asset <name>",
		})
	end
	local name = asset or string.match(photo, "([^/]+)%.%w+$") or "photo"
	local out = `{Config.build("camfit")}/{name}`
	fs.writeDir(out)
	local mask = `{out}/mask.png`
	local cut = Run.content("cutout", Run.tool("python"), { "kit/vision/run.py", "cutout", photo, "-o", mask })
	if not cut.ok then
		return cut
	end
	local fov = option(rest, "--fov")
	if not fov then
		local ex = Run.content("exif lens", Run.tool("python"), { "kit/vision/exif_fov.py", photo })
		if ex.ok and ex.result and type(ex.result.fov) == "number" then
			fov = tostring(ex.result.fov)
		end
	end
	local args = {
		"-b",
		"--factory-startup",
		"--python-exit-code",
		"2",
		"-P",
		"kit/blender/camfit.py",
		"--",
		blend,
		mask,
		"--out",
		out,
		"--evals",
		option(rest, "--evals") or "3200",
	}
	if fov then
		table.insert(args, "--fov")
		table.insert(args, fov)
	end
	local ignore = option(rest, "--ignore") -- model groups the photo shows differently (a deployed bipod)
	if ignore then
		table.insert(args, "--ignore")
		table.insert(args, ignore)
	end
	local exclude = option(rest, "--exclude") -- photo regions that do not count ("x0,y0,x1,y1;...", photo pixels)
	if exclude then
		table.insert(args, "--exclude")
		table.insert(args, exclude)
	end
	-- the asset's anchors marked on the photo (a thin object's pose), a known rough view, more starts, another manifest
	for _, flag in { "--points", "--start", "--starts", "--manifest" } do
		local v = option(rest, flag)
		if v then
			table.insert(args, flag)
			table.insert(args, v)
		end
	end
	return Run.content("fit camera", Run.tool("blender"), args)
end

local function params(asset: string, rest: { string }): Run.Step
	-- (fitting rebuilds the piece over and over: its clock and its route hold here as in kit asset, and so does
	-- the owner's approval of its model sheet - fitting is shape rounds)
	local staged = require("../lib/lanelocks").stages(asset, nil, nil, "geo")
	if staged then
		return Run.step("fit", false, "", {
			summary = `fit: {asset} skipped a stage approval (model sheet)`,
			next_action = staged,
		})
	end
	local stop = require("./content").prebuild(asset, Config.path("models"))
	if stop then
		return Run.step("fit", false, "", { summary = stop.summary, next_action = stop.next_action })
	end
	local h, why = Worker.start(1200)
	if not h then
		return Run.step("fit", false, "", { summary = `fit: {why}`, next_action = "lune run kit doctor" })
	end
	local args = {
		"kit/blender/fit.py",
		asset,
		"--models",
		Config.path("models"),
		"--build",
		Config.path("build"),
	}
	for _, a in rest do
		table.insert(args, a)
	end
	local step = Run.content(`fit {asset}`, Run.tool("python"), args)
	Worker.stop(h :: any)
	return step
end

return function(Cli: any)
	Cli.command(
		"3d",
		"fit",
		"fit <asset> [--write] [--weights side=1,front=0.4] [--hold <view>] | fit camera <photo> --asset <name>",
		"fit against references (never the score): an asset's a.param() numbers, or the camera a photo was taken from",
		function(rawArgs)
			local sub = rawArgs[1]
			local rest = { table.unpack(rawArgs, 2) }
			local step: Run.Step
			if sub == "camera" then
				step = camera(rest)
			elseif
				sub
				and (
					fs.isFile(`{Config.path("models")}/build_{sub}.py`)
					or (
						table.find(rest, "--models")
						and fs.isFile(`{rest[(table.find(rest, "--models") :: number) + 1]}/build_{sub}.py`)
					)
				)
			then
				step = params(sub, rest)
			else
				return Run.report(
					"fit",
					{},
					Run.CODES.USAGE,
					"fit: needs an asset (its a.param() numbers) or camera",
					"lune run kit fit <asset>   |   lune run kit fit camera <photo> --asset <name>"
				)
			end
			local r = step.result or {}
			return Run.report(
				"fit",
				{ step },
				if step.ok then Run.CODES.PASS else Run.CODES.CONTENT,
				r.summary or "fit: crashed",
				r.next_action or "read the error above"
			)
		end
	)
end
