local DailyDeals = {}
local purchaseWebhook = GetConvar('wqzx_dealership_webhook', '')
local inventoryReady = promise.new()
local ownershipInsert = 'INSERT INTO owned_vehicles (owner, plate, vehicle, type, stored) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
local needsLegacyOwnershipValue = false
local dealershipsById = {}
local vehiclesByDealership = {}

for _, dealership in ipairs(Config.Dealerships) do
    if dealership.id and dealership.spawn and dealership.testdrive then
        dealershipsById[dealership.id] = dealership
        vehiclesByDealership[dealership.id] = {}
    end
end

for _, category in pairs(Config.Vehicles) do
    local vehicles = vehiclesByDealership[category.dealership or 'cars']
    if vehicles then
        local seen = {}
        for _, vehicle in ipairs(category.cars) do
            if not seen[vehicle.model] then
                vehicles[vehicle.model] = vehicle
                seen[vehicle.model] = true
            end
        end
    end
end

MySQL.ready(function()
    local ok, err = pcall(function()
        MySQL.query.await([[
            CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS wqzx_dealership_inventory (
                model VARCHAR(50) NOT NULL PRIMARY KEY,
                stock INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                discount_percent INT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
                sales_disabled TINYINT NOT NULL DEFAULT 0
            )
        ]])

        local seededModels = {}
        local stockRows = {}
        local stockValues = {}
        for _, category in pairs(Config.Vehicles) do
            for _, vehicle in ipairs(category.cars) do
                if not seededModels[vehicle.model] then
                    seededModels[vehicle.model] = true
                    stockRows[#stockRows + 1] = '(?, ?)'
                    stockValues[#stockValues + 1] = vehicle.model
                    stockValues[#stockValues + 1] = vehicle.stock or 999
                end
            end
        end
        if #stockRows > 0 then
            MySQL.query.await(
                'INSERT IGNORE INTO wqzx_dealership_inventory (model, stock) VALUES ' .. table.concat(stockRows, ', '),
                stockValues
            )
        end

        -- Older ownership schemas can require an empty value in this external column.
        local column = MySQL.single.await("SHOW COLUMNS FROM owned_vehicles LIKE 'peopleWithKeys'")
        if column and column.Null == 'NO' and column.Default == nil then
            ownershipInsert = 'INSERT INTO owned_vehicles (owner, plate, vehicle, type, stored, peopleWithKeys) VALUES (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)'
            needsLegacyOwnershipValue = true
        end
    end)

    inventoryReady:resolve(ok)
    if not ok then error(err) end
end)

local function generatePlate()
    local chars = 'ABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789'
    local plate = ''
    local length = 8
    for i = 1, length do
        local rand = math.random(#chars)
        plate = plate .. string.sub(chars, rand, rand)
    end
    return plate
end

local function sendDiscordLog(playerName, vehicleLabel, plate, price, paymentType)
    if purchaseWebhook == '' then return end
    local embed = {
        {
            ["color"] = 3066993,
            ["title"] = TranslateDealership('log_purchase'),
            ["description"] = TranslateDealership('log_purchase_details'),
            ["fields"] = {
                { ["name"] = TranslateDealership('log_player'), ["value"] = playerName, ["inline"] = true },
                { ["name"] = TranslateDealership('log_vehicle'), ["value"] = vehicleLabel, ["inline"] = true },
                { ["name"] = TranslateDealership('log_plate'), ["value"] = plate, ["inline"] = true },
                { ["name"] = TranslateDealership('log_price'), ["value"] = Config.Currency .. price, ["inline"] = true },
                { ["name"] = TranslateDealership('log_payment'), ["value"] = (TranslateDealership(paymentType == 'bank' and 'log_bank' or 'log_cash')), ["inline"] = true },
            },
            ["footer"] = { ["text"] = "WQZX • " .. os.date("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S") }
        }
    }
    PerformHttpRequest(purchaseWebhook, function(err, text, headers) end, 'POST', json.encode({username = "WQZX Dealership", embeds = embed}), { ['Content-Type'] = 'application/json' })
end

local function sendTestDriveLog(playerName, vehicleLabel, price, paymentType, duration)
    if purchaseWebhook == '' then return end
    local embed = {
        {
            ["color"] = 16776960,
            ["title"] = TranslateDealership('log_test_drive'),
            ["description"] = TranslateDealership('log_test_drive_details'),
            ["fields"] = {
                { ["name"] = TranslateDealership('log_player'), ["value"] = playerName, ["inline"] = true },
                { ["name"] = TranslateDealership('log_vehicle'), ["value"] = vehicleLabel, ["inline"] = true },
                { ["name"] = TranslateDealership('log_price'), ["value"] = Config.Currency .. price, ["inline"] = true },
                { ["name"] = TranslateDealership('log_payment'), ["value"] = paymentType, ["inline"] = true },
                { ["name"] = TranslateDealership('log_duration'), ["value"] = duration .. ' s', ["inline"] = true },
            },
            ["footer"] = { ["text"] = "WQZX • " .. os.date("%d.%m.%Y %H:%M:%S") }
        }
    }
    PerformHttpRequest(purchaseWebhook, function(err, text, headers) end, 'POST', json.encode({username = "WQZX Dealership", embeds = embed}), { ['Content-Type'] = 'application/json' })
end

local function generateDailyDeals()
    if not Config.DailyDeals.enabled then return end
    
    DailyDeals = {}
    local allCars = {}

    for _, cat in pairs(Config.Vehicles) do
        if (cat.dealership or 'cars') == 'cars' then
            for _, car in ipairs(cat.cars) do
                table.insert(allCars, car)
            end
        end
    end

    local count = Config.DailyDeals.count
    if #allCars < count then count = #allCars end

    math.randomseed(os.time())
    
    for i = 1, count do
        if #allCars == 0 then break end
        
        local randomIndex = math.random(#allCars)
        local selectedCar = allCars[randomIndex]
        
        local discountPercent = math.random(Config.DailyDeals.discountmin, Config.DailyDeals.discountmax)
        local discountAmount = math.floor(selectedCar.price * (discountPercent / 100))
        local newPrice = selectedCar.price - discountAmount

        DailyDeals[selectedCar.model] = {
            model = selectedCar.model,
            label = selectedCar.label,
            originalPrice = selectedCar.price,
            price = newPrice, 
            discount = discountPercent
        }

        table.remove(allCars, randomIndex)
    end
end

CreateThread(function()
    generateDailyDeals()
end)

ESX.RegisterServerCallback('wqzx_dealership:getPlayerData', function(source, cb, dealershipId)
    local xPlayer = ESX.GetPlayerFromId(source)
    local id = dealershipId or 'cars'
    local vehicles = vehiclesByDealership[id]
    if not xPlayer or not vehicles or not Citizen.Await(inventoryReady) then cb(nil) return end

    local vehicleData = MySQL.query.await('SELECT model, stock, discount_percent, sales_disabled FROM wqzx_dealership_inventory')
    local formattedData = {}

    for _, vehicle in ipairs(vehicleData) do
        if vehicles[vehicle.model] then
            formattedData[vehicle.model] = {
                stock = vehicle.stock,
                discount_percent = vehicle.discount_percent,
                sales_disabled = vehicle.sales_disabled == 1
            }
        end
    end

    cb({
        name = xPlayer.getName(),
        cash = xPlayer.getMoney(),
        bank = xPlayer.getAccount('bank').money,
        dailyDeals = id == 'cars' and DailyDeals or {},
        vehicleData = formattedData
    })
end)

ESX.RegisterServerCallback('wqzx_dealership:payTestDrive', function(source, cb, model, dealershipId, locationIndex)
    local xPlayer = ESX.GetPlayerFromId(source)
    if not xPlayer or type(model) ~= 'string' then cb(false) return end

    local id = dealershipId or 'cars'
    local dealership = dealershipsById[id]
    local vehicle = dealership and vehiclesByDealership[id][model]
    if not vehicle or not dealership.testdrive.locations[locationIndex or 1] then cb(false) return end

    local testDrive = dealership.testdrive
    local price = testDrive.price

    if xPlayer.getMoney() >= price then
        xPlayer.removeMoney(price)
        sendTestDriveLog(xPlayer.getName(), vehicle.label, price, TranslateDealership('log_cash'), testDrive.time)
        cb(true)
    elseif xPlayer.getAccount('bank').money >= price then
        xPlayer.removeAccountMoney('bank', price)
        sendTestDriveLog(xPlayer.getName(), vehicle.label, price, TranslateDealership('log_bank'), testDrive.time)
        cb(true)
    else
        cb(false)
    end
end)

RegisterNetEvent('wqzx_dealership:buyVehicle', function(model, price, paymentType, label, colorIndex, dealershipId)
    local src = source
    local xPlayer = ESX.GetPlayerFromId(src)
    if not xPlayer or type(model) ~= 'string' or type(price) ~= 'number' then return end
    if paymentType ~= 'bank' and paymentType ~= 'cash' then return end
    local id = dealershipId or 'cars'
    local dealership = dealershipsById[id]
    local vehicle = dealership and vehiclesByDealership[id][model]
    if not vehicle then return end

    if not Citizen.Await(inventoryReady) then
        TriggerClientEvent('wqzx_dealership:notify', src, 'error', 'inventory_error')
        return
    end

    local dbData = MySQL.query.await('SELECT stock, sales_disabled, discount_percent FROM wqzx_dealership_inventory WHERE model = ?', {model})
    local stock = 0
    local salesDisabled = false
    local discountPercent = 0

    if dbData[1] then
        stock = dbData[1].stock
        salesDisabled = (dbData[1].sales_disabled == 1)
        discountPercent = dbData[1].discount_percent
    end

    if salesDisabled then
        TriggerClientEvent('wqzx_dealership:notify', src, 'error', 'sales_paused')
        return
    end

    if stock <= 0 then
        TriggerClientEvent('wqzx_dealership:notify', src, 'error', 'sold_out')
        return
    end

    local basePrice = vehicle.price
    local finalPrice = basePrice
    
    if id == 'cars' and DailyDeals[model] then
        finalPrice = DailyDeals[model].price
    elseif discountPercent > 0 then
        local discountAmount = math.floor(basePrice * (discountPercent / 100))
        finalPrice = basePrice - discountAmount
    end
    
    local money = (paymentType == 'bank') and xPlayer.getAccount('bank').money or xPlayer.getMoney()

    if money < finalPrice then
        TriggerClientEvent('wqzx_dealership:notify', src, 'error', 'insufficient_funds')
        return
    end

    if paymentType == 'bank' then
        xPlayer.removeAccountMoney('bank', finalPrice)
    else
        xPlayer.removeMoney(finalPrice)
    end

    local updated, affectedRows = pcall(MySQL.update.await,
        'UPDATE wqzx_dealership_inventory SET stock = stock - 1 WHERE model = ? AND stock > 0', {model})

    if updated and affectedRows == 1 then
        local plate = generatePlate()
        local color = math.tointeger(colorIndex) or 0
        local vehicleProps = { model = joaat(model), plate = plate, color1 = color, color2 = color }
        local params = { xPlayer.identifier, plate, json.encode(vehicleProps), dealership.garageType or 'car', 1 }
        if needsLegacyOwnershipValue then params[6] = '[]' end

        local inserted, insertId = pcall(MySQL.insert.await, ownershipInsert, params)
        if inserted and insertId then
            TriggerClientEvent('wqzx_dealership:spawnPurchasedVehicle', src, model, plate, color, id)
            sendDiscordLog(xPlayer.getName(), vehicle.label, plate, finalPrice, paymentType)
            return
        end

        MySQL.update('UPDATE wqzx_dealership_inventory SET stock = stock + 1 WHERE model = ?', {model})
    end

    if paymentType == 'bank' then
        xPlayer.addAccountMoney('bank', finalPrice)
    else
        xPlayer.addMoney(finalPrice)
    end
    local message = updated and affectedRows == 0 and 'sold_out' or 'purchase_failed'
    TriggerClientEvent('wqzx_dealership:notify', src, 'error', message)
end)

if Config.Framework == 'esx' and Config.Tracking.Enable then
	AddEventHandler('esx:onSetDuty', function(source, jobName, onDuty)
		local identifier = GetPlayerUniqueIdentifier(source)
		if not identifier then return end

		local job = GetPlayerJob(source)
		if not job then return end

		if not Config.Tracking.Jobs[job.name] then return end

		if job.onDuty then
			-- If player is hidden, we don't bother adding them to the locations table now
			local xPlayer = GetPlayerById(source)
			if Functions.CheckIfPlayerHidden(xPlayer) then return end

			local coords = GetEntityCoords(GetPlayerPed(source))
			local userId = GetCachedTrackingUserId(identifier)
			if not userId then return end

			exports[GetCurrentResourceName()]:SendUserLocations({
				users = {
					BuildUserLocationEntry(userId, job.name, coords, false, true),
				},
			})

			SetTrackingPosition(identifier, coords)
		else
			DeleteTrackingPosition(identifier, job.name)
		end
	end)

	AddEventHandler('esx:playerDropped', function(source)
		local identifier = GetPlayerUniqueIdentifier(source)
		if not identifier then
			Logger.error(('No identifier returned for player %s.'):format(source))
			return
		end

		DeleteTrackingPosition(identifier)
	end)
end

if Config.Framework == 'qbcore' and Config.Tracking.Enable then
	AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:OnJobUpdate', function(source, job)
		local identifier = GetPlayerUniqueIdentifier(source)
		local normalizedJob = GetPlayerJob(source)
		if not identifier or not normalizedJob then return end

		if not Config.Tracking.Jobs[normalizedJob.name] then return end

		if normalizedJob.onDuty then
			local xPlayer = GetPlayerById(source)

			-- If player is hidden, we don't bother adding them to the locations table now
			if Functions.CheckIfPlayerHidden(xPlayer) then return end

			local coords = GetEntityCoords(GetPlayerPed(source))
			local userId = GetCachedTrackingUserId(identifier)
			if not userId then return end

			exports[GetCurrentResourceName()]:SendUserLocations({
				users = {
					BuildUserLocationEntry(userId, normalizedJob.name, coords, false, true),
				},
			})

			SetTrackingPosition(identifier, coords)
		else
			DeleteTrackingPosition(identifier, normalizedJob.name)
		end
	end)

	AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:PlayerDropped', function(source)
		local identifier = GetPlayerUniqueIdentifier(source)
		if not identifier then
			Logger.error(('No identifier returned for player %s.'):format(source))
			return
		end

		DeleteTrackingPosition(identifier)
	end)
end

-- Multi framework handling
--
-- Heavily inspired by <https://github.com/nwvh/wx_bridge> and <https://github.com/meesvrh/fmLib> projects
--

ESX = nil
QBCore = nil

local identifierToUserIdCache = {}
local identifierToUserIdCacheTtl = 60

local function clearIdentifierToUserIdCache(identifier --[[string]])
	if not identifier then return end

	identifierToUserIdCache[identifier] = nil
end

local function clearIdentifierToUserIdCacheForSource(playerId --[[number]])
	clearIdentifierToUserIdCache(GetPlayerUniqueIdentifier(playerId))
end

if Config.Framework == 'esx' then
	ESX = exports['es_extended']:getSharedObject()
elseif Config.Framework == 'qbcore' then
	QBCore = exports['qb-core']:GetCoreObject()
else
	Logger.error('No framework selected for FiveNet, this will cause FiveNet to not work correctly!')
end

-- Framework independent functions

--- Resolve the framework identifier for a player source.
--- ESX returns the character identifier.
--- QB-Core returns `cid:license`.
---@param source number
---@return string|nil
function GetPlayerUniqueIdentifier(source)
	if Config.Framework == 'esx' then
		-- ESX
		local xPlayer = ESX.GetPlayerFromId(source)
		if not xPlayer then
			return nil
		end

		return xPlayer.identifier
	elseif Config.Framework == 'qbcore' then
		-- QBCore
		local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source)
		if not player then
			return nil
		end

		return player.PlayerData.cid .. ':' .. GetLicenseFromIdentifier(player.PlayerData.license)
	end

	-- Fallback
	local license
	for _, v in ipairs(GetPlayerIdentifiers(source)) do
		if string.match(v, 'license:') then
			license = v
			break
		end
	end

	return license
end
exports('getPlayerUniqueIdentifier', GetPlayerUniqueIdentifier)

if Config.Framework == 'esx' then
	AddEventHandler('esx:playerDropped', function(playerId)
		clearIdentifierToUserIdCacheForSource(playerId)
	end)

	AddEventHandler('esx:playerLogout', function(playerId)
		clearIdentifierToUserIdCacheForSource(playerId)
	end)
elseif Config.Framework == 'qbcore' then
	AddEventHandler('QBCore:Server:OnPlayerUnload', function(playerId)
		clearIdentifierToUserIdCacheForSource(playerId)
	end)
end

--- Resolve the FiveNet user DB ID for a framework identifier.
--- ESX expects the character identifier.
--- QB-Core expects `cid:license`.
---@param identifier string
---@return number
function GetUserIDFromIdentifier(identifier --[[string]])
	if not identifier then
		return 0
	end

	local cachedEntry = identifierToUserIdCache[identifier]
	if cachedEntry ~= nil then
		if cachedEntry.expiresAt > os.time() then
			return cachedEntry.id
		end

		clearIdentifierToUserIdCache(identifier)
	end

	local query
	local params = { identifier }

	if Config.Framework == 'esx' then
		query = 'SELECT `id` FROM `users` WHERE `identifier` = ? LIMIT 1'
	elseif Config.Framework == 'qbcore' then
		params[1] = GetLicenseFromIdentifier(identifier)
		params[2] = string.sub(identifier, 1, (string.find(identifier, ':', 1, true) or 0) - 1)

		query = 'SELECT `id` FROM `players` WHERE `citizenid` = ? AND `cid` = ? LIMIT 1'
	else
		return 0
	end

	local id = MySQL.scalar.await(query, params)
	if not id then
		return 0
	end

	identifierToUserIdCache[identifier] = {
		id = id,
		expiresAt = os.time() + identifierToUserIdCacheTtl,
	}
	return id
end
exports('getUserIDFromIdentifier', GetUserIDFromIdentifier)

--- Mark the framework user row as changed so DBSync can pick it up.
--- ESX updates `users.last_seen`.
--- QB-Core updates `players.updated_at`.
---@param identifier string
---@return boolean
function MarkUserForSync(identifier --[[string]])
	local userId = GetUserIDFromIdentifier(identifier)
	if not userId or userId == 0 then
		return false
	end

	local query
	if Config.Framework == 'esx' then
		query = 'UPDATE `users` SET `last_seen` = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE `id` = ? LIMIT 1'
	elseif Config.Framework == 'qbcore' then
		query = 'UPDATE `players` SET `updated_at` = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE `id` = ? LIMIT 1'
	else
		return false
	end

	local affectedRows = MySQL.update.await(query, { userId })
	return affectedRows ~= nil and affectedRows > 0
end
exports('markUserForSync', MarkUserForSync)

--- Resolve the FiveNet user DB ID for a player source.
---@param source number
---@return number|nil
function GetUserDBID(source)
	if Config.Framework == 'esx' then
		-- ESX doesn't select the `id` at all when loading the player, so we need to query it ourselves
		return GetUserIDFromIdentifier(GetPlayerUniqueIdentifier(source))
	elseif Config.Framework == 'qbcore' then
		-- QBCore
		local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source)
		if not player then
			return nil
		end

		if player.PlayerData.id ~= nil then
			return player.PlayerData.id
		end

		return GetUserIDFromIdentifier(GetPlayerUniqueIdentifier(source))
	end

	-- Fallback
	return 0
end
exports('getUserDBID', GetUserDBID)

--- Mark the framework user row for a player source as changed so DBSync can pick it up.
---@param source number
---@return boolean
function MarkPlayerForSync(source)
	local identifier = GetPlayerUniqueIdentifier(source)
	if not identifier then
		return false
	end

	return MarkUserForSync(identifier)
end
exports('markPlayerForSync', MarkPlayerForSync)

--- Return the player's job information for the active framework.
---@param source number
---@return table
function GetPlayerJob(source)
	if Config.Framework == 'esx' then
		-- ESX
		local xPlayer = ESX.GetPlayerFromId(source)
		if not xPlayer then
			return nil
		end

		return NormalizePlayerJob(xPlayer.job, xPlayer.job.onDuty)
	elseif Config.Framework == 'qbcore' then
		-- QBCore
		local player = QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source)
		if not player then
			return nil
		end

		return NormalizePlayerJob(player.PlayerData.job, player.PlayerData.job.onduty)
	end

	-- Fallback
	return {
		name = 'unemployed',
		label = 'Unemployed',
		grade = 0,
		gradeLabel = 'Unemployed',
		onDuty = false,
	}
end

--- Return the framework player object for a source.
---@param source number
---@return table|nil
function GetPlayerById(source)
	if Config.Framework == 'esx' then
        return ESX.GetPlayerFromId(source)
    elseif Config.Framework == 'qbcore' then
        return QBCore.Functions.GetPlayer(source)
    end

    return nil
end

--- Return the framework-specific player list.
---@return table
function GetPlayers()
	if Config.Framework == 'esx' then
        return ESX.GetExtendedPlayers()
    elseif Config.Framework == 'qbcore' then
        return QBCore.Functions.GetQBPlayers()
    end

    return {}
end
